inspecao-palavra-aff.excerptEs: Palabras: «aff» — interjección BR de hastío; inspección severa: termómetro ok, veredicto final sin informe = reprobado.
inspecao-palavra-aff.contentEn:
## Scope

**Severe inspection** of Brazilian Portuguese interjection **aff** — short breath of exasperation. Not a plant name. Marks fatigue, disappointment, a stuck keyboard, a half-said sentence. Frequent oral pair: **[já](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ja.html)** (“aff, já…”).

> Method note: independent audit, severe tone. Support: oral use, [Wiktionary · aff](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/aff). Word sheet ≠ therapy.

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **aff** |
| Class | Interjection |
| Lab type | Exasperation signal — risk of closing the inspection early |
| Date | 2026-08-02 |

## Severe findings

| Use | Reading |
|-----|---------|
| “Aff” + what failed | Craft — name the object |
| “Aff” alone as ending | Premature close — object vanishes |
| “Aff” + erase all | [Backspace](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-backspace.html) temptation |
| “Aff, já…” | Chest + clock — high risk of empty close | [já](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ja.html) |

**Verdict:** the lab accepts “aff” as a thermometer. It refuses “aff” as a final verdict — including “aff, já”.

## Status

**Approved with severe caveat** — legitimate as signal; rejected as silence that skips method.

inspecao-palavra-aff.contentEs:
## Alcance

**Inspección severa** de la interjección brasileña **aff** — soplo de exasperación. No es nombre de planta. Marca cansancio, decepción, teclado que falla, frase a medias. Par oral frecuente: **[já](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ja.html)** («aff, já…»).

> Nota: auditoría independiente, tono severo. Apoyo: uso oral, [Wikcionario · aff](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/aff). Ficha ≠ terapia.

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |

| Clase | Interjección |
| Tipo lab | Señal de exasperación — riesgo de cerrar la inspección |
| Fecha | 2026-08-02 |

## Hallazgos severos

| Uso | Lectura |
|-----|---------|
| «Aff» + qué falló | Oficio — nombrar el objeto |
| «Aff» solo como cierre | Cierre prematuro |
| «Aff» + borrar todo | Tentación [backspace](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-backspace.html) |
| «Aff, já…» | Pecho + reloj — alto riesgo de cierre vacío | [já](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ja.html) |

**Veredicto:** el laboratorio acepta «aff» como termómetro. Rechaza «aff» como veredicto final — también «aff, já».

## Estado

inspecao-palavra-lavar.contentEn:
## Scope

**Lavar** (Lat. *lavāre*) — from **[hands](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mao-esquerda-direita.html)** with [water](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-agua.html) up to **“lavar a alma”**. Field slip: *larva de vulcão* → **[lava](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lava.html)** (molten rock), not **[larva](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-larva.html)** (insect). Ear also glues [formiga lava-pé](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-formiga-lava-pe.html).

> Method note: [Wiktionary · lavar](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/lavar). *Alma* = intimate center (as in [revenge poisons the soul](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-vinganca-mata-alma-envenena.html)) — not a theology tract.

## Ladder

Hands → bucket/tool → diary day → **wash the soul**.

## Wash the soul — good × bad

| Use | Reading |
|-----|---------|
| Good | Name the weight, stay, record, do your best — tear as miniature water ([Águas…](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-aguas-e-lagrimas.html)) |
| Bad | “Soul washed” while erasing the fact ([backspace](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-backspace.html)) or washing hands of responsibility |
| Bad | Trying to wash with revenge — poisons instead ([ficha](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-vinganca-mata-alma-envenena.html)) |

## Status

**Approved** — lavar reaches the hands and climbs to lavar a alma; lava ≠ larva ≠ lava-pé.

inspecao-figura-ayrton-senna.contentEn:
## Scope

Homage and editorial inspection of **Ayrton Senna da Silva** (São Paulo, 21 Mar 1960 — Bologna, 1 May 1994) — Brazilian Formula 1 driver, businessman and philanthropist. Three-time world champion (1988, 1990, 1991). BudGanja focus: the **person and craft** — focus, rain, excellence and giving — with primary link to [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> **Method note:** independent audit from [Wikipedia · Ayrton Senna](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ayrton_Senna) and the public legacy of the [Instituto Ayrton Senna](https://www.institutoayrtonsenna.org.br/). No commercial affiliation. Does **not** romanticize the crash. For companionship, see [Vida](/vida/). Distinct from cannabis Legacy.

## Inspected object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Name | **Ayrton Senna da Silva** |
| Titles | **3× F1 World Champion** (1988, 1990, 1991) |
| F1 summary | 161 GPs · **41** wins · **80** podiums · **65** poles |
| Social legacy | [Instituto Ayrton Senna](https://www.institutoayrtonsenna.org.br/) |
| Lab type | Person — craft of excellence × Valeu !!! |
| Main link | [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) · [Vida poem](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Words | [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) · [path](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html) · [risk](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html) · [truth](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) |
| Source | [Wikipedia](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ayrton_Senna) |
| Date | 2026-08-03 |

## Hypotheses

**H1:** Senna’s BudGanja value is the **craft of the best** — preparation and delivery without making death an ideal.  
**H2:** [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) translates Senna’s method: *your* best, *today’s*, what fits *in this hand*.  
**H3:** Lasting good includes education/philanthropy (Instituto).  
**H4:** Rivalry ≠ [revenge](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-vinganca-mata-alma-envenena.html) — answer with craft and truth.

## Who he was (verifiable)

- Born in São Paulo (1960); kart from age 13; Brazilian/South American titles; yellow helmet trademark.  
- Europe: Formula Ford and British F3 (1983) → F1.  
- F1: Toleman 1984 (Monaco rain standout); Lotus 1985–87 (first win Estoril 1985 in rain); McLaren-Honda tricampeonato; Williams 1994.  
- Widely remembered among the greatest in F1 and a Brazilian icon of the 20th century.  
- After his death, Viviane Senna founded the **Instituto Ayrton Senna**.

## All the good (lab merits)

| Merit | Reading |
|-------|---------|
| Repeated excellence | Three world titles — method, not one-off luck |
| Rain & precision | Hard conditions = trained [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) |
| Focus before the lights | The “best” starts before the start |
| Brazil on the grid | National pride without diminishing others |
| Philanthropy | Victory that becomes school — [Instituto](https://www.institutoayrtonsenna.org.br/) |
| Safety legacy of the era | 1994 pain sped up F1 safety — read as **care**, not cult of blind risk |

## Link to “Valeu !!!”

|-------|------|
| Expression | [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Vida poem | [poem](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Vida | [Vida page](/vida/) |

## Limits

- Imola 1994 is historical fact — homage does **not** turn it into spectacle or ideal.  
- Not a closed biography, definitive ranking, or forensic crash analysis.  
- Elite speed ≠ everyday protocol: in the lab, **care** and **method** come first.

## Status

**Approved in People series** — full homage to Ayrton Senna of Brazil, primary link [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-palavra-ja.contentEn:
## Scope

Word sheet for Portuguese **já** — adverb of time and urgency (Lat. *iam*). In Brazilian speech it often pairs with **[aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html)**: “aff, já…” joins the **chest** (exasperation) to the **clock** (enough / now / already). [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) does not erase “já” — it inspects it.

> Method note: [Wiktionary · já](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/j%C3%A1). Sister sheet: [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html). Do **not** confuse with glossary language code `ja` (Japanese) — there, “aff” ≈ **はぁ** (*haa*).

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **já** |
| Class | Adverb |
| Etymon | Lat. *iam* |
| Main links | [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-03 |

## Aff × já

| Piece | Role | Risk |
|-------|------|------|
| [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html) | Chest — exasperation | Close without naming |
| **já** | Clock — enough / now / past | Declare end without inspecting |
| **aff + já** | Classic BR shortcut | Double silence |
| [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) | Craft after the shortcut | Continue with [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) |

## Status

**Approved** — “já” as the sentence’s clock; pair with [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html); empty close = caveat.

inspecao-palavra-genial.contentEn:
## Scope

Word sheet for Portuguese **genial** — adjective and praise interjection in Brazilian use (*gênio* + *-al*). In the **Inspetor BudGanja project**, “genial!” celebrates a **lab deed** (sheet, verse, link, grow); it does **not** replace [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) or [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Method note: [Wiktionary · genial](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/genial). Partial false friend with English *genial*. Word sheet ≠ IQ cult. Praise scale: [legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html) (slang) · [maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html) · [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html).

## What it actually is

Portuguese **genial** is not “anything nice” and not “a special person”. It names **ingenuity**: a deed or idea that **hit**.

| What people often mean | What the word is |
|------------------------|------------------|
| “I liked it” / “cool” | Closer to slang [legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html) |
| “Wow, it opened the chest” | Closer to [maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html) / [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html) |
| “That person is an idol” | [ídolo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-idolo.html) — a pedestal for a **person** |
| “Born a genius” | Myth; this sheet does not measure IQ |
| **“That idea / that deed hit”** | **This is genial** — ingenuity with a trail |

Root: Latin *genius* → Portuguese *gênio* + *-al*. In Brazil, “genial!” became a **praise puff**. In English, *genial* almost always means **amiable / mild weather** — **not** the same.

In the lab: “genial” points to a **deed** (sheet, verse, link, grow) — it does not replace [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) or [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html).

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **genial** |
| Class | Adjective · praise interjection (BR oral) |
| Etymon | *gênio* + *-al* ← Lat. *genius* |
| Praise scale | [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html) · [legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html) · **genial** · [maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html) · [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html) |
| Project links | [Inspections](/biblioteca/inspecoes/) · [Vida](/vida/) · [Cultivo](/cultivo/) · [Comunidade](/comunidade/) |
| Main links | [creativity](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-criatividade.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) · [Senna](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-ayrton-senna.html) · [especial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-especial.html) · [ídolo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-idolo.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-03 |

## Praise / intensity scale (BR oral)

| Intensity | Word | Marks |
|-----------|------|-------|
| Low / weight | [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html) | Exasperation |
| Mid / approval | [legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html) (slang) | “Cool / nice” |
| Mid+ / craft | **genial** | Deed that hit **ingenuity** |
| High / awe | [maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html) | Warm wonder |
| High / “wow” | [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html) | Fantasy **or** strong praise |

**Reading:** genial is the **craft/ingenuity** pole — not a synonym of [especial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-especial.html) (particular) or [ídolo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-idolo.html) (person on a pedestal). Legal’s juridical axis lives on the [legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html) sheet; here we use the “cool” pole.

## Genial × BudGanja project

| Project piece | What can be “genial” (with method) |
|---------------|-------------------------------------|
| [Inspections / Words](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-palavras) | New sheet, sharp link, clean etymon |
| [Vida](/vida/) · [poem](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) | Verse that stays; mantra on the banner |
| [Diário](/vida/diario/) | Day recorded without erasing the hard part |
| [Cultivo](/cultivo/) | Practical ingenuity |
| [Comunidade](/comunidade/) | Sharing with credit |

**Project reading:** genial is praise **after the commit** — not a shortcut before the work.

## Findings

| Use | Reading |
|-----|---------|
| “Genial!” + what worked on the site | Craft — praise with a project object |
| “Que legal” vs “genial” | Light approval vs recognized ingenuity |
| “The project is genial” without opening a sheet | Flattery — skips inspection |
| “I’m not a genius, so I stop” | Trap — BudGanja runs on the mantra |

## Status

**Approved** — praise of ingenuity **tied to the project**; BR praise-scale pole between [legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html) and [maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html) / [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html); contrast [ídolo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-idolo.html); empty cult = caveat.

inspecao-palavra-genial.contentEs:
## Alcance

Ficha de **genial** — adjetivo y exclamación de elogio en el uso BR (*gênio* + *-al*). En el **proyecto Inspetor BudGanja**, «¡genial!» celebra un **hecho del laboratorio** (ficha, verso, vínculo, cultivo); **no** sustituye el [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) ni [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Nota: [Wikcionario · genial](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/genial). Falso amigo parcial con el inglés *genial*. Ficha ≠ culto al genio innato. Escala: [legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html) (jerga) · [maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html) · [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html).

## Qué es de verdad

**Genial** no es «cualquier cosa buena» ni «persona especial». Nombra **ingenio**: lo que parece haber **acertado**.

| Lo que mucha gente siente | Lo que la palabra es |
|---------------------------|----------------------|
| «Me gustó» / «chévere» | Eso es más [legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html) (jerga) |
| «Guau, abrió el pecho» | Eso es más [maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html) / [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html) |
| «Esa persona es un ídolo» | Eso es [ídolo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-idolo.html) — pedestal de **persona** |
| «Nació genio» | Mito; la ficha no mide CI |
| **«Esa idea / ese hecho acertó»** | **Esto es genial** — ingenio con rastro |

Raíz: latín *genius* → portugués *gênio* + *-al*. En Brasil, «¡genial!» se volvió **soplo de elogio**. En inglés, *genial* casi siempre quiere decir **amable / clima templado** — **no** es lo mismo.

En el lab: decir «genial» apunta a un **hecho** (ficha, verso, vínculo, cultivo) — no sustituye [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) ni el [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html).

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Palabra | **genial** |
| Clase | Adjetivo · interjección de elogio (oral BR) |
| Étimo | *gênio* + *-al* ← lat. *genius* |
| Escala | [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html) · [legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html) · **genial** · [maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html) · [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html) |
| Vínculos de proyecto | [Inspecciones](/biblioteca/inspecoes/) · [Vida](/vida/) · [Cultivo](/cultivo/) · [Comunidad](/comunidade/) |
| Vínculos | [creatividad](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-criatividade.html) · [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) · [Senna](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-ayrton-senna.html) · [especial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-especial.html) · [ídolo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-idolo.html) |
| Fecha | 2026-08-03 |

## Escala de elogio / intensidad (oralidad BR)

| Intensidad | Palabra | Marca |
|------------|---------|-------|
| Baja / peso | [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html) | Hastío |
| Media / aprobación | [legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html) (jerga) | «Bacán / ok» |
| Media+ / ingenio | **genial** | Hecho que acertó el **ingenio** |
| Alta / asombro | [maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html) | Asombro cálido |
| Alta / «guau» | [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html) | Fantasía **o** elogio fuerte |

**Lectura:** genial es el polo del **ingenio** — no sinónimo de [especial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-especial.html) ni de [ídolo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-idolo.html) (pedestal de persona). El eje jurídico de *legal* vive en la ficha [legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html); aquí usamos el polo «bacán».

## Genial × proyecto BudGanja

| Pieza del proyecto | Qué puede ser «genial» (con método) |
|--------------------|-------------------------------------|
| [Inspecciones / Palabras](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-palavras) | Ficha nueva, vínculo afilado |
| [Vida](/vida/) · [poema](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) | Verso que queda; mantra |
| [Diario](/vida/diario/) | Día registrado |
| [Cultivo](/cultivo/) | Ingenio práctico |
| [Comunidad](/comunidade/) | Compartir con crédito |

**Lectura de proyecto:** genial es el elogio **después del commit** — no el atajo antes del trabajo.

## Hallazgos

| Uso | Lectura |
|-----|---------|
| «¡Genial!» + qué acertó en el sitio | Oficio — elogio con objeto del proyecto |
| «Qué legal» vs «genial» | Aprobación leve × ingenio reconocido |
| «El proyecto es genial» sin abrir ficha | Halago — salta la inspección |
| «No soy genial, entonces paro» | Trampa — BudGanja corre con el mantra |

## Estado

**Aprobada** — elogio de ingenio **ligado al proyecto**; polo de la escala BR entre [legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html) y [maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html) / [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html); contraste [ídolo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-idolo.html); culto vacío = salvedad.

inspecao-palavra-esquerdo.contentEn:
## Scope

Word sheet for Portuguese **esquerdo** / **esquerda** (left) — side, hand and craft metaphor. Covers **object**, **creation**, **purpose**, and [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html). Sister sheet: [left × right hand](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mao-esquerda-direita.html).

> Method note: [Wiktionary · esquerdo](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/esquerdo). Lat. *sinistra* field = left side — BudGanja **rejects** moral stigma. Word sheet ≠ clinical laterality.

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **esquerdo** · **esquerda** |
| Class | Adjective · noun (side / hand) |
| Lab type | Side of craft + creation; anti-stigma |
| Main links | [hands](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mao-esquerda-direita.html) · [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-03 |

**Object:** not only “opposite of right” — the **side the craft names** to support, write, type, hold the bucket, create.

## Relation to hands

**esquerdo** names the **side**; [hands](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mao-esquerda-direita.html) names the **tool pair** (incl. **right hand × heart** — action × care; the left also cares). Sister reading: hands = with *what*; esquerdo = on *which* side. Complementarity, not rivalry; both refuse “left = bad.”

## 2. Creation

| Creative act | Role of the left | Link |
|--------------|------------------|------|
| Write / type | Execute or support — depends on the person | [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) |
| Grow | Stabilize plant, carry bucket | [cultivo](/cultivo/) |
| Invent sheet / verse | Idea in the working hand — may be the left | [creativity](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-criatividade.html) |

**Creation verdict:** left **creates** as **instrument** — not as a label of exclusion.

## 3. Purpose

| Purpose | Reading |
|---------|---------|
| Orient | Name the side in space / body / keyboard |
| Complement | Pair with the right in craft |
| Create | Enable gesture |
| Care | Support vase, sentence, diary day |
| Destigmatize | Refuse “sinistra = bad” |
| Close with craft | [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |

## 4. Valeu !!!

Valeu !!! **with this hand today** — left or right. The side does not excuse stopping; it **orients** the gesture. Sister excellence: [Senna](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-ayrton-senna.html).

## Status

**Approved** — object · creation · purpose · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html); complements [hands](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mao-esquerda-direita.html).

inspecao-palavra-esquerdo.contentEs:
## Alcance

Ficha de **esquerdo** / **esquerda** — lado, mano y metáfora de oficio. Cubre **objeto**, **creación**, **finalidad** y [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html). Hermana: [mano izquierda × derecha](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mao-esquerda-direita.html).

> Nota: [Wikcionario · esquerdo](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/esquerdo). Campo lat. *sinistra* = lado izquierdo — BudGanja **rechaza** el estigma moral. Ficha ≠ lateralidad clínica.

## 1. Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Palabra | **esquerdo** · **esquerda** |
| Clase | Adjetivo · sustantivo (lado / mano) |
| Tipo lab | Lado de oficio + creación; anti-estigma |
| Vínculos | [manos](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mao-esquerda-direita.html) · [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) · [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Fecha | 2026-08-03 |

**Objeto:** no solo «lo contrario de la derecha» — el **lado que el oficio nombra** para apoyar, escribir, crear.

## Relación con las manos

**esquerdo** nombra el **lado**; [manos](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mao-esquerda-direita.html) nombra el **par de herramientas** (incl. **mano derecha × corazón** — acción × cuidado; la izquierda también cuida). Lectura hermana: manos = *con qué*; esquerdo = *en qué lado*. Complementariedad, no rivalidad; ambas rechazan «izquierda = mala».

## 2. Creación

| Acto | Rol de lo izquierdo | Vínculo |
|------|---------------------|---------|
| Escribir / teclear | Ejecutar o apoyar | [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) |
| Cultivar | Estabilizar, llevar balde | [cultivo](/cultivo/) |
| Inventar ficha / verso | Idea en la mano que trabaja | [creatividad](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-criatividade.html) |

**Veredicto:** lo izquierdo **crea** como **instrumento** — no como etiqueta de exclusión.

## 3. Finalidad

| Finalidad | Lectura |
|-----------|---------|
| Orientar | Nombrar el lado |
| Complementar | Par con la derecha |
| Crear | Permitir el gesto |
| Cuidar | Apoyar vaso, frase, diario |
| Desestigmatizar | Rechazar «sinistra = mala» |
| Cerrar con oficio | [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |

## 4. ¡Valeu !!!

Valeu !!! **con esta mano hoy** — izquierda o derecha. El lado no disculpa parar; **orienta** el gesto. [Senna](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-ayrton-senna.html).

## Estado

**Aprobada** — objeto · creación · finalidad · [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html); complementa [manos](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mao-esquerda-direita.html).

inspecao-palavra-lingua-portuguesa.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of the **Portuguese language** — the medium in which Inspetor BudGanja thinks, inspects and publishes. Covers **originality**, **changes over time**, **what it is for**, and [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html). Oral cross-link: [jesusamado](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-jesusamado.html).

> Method note: [Wikipedia · Portuguese](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/L%C3%ADngua_portuguesa), [Brazilian Portuguese](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portugu%C3%AAs_brasileiro), [Words](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-palavras), [Duvivier](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-duvivier.html). Not a full grammar.

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Name | **língua portuguesa** / Portuguese |
| Lab type | Language — medium of the whole project |
| Anchor variety | Brazilian Portuguese |
| Links | [Duvivier](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-duvivier.html) · [truth](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) · [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) · [pass](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-passar.html) · [path](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-03 |

## 1. Originality

| Layer | Lab reading |
|-------|-------------|
| Latin root | Romance heritage |
| Atlantic crossing | Language travels and transforms |
| Brazilian Portuguese | Slang, rhythm, *aff*, *já*, *genial!* |
| Traceable lexicon | e.g. [maconha](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maconha.html) |
| Craft of the word | [Duvivier](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-duvivier.html) — language as public research |

**Verdict:** originality = what the language **allows you to create** without lying about word origins.

## 2. Changes over time

Portuguese **does not freeze**. The lab method (origin → journey → transformation) applies to the whole language.

| Phase | What shifts |
|-------|-------------|
| Vulgar Latin → Galician-Portuguese | Sounds, morphology |
| Old / medieval Portuguese | Writing becomes document |
| Maritime expansion | Contact Africa / Asia / Brazil — [pass](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-passar.html) · [path](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html) |
| Brazil | Indigenous + African contact; BR variety (e.g. [maconha](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maconha.html)) |
| Print / school / radio | Written and spoken negotiate |
| Spelling agreements | Official norms across countries |
| Digital age | Chat slang — [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html) · [já](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ja.html) · [genial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-genial.html) |
| BudGanja today | Sheets inspect change **without denying the root** |

**Temporal hypothesis:** each [Words](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-palavras) sheet is a **cut in time**. Change ≠ decay; freezing “pure ancient Portuguese” = fail; erasing history = also fail. Living breath in BR orality: [jesusamado](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-jesusamado.html) vs [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html).

## 3. What it is for

Name · inspect (including through time) · create · care · share · learn · grow — in the project: [Words](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-palavras), [Vida](/vida/), [Cultivo](/cultivo/), [Comunidade](/comunidade/), [Guia](/guia/palavras.html).

**One line:** Portuguese is the **sound-soil** where the lab plants truth, gesture and care.

## 4. Valeu !!!

[Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) is written and said **in Portuguese** — honest **in this moment**, knowing the language still moves. Imperfect Portuguese ≠ stop; eternal purism ≠ the mantra.

## Status

**Approved** — originality · changes over time · purpose · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-palavra-lingua-portuguesa.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de la **lengua portuguesa** — el medio en que Inspetor BudGanja piensa, inspecciona y publica. Cubre **originalidad**, **cambios a lo largo del tiempo**, **para qué sirve** y [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html). Vínculo oral: [jesusamado](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-jesusamado.html).

> Nota: [Wikipedia · Portugués](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/L%C3%ADngua_portuguesa), [portugués brasileño](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portugu%C3%AAs_brasileiro), [Palabras](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-palavras), [Duvivier](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-duvivier.html). No es gramática completa.

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Nombre | **língua portuguesa** / portugués |
| Tipo lab | Lengua — medio de todo el proyecto |
| Variedad ancla | Portugués de Brasil |
| Vínculos | [Duvivier](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-duvivier.html) · [verdad](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) · [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) · [pasar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-passar.html) · [camino](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html) · [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Fecha | 2026-08-03 |

## 1. Originalidad

Raíz latina · travesía atlántica · BR oral (*aff*, *já*, *genial*) · léxico rastreable · oficio de la palabra ([Duvivier](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-duvivier.html)).

**Veredicto:** original = lo que la lengua **permite crear** sin mentir sobre el origen.

## 2. Cambios a lo largo del tiempo

La lengua **no se congela**. Método del lab (origen → viaje → transformación) aplica a toda la lengua.

| Fase | Qué cambia |
|------|------------|
| Latín vulgar → galaicoportugués | Sonidos, morfología |
| Portugués antiguo / medieval | La lengua se hace documento |
| Expansión marítima | Contacto África / Asia / Brasil — [pasar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-passar.html) · [camino](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html) |
| Brasil | Contacto indígena y africano; variedad BR (ej. [maconha](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maconha.html)) |
| Prensa / escuela / radio | Escrita y oral negocian |
| Acuerdos ortográficos | Normas oficiales |
| Era digital | Jerga de chat — [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html) · [já](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ja.html) · [genial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-genial.html) |
| BudGanja hoy | Fichas inspeccionan el cambio **sin negar la raíz** |

**Hipótesis temporal:** cada ficha de [Palabras](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-palavras) es un **corte en el tiempo**. Cambio ≠ decadencia; congelar «portugués puro eterno» = reprobado. Soplo vivo BR: [jesusamado](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-jesusamado.html) vs [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html).

## 3. Para qué sirve

Nombrar · inspeccionar (también en el tiempo) · crear · cuidar · compartir · aprender · cultivar — en el proyecto: [Palabras](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-palavras), [Vida](/vida/), [Cultivo](/cultivo/), [Comunidad](/comunidade/).

## 4. ¡Valeu !!!

[¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) se escribe y se dice **en portugués** — honesto **en este momento**, sabiendo que la lengua sigue moviéndose.

## Estado

**Aprobada** — originalidad · cambios en el tiempo · para qué sirve · [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-expressao-jesusamado.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of the Brazilian oral expression **“jesusamado”** — one breath (often written as one word) that mixes **awe**, **affection**, and, for many, a light **blessing**. Not a theological treatise — an **orality** sheet in Expressions, on [Portuguese language](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lingua-portuguesa.html) soil.

> Independent BudGanja audit. Object = the living form *Jesus amado*. Respect for faith; **no** proselytizing.

**Lab swap:** *jesusamando* → **jesusamado** (22 Aug 2026). The old [jesusamando](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-jesusamado.html) sheet redirects here.

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Saying | **jesusamado** (also *Jesus amado*) |
| Type | BR oral interjection |
| Canonical form | **jesusamado** — *Jesus* + *amado* (participle), not the gerund *amando* |
| Contrast | [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html) (exasperation) × **jesusamado** (warmth / awe) |
| Links | [Portuguese](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lingua-portuguesa.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) · [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) · [joy](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alegria.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-22 |

## Reading

**H1:** positive oral thermometer — mirror of [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html).  
**H2:** sounds like *Jesus* + *beloved* (*amado*), not the gerund *amando*. Everyday use does not require catechism.  
**H3:** marks warmth and awe — then [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Field note (2026-08-03)

Anonymous everyday audit: a **ride** toward **health care** (B12 injection; chronic pain). On that road, the useful breath was **jesusamado** (warmth / company) — not the high-awe peak of [jesusudavi](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-jesusudavi.html) (ex-*meudeusdoceu*). No personal data; **not** medical advice.

## Purpose

Exclaim · lightly bless (for those who believe) · open the chest after strain · celebrate · accompany under strain · return to craft.

## Verdict

**Approved** — BR oral warmth; contrast with [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html); link [Portuguese](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lingua-portuguesa.html) and [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Scope

Editorial inspection of Portuguese **fogo** (fire) — element, heat, light and craft metaphor (and danger). Covers **object**, **uses**, **care**, and [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html). Links: [água](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-agua.html), [raiva](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-raiva.html), [cultivo](/cultivo/).

> Method note: [Wiktionary · fogo](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/fogo), [Wikipedia · Fogo](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fogo). Not a fire-safety manual.

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **fogo** |
| Etymon | Latin *focus* (“hearth; stove; point”) → PT *fogo* |
| Lab type | Element × metaphor × care |

| Date | 2026-08-03 |

## 2–3. Senses and uses

Combustion · heat/light · affective ardor ([raiva](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-raiva.html)) · danger · “trial by fire” · cultivation dose (measured heat, not blind blaze).

**H:** hearth-center (*focus*); anger with craft ≠ [revenge](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-vinganca-mata-alma-envenena.html); in grow, unmeasured “fire” = harm.

## 4. Purpose

Warm/illuminate · warn · balance with [água](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-agua.html) · grow with measured heat · create · close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## 5. Valeu !!!

Best possible **with this heat**, today — without burning another’s chest. Fire without [path](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html) = blaze; fire with method = hearth.

## Status

**Approved** — object · uses · care · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-palavra-buguei.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of Brazilian oral **buguei** (family *bugar* / *bug*) — from English *bug* (insect) to machine fault to “my mind glitched.” Covers the **insect link**, the **shift that made it sound bad**, and [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Method note: [bug (EN)](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/bug), [Software bug](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Software_bug), [Insect](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inseto). Not a clinical diagnosis.

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Anchor | **buguei** (“I glitched / froze”) |
| Etymon path | EN *bug* “insect” → defect → BR slang |
| Links | [animal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-animal.html) · [Joaninha](/posts/post-inspecao-personagem-joaninha-joana.html) · [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html) · [backspace](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-backspace.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-03 |

## Insect relation

Insect → pest/nuisance → machine *bug* (defect metaphor) → BR *bugar* / **buguei** (mind/chest freeze). The insect stays in the etymon; modern use mostly hears the **error**.

## How it was altered to seem “bad”

Phases: insect (neutral) → pest (mild negative) → technical fault → device slang → affective “I failed.” Mechanisms: pest metaphor, person-as-machine, borrowing without credit, guilt tone. **Verdict:** sounding “bad” is **sense selection**, not the animal’s destiny — craft can name the stall without calling the person trash.

## Valeu !!!

After **buguei**, inspect the stall, credit the insect origin, return to [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) and [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Status

**Approved** — insect → fault → chest; pejorative shift mapped; [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-palavra-buguei.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **buguei** (familia *bugar* / *bug*) — del inglés *bug* (insecto) al fallo de máquina y al «se me trabó la cabeza» en BR. Cubre el **vínculo con insectos**, la **alteración** que lo hizo sonar a algo malo, y [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Nota: [bug (EN)](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/bug), [Software bug](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Software_bug), [Insecto](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inseto). No es diagnóstico clínico.

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Ancla | **buguei** |
| Camino | EN *bug* «insecto» → defecto → jerga BR |
| Vínculos | [animal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-animal.html) · [Joaninha](/posts/post-inspecao-personagem-joaninha-joana.html) · [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html) · [backspace](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-backspace.html) · [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Fecha | 2026-08-03 |

## Relación con insectos

Insecto → plaga → *bug* de máquina → *bugar* / **buguei** en el pecho. El insecto queda en el étimo; el uso moderno oye sobre todo el **error**.

## Cómo se alteró para parecer algo malo

Fases: insecto → plaga → fallo técnico → jerga de aparato → «fallé». Parecer «malo» = **selección de sentido**, no destino del animal.

## ¡Valeu !!!

Después de **buguei**, inspeccionar el tranco y volver al [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) con [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Estado

**Aprobada** — insecto → fallo → pecho; alteración mapeada; [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Scope

Editorial inspection of the Brazilian oral expression **“deu certo, galera”** (chat/mouth often **“deucer galerra”**) — **collective celebration** that something worked. Orality sheet; sisters [jesusamado](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-jesusamado.html) and [meudeusdoceu](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-meudeusdoceu.html); contrast with [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html) and [buguei](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-buguei.html); on [Portuguese](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lingua-portuguesa.html) soil.

> Independent BudGanja audit. **No** proselytizing — speech and sharing, not cult.

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Saying | **deu certo, galera** (also *deucer galerra*) |
| Type | BR oral celebration (group vocative) |
| Tone scale | [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html) / [buguei](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-buguei.html) (stall) ← → **deu certo, galera** (shared win) ← → [genial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-genial.html) / [jesusamado](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-jesusamado.html) |
| Links | [Portuguese](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lingua-portuguesa.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-03 |

## Reading

**H1:** shared-success thermometer — opposite pole of [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html) / [buguei](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-buguei.html).  
**H2:** *galera* is the circle that hears the announcement.  
**H3:** celebrate the result, then return to craft — [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Purpose

Celebrate the win · call the circle · leave the stall · light credit · close with craft.

## Verdict

inspecao-palavra-especial.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of **especial** (“special”) — and, **especially** (*em especial*), what the lab does with it in Brazilian Portuguese. Covers the **object** (Latin *specialis*, **not** a Tupi etymon), **BR oral/craft uses**, the **“em especial”** meta-frame, and a substantial **“Brazil’s originary words”** section linking existing sheets — without claiming *especial* is Indigenous.

> Method note: [Wiktionary · especial](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/especial), [specialis](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/specialis), [Portuguese](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lingua-portuguesa.html), [Duvivier](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-duvivier.html). **especial ≠ Tupi.**

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **especial** |
| Anchor phrase | **em especial** (“in particular; especially”) |
| Etymon | Latin *specialis* ← *species* — **high** confidence |
| Not | Tupi / folk “native” origin — **fail** as hypothesis |
| Links | [Portuguese](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lingua-portuguesa.html) · [maconha](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maconha.html) · [diamba](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-diamba.html) · [ganja](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ganja.html) · [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html) · [buguei](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-buguei.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-03 |

## Origin — Latin, not Tupi

*especial* is Romance/Latin. Brazil shapes **use** (praise, selection, craft), not the etymon. Inventing an Indigenous root erases the real Afro-Atlantic / contact stories already on file.

## BR oral and craft uses

Selection (“em especial…”), affectionate praise (“pessoa especial”), craft (“ficha especial”), marketing hype risk (“everything is special” = nothing is). Contrast: *especial* ≠ [genial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-genial.html) (particular vs ingenuity).

## Brazil’s originary words

Lab layers: **Afro-Atlantic** ([maconha](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maconha.html), [diamba](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-diamba.html)) · **Indic/Caribbean route in BR** ([ganja](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ganja.html)) · **BR orality** ([aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html), [buguei](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-buguei.html), [jesusamado](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-jesusamado.html), [meudeusdoceu](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-meudeusdoceu.html)) · **language soil** ([Portuguese](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lingua-portuguesa.html), [Duvivier](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-duvivier.html)) · **Latin alive in BR** (**especial** here). “Originary” ≠ “Tupi only.” *especial* is the **pointer** into that network, not a false Indigenous claim.

## Valeu !!!

Particularize with credit; refuse folk etymology; return to [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) and [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Status

**Approved** — Latin *specialis* (≠ Tupi); BR use; originary network linked; [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

*especial* es romance/latín. Brasil marca el **uso**, no el étimo. Inventar raíz indígena borra las historias afroatlánticas ya fichadas.

## Usos BR

Selección, elogio afectivo, oficio, riesgo de hype. Contraste: *especial* ≠ [genial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-genial.html).

## Palabras originarias de Brasil

Capas del lab: **afroatlántica** ([maconha](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maconha.html), [diamba](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-diamba.html)) · **ruta índica/caribeña** ([ganja](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ganja.html)) · **oralidad BR** ([aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html), [buguei](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-buguei.html), [jesusamado](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-jesusamado.html), [meudeusdoceu](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-meudeusdoceu.html)) · **suelo** ([portugués](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lingua-portuguesa.html), [Duvivier](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-duvivier.html)) · **latín vivo** (**especial**). «Originaria» ≠ «solo tupí». *especial* es el **puntero** de la red.

inspecao-palavra-fabuloso.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of Portuguese **fabuloso** — adjective and BR praise interjection. Etymon: Lat. *fābula* → *fabulōsus* → PT *fabuloso* / Eng. *fabulous*. Everyday BR “fabuloso!” is **high praise** — near [genial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-genial.html), [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html), [maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html) and slang [legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html) (“cool”), with a **fable / wonder** tint. Common typo trigger: *fabsulkaoso* → **fabuloso**. Celebrates a deed with method; does **not** replace [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) or [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Method note: [Wiktionary · fabuloso](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/fabuloso), [fábula](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/f%C3%A1bula), [fabulous](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/fabulous). Praise scale only links **existing** sheets.

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **fabuloso** |
| Etymon | Lat. *fābula* → *fabulōsus* — high confidence |
| Lab type | BR praise × fable root × hype risk |
| Links | [genial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-genial.html) · [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html) · [incrível](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-incrivel.html) · [maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html) · [magnífico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-magnifico.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-03 |

## 2–3. Senses & praise scale

Wonder / admirable · everyday “how great!” · cultured shadow “legendary / made-up.” Scale (existing): [legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html) · [especial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-especial.html) · [genial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-genial.html) · [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html) · [incrível](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-incrivel.html) · **fabuloso** · [maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html) · [magnífico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-magnifico.html). Good = praise with object; bad = “already fabulous, skip inspection” ([já](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ja.html) / [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html)).

## 4. Purpose

Praise after the commit · name the legendary carefully · bridge EN *fabulous* · normalize typos without shaming · close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## 5. Valeu !!!

Best possible **today** — no need to be absolutely “fabulous.” Trap: praise that skips [truth](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html).

## Status

**Approved** — *fábula* / *fabulous* etymon; BR everyday praise; scale with existing sheets; [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## 2–3. Sentidos y escala

Admirable · «¡qué bueno!» · sombra culta «legendario / inventado». Bueno = elogio con objeto; malo = «ya es fabuloso, no inspecciones».

## 4. Para qué sirve

Elogiar después del commit · nombrar lo legendario con cuidado · puente EN *fabulous* · normalizar typos · cerrar con [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## 5. ¡Valeu !!!

## Scope

Editorial inspection of Portuguese **respeito** (respect) — consideration, social practice, and the etymological sense of **looking again**. Covers **object**, **senses** (value × practice × boundary), contrast with [vingança](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-vinganca-mata-alma-envenena.html), and [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html). ## 2. Senses

**Look again** (etymon) · **consideration** · **social value** · **practice** (concrete acts) · **self-boundary** · register «a respeito de» (about).

## 3. Practice

Good = trackable [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) with [verdade](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html). Bad = “respect” as muzzle, hierarchy theater, or flattery. Faith of others: welcome tone ([jesusamado](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-jesusamado.html) / [meudeusdoceu](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-meudeusdoceu.html)) without doctrine.

## 4. Contrast

**Respeito** looks again; [vingança](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-vinganca-mata-alma-envenena.html) returns poison. Anger ([raiva](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-raiva.html)) may become boundary with method — or a venom cycle.

## 5. Valeu !!!

Best possible **with this regard**, today — without virtue posing. Respect without [path](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html) = poster; respect with method = consideration that stays.

inspecao-palavra-incrivel.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **[incrível](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-incrivel.html)** — Lat. *incredibilis* (“not believable”). Field request: *inspect incrível; cross it with acreditar or fé*. Covers the **object**, BR **unbelief × praise**, the **crossing** with **acreditar** (same *credere* trunk) and **fé** (Lat. *fides* — **another etymon**), sibling **[inacreditável](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-inacreditavel.html)**. Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Note: [Wiktionary · incrível](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/incr%C3%ADvel), [*incredibilis*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/incredibilis), [acreditar](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/acreditar), [*fides*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/fides#Latin). Word sheet ≠ catechism, ≠ proof.

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **incrível** |
| Etymon | Lat. *incredibilis* ← *in-* + *credibilis* ← *credere* (high confidence) |
| Lab type | Unbelief × BR praise × **acreditar / fé** crossing |
| Same trunk | **acreditar** / **crer** — the verb of *credere* |
| Other trunk | **fé** ← *fides* — trust / faith; crosses the chest, not the etymon |
| Sibling | [inacreditável](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-inacreditavel.html) — via *acreditar* |
| Date | 2026-08-24 |

**Crossing:** *incrível* names the **quality** (what will not fit in believing, or BR “wow”). *Acreditar* names the **verb**. *Fé* is **another root**. You can find it incredible without faith; you can have faith in the incredible. Craft: name the axis; do not fuse.

```poem
Incrível is what will not fit in believing.
Acreditar is the verb that tries to fit.
Fé is another trunk — fides, not credere.

You can find it incredible without faith —
awe, wow, BR hyperbole.
You can have faith in the incredible —
a chest that holds what proof has not yet closed.

The in- of incrível does not erase credit.
It only marks the limit:
this still does not fit,
or it has already left the expected.

Valeu !!!
incredible with a trail,
believe with an object,
faith without fusing the etymon.
```

## Status

**Approved** — *incredibilis* path documented; unbelief distinguished from praise, *acreditar*, and *fé*; sibling [inacreditável](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-inacreditavel.html) linked.

inspecao-palavra-incrivel.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de la palabra portuguesa **[incrível](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-incrivel.html)** — lat. *incredibilis* («que no se puede creer»). Pedido de campo: inspeccionar *incrível* y **cruzarlo con acreditar o fé**. Cubre **objeto**, oficios BR (incredulidad × elogio), el **cruce** con **acreditar** (mismo tronco *credere*) y **fé** (lat. *fides* — **otro étimo**), hermano **[inacreditável](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-inacreditavel.html)**. Cierre: [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Nota: [Wikcionario · incrível](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/incr%C3%ADvel), [*incredibilis*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/incredibilis), [acreditar](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/acreditar), [*fides*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/fides#Latin). Ficha ≠ catecismo, ≠ prueba.

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Palabra | **incrível** |
| Étimo | Lat. *incredibilis* ← *in-* + *credibilis* ← *credere* (confianza alta) |
| Tipo lab | Incredulidad × elogio BR × cruce **acreditar / fé** |
| Mismo tronco | **acreditar** / **crer** — el verbo de *credere* |
| Otro tronco | **fé** ← *fides* — confianza / fe; cruza el pecho, no el étimo |
| Hermano | [inacreditável](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-inacreditavel.html) — vía *acreditar* |
| Fecha | 2026-08-24 |

**Cruce:** *incrível* nombra la **cualidad**; *acreditar* nombra el **verbo**; *fé* es **otra raíz**. Se puede hallar incrível sin fe; se puede tener fe en lo incrível. Oficio: nombrar el eje; no fusionar.

```poem
Incrível es lo que no cabe en el creer.
Acreditar es el verbo que intenta caber.
Fé es otro tronco — fides, no credere.

Se puede hallar incrível sin fe —
asombro, uau, hipérbole BR.
Se puede tener fe en lo incrível —
pecho que sujeta lo que la prueba aún no cierra.

El in- de incrível no apaga el crédito.
Solo marca el límite:
esto aún no cabe,
o ya salió de lo esperado.

¡Valeu !!!
incrível con rastro,
acreditar con objeto,
fe sin fusionar el étimo.
```

## Estado

**Aprobada** — vía *incredibilis* documentada; incredulidad distinta de elogio, *acreditar* y *fé*; hermano [inacreditável](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-inacreditavel.html).

Editorial inspection of Portuguese **fantástico** (typo fix: *fantisico* → **fantástico**) — from **fantasy / the fantastical** to everyday BR praise (“fantástico!” = “awesome!”). Covers **object**, **two axes**, a **scale** with [legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html), [genial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-genial.html) and [maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html), and [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Method note: [Wiktionary · fantástico](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/fant%C3%A1stico), [fantasia](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/fantasia). Not a full fantasy-literature treatise.

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **fantástico** |
| Etymon | Lat. *phantasticus* ← Gk *phantastikós* ← *phantasía* |
| Lab type | Fantasy × BR praise × craft |
| Links | [legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html) · [genial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-genial.html) · [maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html) · [Alice](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-alice-no-pais-das-maravilhas.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-03 |

## 2–3. Senses and scale

Imagination / fantastical genre · strong everyday praise · scale: [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html) ← [legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html) (slang) ← [genial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-genial.html) ← [maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html) ← **fantástico**.

**H:** fantasy-root; BR praise is stable; good use points to a deed with [truth](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html); empty hype = caveat.

## 4–5. Purpose · Valeu !!!

Name fantasy honestly · praise with an object · separate hype from craft · after the wow, the next [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html). Best possible **today** — even when the chest feels fantastic.

## Status

**Approved** — fantasy × BR praise · scale with legal / genial / maravilhoso · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-palavra-memoravel.contentEn:
## Scope

Word sheet for Portuguese **memorável** — *worth remembering* and, in BR use, praise (“it was memorable!”). Core: Lat. *memorabilis*. Distinct from intensity praise ([genial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-genial.html), [maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html), [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html), [fabuloso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fabuloso.html), [incrível](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-incrivel.html), [legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html)): **memorável** = retention; praise-scale = intensity/approval.

> Method: [Wiktionary · memorável](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/memor%C3%A1vel), [memorabilis](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/memorabilis). Not clinical memory science. Typo source “memeopravel” read as **memorável** (not *meme*).

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **memorável** |
| Class | Adjective |
| Etymon | Lat. *memorabilis* ← *memor* / *memoria* |
| Memory links | [Inside Out / Divertida Mente](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-divertida-mente.html) · [emotion](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-emocao.html) · [book](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-livro.html) |
| Craft links | [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) · [truth](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) · [creativity](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-criatividade.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Scale (≠) | [legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html) · [genial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-genial.html) · [incrível](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-incrivel.html) · [maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html) · [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html) · [fabuloso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fabuloso.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-03 |

## Memory × praise scale

| Word | Main axis |
|------|-----------|
| **memorável** | Retention — does it stick? |
| [genial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-genial.html) · [legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html) | Approval / ingenuity |
| [maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html) · [incrível](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-incrivel.html) · [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html) · [fabuloso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fabuloso.html) | High intensity / wonder |

Intensity praise measures **how the chest sounds now**. *Memorável* measures **what is still here later**.

## BudGanja

Memorable = **trace** (published sheet, verse live, day in the diary) — not a slogan before the commit. [Vida](/vida/) · [Diário](/vida/diario/) · [book](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-livro.html) · [Inspections](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-palavras).

## Status

**Approved** — retention axis distinct from intensity praise; empty hype = caveat.

inspecao-palavra-legal.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of Portuguese **legal** — the **juridical** pole (lawful) and Brazilian slang **“cool / nice / ok”**, without erasing either. Covers **object**, **two sense axes**, useful contrast with English *legal*, and [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html). Links: [ilícito](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ilicito.html), [Lei 11.343](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lei-11-343.html), [porte × tráfico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-porte-trafico.html), [descriminalização](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-descriminalizacao.html), [risco](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html), [verdade](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html).

> Method note: [Wiktionary · legal](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/legal), [legal (EN)](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/legal). Not legal advice.

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **legal** |
| Etymon | Latin *legālis* ← *lex* — high confidence |
| Lab type | Juridical × BR slang × literacy |
| Links | [ilícito](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ilicito.html) · [Lei 11.343](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lei-11-343.html) · [truth](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) · [risk](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-03 |

## 2–3. Senses

Juridical (lawful / licit) · antonym [ilícito](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ilicito.html) · BR slang “bacana” · oral agreement (“tá legal”). English *legal* is almost only juridical — **not** “cool.” Literacy = name which sense is in play. Legalize ≠ [descriminalize](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-descriminalizacao.html).

## 4. Purpose

Name the law · separate maps (legalize / descriminalize / possession) · calculate [risk](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html) · approve with warmth when slang · close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## 5. Valeu !!!

Best possible **with the right tool** — law when law; “cool” when chest; never one standing in for the other without a flag. Trap: “I find it legal (cool) → therefore it is legal (lawful)” = false.

## Status

**Approved** — juridical × BR slang; English contrast; network linked; [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-palavra-legal.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **legal** — polo **jurídico** (conforme a la ley) y jerga brasileña **«bacán / ok / bueno»**, sin borrar ninguno. Cubre **objeto**, **dos ejes**, contraste con el inglés *legal*, y [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html). Vínculos: [ilícito](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ilicito.html), [Lei 11.343](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lei-11-343.html), [porte × tráfico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-porte-trafico.html), [descriminalização](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-descriminalizacao.html), [risco](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html), [verdade](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html).

> Nota: [Wikcionario · legal](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/legal), [legal (EN)](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/legal). No es dictamen jurídico.

## 1. Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Palabra | **legal** |
| Étimo | Latín *legālis* ← *lex* |
| Tipo lab | Jurídico × jerga BR × literacia |
| Vínculos | [ilícito](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ilicito.html) · [Lei 11.343](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lei-11-343.html) · [verdad](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) · [riesgo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html) · [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Fecha | 2026-08-03 |

## 2–3. Sentidos

Jurídico · antónimo [ilícito](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ilicito.html) · jerga BR «bacana» · acuerdo oral. Inglés *legal* ≈ solo jurídico — **no** «cool». Legalizar ≠ [descriminalizar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-descriminalizacao.html).

## 4. Para qué sirve

Nombrar la ley · separar mapas · calcular [riesgo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html) · aprobar con calor (jerga) · cerrar con [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## 5. ¡Valeu !!!

Lo mejor posible **con la herramienta correcta** — ley cuando es ley; «bacán» cuando es pecho. Trampa: «me parece legal (bacán) → entonces es legal (lícito)» = falso.

## Estado

**Aprobada** — jurídico × jerga BR; contraste con inglés; red enlazada; [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Object

| Lab form | **ausdhuashduas** (alias *aushduashduash*) |
| Common label replaced | **kkkk…** / *kkkk* |
| Plain label replaced | «risas online» |
| Type | BR oral / chat onomatopoeia |
| Contrast | [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html) (exasperation) × **ausdhuashduas** (laugh) |

| Date | 2026-08-03 |

## Reading

**H1:** thermometer of typed BR laughter — lab name for chat *kkkk…*.  
**H2:** «risas online» was a flat label; the sheet gives a stable form.  
**H3:** light sister to [jesusamado](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-jesusamado.html) / [meudeusdoceu](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-meudeusdoceu.html) — then [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-palavra-multitask.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of **multitask** (English loan) and Portuguese sister **multitarefa** — the productivity cult that promises “doing everything well at once.” Covers **object** (EN → BR), **seems vs is**, **BudGanja correction**, and [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Method note: [multitask](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/multitask), [Human multitasking](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Human_multitasking), [Computer multitasking](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Computer_multitasking). Not a management manual or attention diagnosis.

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Anchor | **multitask** · sister **multitarefa** |
| Path | Lat. *multi-* + EN *task* → computing → office/self-help → BR speech |
| Links | [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) · [truth](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) · [path](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html) · [buguei](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-buguei.html) · [Portuguese](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lingua-portuguesa.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-03 |

## 2. Seems vs is

**Seems:** superpower — everything well, all at once.  
**Is:** attention switching with a real cost (computers share time; humans pay context). Office BR praise often hides overload without method.

## 3. BudGanja correction

**multitask ≠ doing everything well at the same time.** Craft = **one thing with method**, or **intentional parallel with limits**. Name the [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html); when it stalls → [buguei](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-buguei.html) → [backspace](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-backspace.html) → [path](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html). Close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) — best in *this* act, not ten mediocre ones. Anti-hype: productivity cult identity (“I am multitask”) is not craft.

## Status

**Approved** — EN loan → BR; seems×is; correction mapped; [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

**multitask ≠ hacerlo todo bien al mismo tiempo.** Oficio = **una cosa con método**, o **paralelo intencional con límites**. Nombrar el [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html); si traba → [buguei](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-buguei.html) → [backspace](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-backspace.html). Cerrar con [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html). Anti-hype: culto de productividad ≠ oficio.

inspecao-palavra-fantasioso.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of Portuguese **fantasioso** — adjective (also “a fanciful person”). Etymon: *fantasia* + *-oso* (“full of”) → “full of fantasy.” In BR use it names a **fanciful / imaginative** person or idea — **praise** (“what a fanciful mind!”) or **mild critique** (“don’t be unrealistic”). Typo trigger: *fantatioso* → **fantasioso**.

> Method note: [Wiktionary · fantasioso](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/fantasioso), [fantasia](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/fantasia), [fanciful](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/fanciful). **Not the sheet for [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html)** (admirable / genre) — sister Cap., distinct axes. [Maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html) = wonder / warm praise — neighbor, not synonym. Network: [criatividade](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-criatividade.html) · [fabuloso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fabuloso.html) · [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html) · [maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html).

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **fantasioso** |
| Etymon | *fantasia* + *-oso* — high confidence |
| Lab type | Imagination × realism × craft |
| ≠ [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html) | Admirable / genre — sister Cap. |
| Links | [criatividade](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-criatividade.html) · [verdade](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) · [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) · [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-03 |

## 2–3. Senses & distinction

Full of fantasy · inventive praise · mild “get real” critique. Neighbors: [criatividade](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-criatividade.html) · [fabuloso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fabuloso.html) · [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html) · [genial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-genial.html). Good = fantasy with a trail; bad = confusing with [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html) (“wow!”) or skipping [truth](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html).

## 4. Purpose

Name inventiveness · warn unreality · normalize *fantatioso* → **fantasioso** (not *fantástico*) · close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## 5. Valeu !!!

Best possible **today** — fantasy with [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html), not escape from [truth](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html).

## Status

**Approved** — *fantasia* + *-oso*; praise × mild critique; clear ≠ [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html); [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

Lleno de fantasía · elogio inventivo · crítica leve «baja a tierra». Vecinos: [criatividade](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-criatividade.html) · [fabuloso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fabuloso.html) · [fantástico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fantastico.html) · [genial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-genial.html). ## 4. Para qué sirve

## 5. ¡Valeu !!!

Lo mejor posible **hoy** — fantasía con [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html), no fuga de la [verdad](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html).

Inspección de **planta** — el **ser vivo vegetal** (plural **plantas** para el conjunto / catálogo). Cubre **objeto**, **sentidos** (vivo · cultivo · farmacia · metáfora), vínculos con el hub [Plantas](/plantas/) y [Farmácia Viva](/posts/post-inspecao-guia-farmacia-viva.html), sin duplicar fichas de especie. Tono: oficio cálido. Vínculos: [animal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-animal.html), [simbiose](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-simbiose.html), [cultivo](/cultivo/), [Vida](/vida/).

> Nota: [Wikcionario · planta](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/planta), [Wikipedia · Planta](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Planta). Lat. *planta* / *plantare*. Ficha de palabra ≠ monografía botánica. Las especies viven en `inspecao-planta-*` (p. ej. [Cannabis sativa](/posts/post-inspecao-planta-cannabis-sativa.html)).

## 1. Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Palabra | **planta** (plural **plantas**) |
| Étimo | Lat. *planta* / *plantare* → PT *planta* |
| Tipo lab | Ser vivo vegetal × cultura de cultivo × farmacia |
| Vínculos | [Plantas](/plantas/) · [Farmácia Viva](/posts/post-inspecao-guia-farmacia-viva.html) · [animal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-animal.html) · [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Fecha | 2026-08-03 |

## 2. Sentidos

**Ser vivo vegetal** · **cultivo** · **farmacia / Farmácia Viva** · plural **plantas** · metáfora industrial · figurado.

## 3. Ser vivo

Buen oficio = ver el ciclo, cuidar con [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html), separar nombre popular / binomio / jerga. Malo = planta como mero producto.

## 4. Cultivo y Farmácia Viva

[Cultivo](/cultivo/) · [Farmácia Viva](/posts/post-inspecao-guia-farmacia-viva.html) · hub [Plantas](/plantas/) — **sin inventariar especies aquí**. Puente de ejemplo: [Cannabis sativa](/posts/post-inspecao-planta-cannabis-sativa.html).

## 5. ¡Valeu !!!

Lo mejor posible **con esta planta / este cultivo**, hoy — observar, cuidar, nombrar con método.

## Estado

**Aprobada** — objeto · sentidos · ser vivo · cultivo / Farmácia Viva · hub sin lista · [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-palavra-idolo.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of Portuguese **ídolo** (idol) — admired person / celebrity, cult image, figurative *idolatrar*, and media culture. Covers **object**, **layered senses**, lab **use**, and [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html). Links: [Senna](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-ayrton-senna.html), [Chorão](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-chorao.html), [genial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-genial.html), [truth](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html), [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html).

> Method note: [Wiktionary · ídolo](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/%C3%ADdolo), [Wikipedia · Ídolo](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%8Ddolo). Not a sermon or anti-fan essay.

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **ídolo** |
| Etymon | Latin *īdōlum* ← Greek *eídōlon* (“image; appearance”) |
| Lab type | Admiration × image × media × craft |
| Links | [Senna](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-ayrton-senna.html) · [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) · [truth](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-03 |

## 2–3. Senses and uses

Image/representation · religious-cult register (lexical, not preachy) · admired person (dominant BR use) · figurative *idolatrar* (excess) · media pedestal / fall. **H:** see the image before “worship”; admiration with craft ≠ handing over your [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html).

## 4. Purpose

Name admiration · separate persona from person · warn on excess · read media without cheap morals · close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## 5. Valeu !!!

Best possible **in this hand**, today — even when idols are on the horizon. Idol without [path](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html) = empty pedestal; idol with method = reference that returns the hand.

## Status

**Approved** — image → admired person → *idolatrar* → media; [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-palavra-fruto.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of Portuguese **fruto** (lemma; Lat. *fructus*) — botanical fruit, everyday plural **frutos**, useful contrast with culinary **fruta**, and figurative **“frutos do trabalho”** (fruits of one’s labor). Closes with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html). Links: [plantas](/plantas/), [fruit hub](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-frutos), [simbiose](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-simbiose.html), [animal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-animal.html), [research · inputs × fruit](/posts/post-pesquisa-insumos-organicos-vs-industrializados-fruto.html).

> Method note: [Wiktionary · fruto](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/fruto), [Wikipedia · Fruto](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fruto), [fructus](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/fructus#Latin). Word sheet ≠ fruit-growing monograph — species sheets live in the [fruit hub](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-frutos).

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Lemma | **fruto** (covers plural **frutos**) |
| Etymon | Lat. *fructus* ← *fruī* “to enjoy / make use of” |
| Type | Botanical × everyday BR × figurative |
| Links | [plantas](/plantas/) · [simbiose](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-simbiose.html) · [animal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-animal.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Sample species | [Avocado](/posts/post-inspecao-planta-abacate.html) · [Banana](/posts/post-inspecao-planta-banana.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-03 |

## 2. Senses

Botanical organ · plural **frutos** · culinary **fruta** · figurative result of work · lab reading (time + care + living cast).

**H1:** Latin already held organ + profit.  
**H2:** BR **fruta** ≈ table; **fruto** ≈ botany + metaphor.  
**H3:** “Fruits of labor” without process becomes slogan.

## 3. Botany × table

Name the axis: lab criterion vs kitchen register. Sample anchors only — [avocado](/posts/post-inspecao-planta-abacate.html), [banana](/posts/post-inspecao-planta-banana.html). Quality map: [organic vs industrial inputs](/posts/post-pesquisa-insumos-organicos-vs-industrializados-fruto.html).

## 4. Figurative

**Frutos do trabalho** = matured result after effort. Pair with [caminho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html) / [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html). Trap: demand harvest without planting.

## 5. Valeu !!!

Best possible **with the fruit’s time**, today — rigor for the organ, warmth for the table, process for the metaphor.

## Status

**Approved** — lemma **fruto** · plural · botany × table × figurative · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-palavra-fruto.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **fruto** (lema; lat. *fructus*) — órgano botánico, plural **frutos**, contraste con **fruta** culinaria, y figurado **«frutos do trabalho»** (frutos del trabajo). Cierre: [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html). Vínculos: [plantas](/plantas/), [hub frutos](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-frutos), [simbiose](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-simbiose.html), [animal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-animal.html), [investigación · insumos × fruto](/posts/post-pesquisa-insumos-organicos-vs-industrializados-fruto.html).

> Nota: [Wikcionario · fruto](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/fruto), [Wikipedia · Fruto](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fruto), [fructus](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/fructus#Latin). Ficha de palabra ≠ monografía de fruticultura.

## 1. Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Lema | **fruto** (cubre el plural **frutos**) |
| Étimo | Lat. *fructus* ← *fruī* |
| Tipo | Botánica × cotidiano BR × figurado |
| Vínculos | [plantas](/plantas/) · [simbiose](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-simbiose.html) · [animal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-animal.html) · [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Muestra | [Aguacate](/posts/post-inspecao-planta-abacate.html) · [Banana](/posts/post-inspecao-planta-banana.html) |
| Fecha | 2026-08-03 |

## 2. Sentidos

Órgano botánico · plural · **fruta** de mesa · resultado del esfuerzo · lectura de lab (tiempo + cuidado).

## 3. Botánica × mesa

Nombrar el eje. Anclas: [aguacate](/posts/post-inspecao-planta-abacate.html), [banana](/posts/post-inspecao-planta-banana.html). Mapa de calidad: [insumos × fruto](/posts/post-pesquisa-insumos-organicos-vs-industrializados-fruto.html).

## 4. Figurado

**Frutos do trabalho** = resultado madurado. Par: [caminho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html) / [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html). Trampa: exigir cosecha sin sembrar.

## 5. ¡Valeu !!!

Lo mejor posible **con el tiempo del fruto**, hoy.

## Estado

**Aprobada** — lema **fruto** · plural · botánica × mesa × figurado · [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-palavra-inseto.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of **inseto** (lemma; plural **insetos** in body) — insects as life, ecology and culture in the BudGanja lab. Warm tone, not a dry entomology textbook. Links: [animal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-animal.html), [simbiose](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-simbiose.html), [Joaninha](/posts/post-inspecao-personagem-joaninha-joana.html), [bee](/posts/post-inspecao-animal-abelha.html), contrast [buguei](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-buguei.html), close [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Method note: [Insect (PT)](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inseto), [Insecta](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Insecta), [Wiktionary · inseto](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/inseto). Not a full taxonomic treatise.

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **inseto** · plural **insetos** |
| Etymon | Lat. *insectum* (“cut into” — segmented body) |
| Links | [animal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-animal.html) · [Joaninha](/posts/post-inspecao-personagem-joaninha-joana.html) · [bee](/posts/post-inspecao-animal-abelha.html) · [simbiose](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-simbiose.html) · [buguei](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-buguei.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-03 |

## Life & ecology

Insects pollinate ([bee](/posts/post-inspecao-animal-abelha.html)), control pests ([Joaninha](/posts/post-inspecao-personagem-joaninha-joana.html)), cycle soil, and sometimes become pests that need careful [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html). Good map = functions and diversity; bad map = “every bug is the enemy.”

## Culture

School word, garden talk, fear/disgust, and the *bug* metaphor → [buguei](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-buguei.html). Curiosity first; spray only with method.

## Valeu !!!

Keep **insetos** in the calculation — literacy, web of life, [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Status

**Approved** — inseto/insetos; ecology & culture; lab links; [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).
