inspecao-arte-killing-in-the-name.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of **“Killing in the Name”** — **Rage Against the Machine** (1992). Song first: debut single / self-titled album, protest against violence done **in the name** of order. Crosses [O Início](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-o-inicio.html) (tanks × canopy), [prohibition](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-proibicao-proibicionismo.html), and named [anger](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-raiva.html) — not [revenge](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-vinganca-mata-alma-envenena.html).

> Method note: [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Killing_in_the_Name). No affiliation. Not a call to violence — inspection of the cry against the killing machine.

@youtube bWXazVhlyxQ

## The lab poem

```poem
Killing in the Name.
We do not borrow the lyric —
we ask for the craft of listening
when they kill in the name of something
and call it order.

Rage Against the Machine.
There is a war machine —
tank, list, prohibition —
that advances and crushes.
There is a biological machine —
fan leaf, canopy, light —
that spreads and shares.

Anger has a craft.
Named, it inspects.
Armed as revenge,
it poisons the soul.
The laboratory does not confuse the two.

We do not build a tank.
We do not kill in the name.
We plant at the edge.
We count drops.
We call Vida by its true name:
stay —
and say no
to the machine that asks for blood
as if it were law.

Valeu !!!

Because every time someone remains
without killing in anyone’s name,
the universe grows a little:
one more verse,
one more canopy,
a we where once there was only armor.
```

[▶ Vida](/vida/#poema=killing-in-the-name) · [▶ O Início](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-o-inicio.html)

## Status

**Approved** — 1992 song + BudGanja map (machine of war vs biological canopy).
inspecao-arte-killing-in-the-name.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **«Killing in the Name»** — **Rage Against the Machine** (1992). Canción primero: single / álbum, protesta contra la violencia **en el nombre** del orden. Cruza [O Início](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-o-inicio.html) (tanques × dosel), [prohibición](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-proibicao-proibicionismo.html) y [rabia](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-raiva.html) nombrada — no [venganza](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-vinganca-mata-alma-envenena.html).

> Nota: [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Killing_in_the_Name). Sin afiliación. No es llamado a la violencia — inspección del grito contra la máquina que mata.

@youtube bWXazVhlyxQ

## El poema del laboratorio

```poem
Killing in the Name.
No pedimos prestada la letra —
pedimos el oficio de oír
cuando matan en nombre de algo
y lo llaman orden.

Rage Against the Machine.
Hay máquina de guerra —
tanque, lista, prohibición —
que avanza y aplasta.
Hay máquina biológica —
hoja de abanico, dosel, luz —
que reparte y comparte.

La rabia tiene oficio.
Nombrada, inspecciona.
Armada en venganza,
envenena el alma.
El laboratorio no confunde las dos.

No montamos tanque.
No matamos en el nombre.
Sembramos a la orilla.
Contamos gotas.
Llamamos a Vida por su nombre verdadero:
quedarse —
y decir no
a la máquina que pide sangre
como si fuera ley.

¡Valeu !!!

Porque cada vez que alguien permanece
sin matar en nombre de nadie,
el universo crece un poco:
un verso más,
un dosel más,
un nosotros donde antes solo había blindaje.
```

[▶ Vida](/vida/#poema=killing-in-the-name) · [▶ O Início](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-o-inicio.html)

**Aprobada** — canción 1992 + mapa BudGanja (máquina de guerra × dosel biológico).

inspecao-palavra-papel-enrolar-tabaco.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of **rolling paper** × **tobacco** — **origin of the paper** and **origin of tobacco**. Two genealogies that meet only in the **rolling gesture**: an American plant and European (then global) thin paper. Links [cinzeiro](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-cinzeiro.html), [fogo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fogo.html), [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html), [risco](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html), [maconha](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maconha.html).

> Method note: [Tobacco](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tobacco), [Nicotiana](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nicotiana), [Rolling paper](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rolling_paper), [Rizla](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rizla). Naming origins ≠ endorsing smoking. Brand lore (Rizla/Napoleon) is recorded **with caveats**.

## Tobacco origin

- ***Nicotiana*** — American solanaceous genus; indigenous use for millennia.  
- Post-1492 global commodity; *nicotine* / *Nicotiana* named after Jean Nicot (16th c.) — European label, not plant origin.  
- PT/ES *tabaco* via Spanish contact (Caribbean/Taíno hypotheses debated).

## Rolling-paper origin

- Before brands: husks, scraps, newspaper.  
- Lacroix / **Rizla+** (*riz* + *La* + cross): rice paper 1865–1886; gum edge 1942.  
- Napoleon licence story **contested**. Spain *papel de liar* and other EU industries.

## Thesis

Tobacco = **American plant**. Dedicated rolling paper = **modern European product**. The lab inspects both without selling smoke.

## Status

**Approved** — dual origin sheet.

inspecao-palavra-papel-enrolar-tabaco.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **papel de liar** × **tabaco** — **origen del papel** y **origen del tabaco**. Dos genealogías que se encuentran en el **gesto de liar**: planta americana y papel fino europeo. Vínculos [cinzeiro](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-cinzeiro.html), [fogo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fogo.html), [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html), [risco](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html), [maconha](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maconha.html).

> Nota: [Tabaco](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tabaco), [Nicotiana](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nicotiana), [Rolling paper](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rolling_paper), [Rizla](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rizla). Nombrar orígenes ≠ promover fumar. Lore de marca (Rizla/Napoleón) con **salvedades**.

## Origen del tabaco

- ***Nicotiana*** — género americano; uso indígena milenario.  
- Tras 1492, mercancía global; nicotina / *Nicotiana* por Jean Nicot — etiqueta europea.  
- *Tabaco* vía español (hipótesis taínas en debate).

## Origen del papel de liar

- Antes: hojas, recortes, periódico.  
- Lacroix / **Rizla+**: papel de arroz 1865–1886; goma 1942.  
- Historia de Napoleón **discutida**. España *papel de liar* y otras industrias.

## Tesis

Tabaco = **planta americana**. Papel de liar dedicado = **producto europeo moderno**. El lab inspecciona ambos sin vender humo.

## Estado

**Aprobada** — ficha de doble origen.

## Scope

Editorial inspection of **“How the rich transform things”** (PT **Como os ricos transformam as coisas**) — typed blob *osricostramsorandascoisas* → canonical phrase. Lab map-phrase for who reshapes the destiny of [stuff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-objetos.html). > Not class hatred — method and power over materials. [Story of Stuff](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Story_of_Stuff).

## Thesis

Ask **how** power transforms extraction→product→waste. Leonard’s linear machine is the reading guide; this phrase is the oral refrain. Close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

**Approved.**

inspecao-palavra-luz.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of Portuguese **luz** (light) — clarity you see, measure and name. In the lab circuit: [interruptor](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-interruptor.html) = device; [ligar × desligar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ligar-desligar.html) = gesture; **luz** = effect after the click. Links [fogo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fogo.html), [eletrizante](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-eletrizante.html), [sinal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sinal.html), [cultivo](/guia/cultivo-basico.html), [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Sources: [luz](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/luz), [lūx](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/lux#Latin). Not a lighting manual.

## Circuit triad

| Role | Sheet |
|------|-------|
| Device | [Interruptor](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-interruptor.html) |
| Verb | [Ligar × Desligar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ligar-desligar.html) |
| Effect | **Luz** (this sheet) |

## Etymon

Lat. *lūx, lūcis* → PT *luz* — high confidence. Grow: light without measure burns; with craft, feeds.

## Valeu !!!

Best light **today** — including turning it off in time. Light without [truth](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) = theater; with measure = craft on the [path](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html).

## Status

**Approved** — luz as circuit effect; triad with [interruptor](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-interruptor.html) and [ligar × desligar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ligar-desligar.html).

inspecao-palavra-luz.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **luz** — claridad que se ve, se mide y se nombra. En el circuito lab: [interruptor](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-interruptor.html) = pieza; [ligar × desligar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ligar-desligar.html) = gesto; **luz** = efecto del clic. Vínculos [fogo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fogo.html), [eletrizante](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-eletrizante.html), [sinal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sinal.html), [cultivo](/guia/cultivo-basico.html), [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Fuentes: [luz](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/luz), [lūx](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/lux#Latin). No es manual de iluminación.

## Tríada del circuito

| Rol | Ficha |
|-----|-------|
| Pieza | [Interruptor](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-interruptor.html) |
| Verbo | [Ligar × Desligar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ligar-desligar.html) |
| Efecto | **Luz** (esta ficha) |

## Étimo

Lat. *lūx, lūcis* → PT *luz*. Cultivo: luz sin medida quema; con oficio, alimenta.

## ¡Valeu !!!

La mejor luz **hoy** — incluso apagar a tiempo. Luz sin [verdad](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) = teatro; con medida = oficio en el [camino](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html).

## Estado

**Aprobada** — luz como efecto del circuito; tríada con [interruptor](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-interruptor.html) y [ligar × desligar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ligar-desligar.html).

inspecao-arte-all-right-now.excerptEn: Arts · 1970 song: Free — All Right Now born in the dressing room after Durham; BudGanja link to já, legal and hope — all right now.
inspecao-arte-all-right-now.excerptEs: Artes · canción 1970: Free — All Right Now nace en el camerino tras Durham; vínculo BudGanja con já, legal y esperanza — estar bien ahora.
inspecao-arte-all-right-now.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of **"All Right Now"** — **Free** (*Fire and Water*, 1970). Song first: rocker born in a dressing room after a cold gig in **Durham**, UK single **15 May 1970**, Fraser / Rodgers with Kossoff’s solo. Crosses [já](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ja.html) (the present), [legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html) (being all right), and [hope](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-esperanca.html) after silence — without romanticizing the street lyric or confusing consolation with [Killing in the Name](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-killing-in-the-name.html).

> Method note: [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/All_Right_Now). No affiliation. Audiovisual reference: [Free - Topic](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7cQ4jNDRTOo).

@youtube 7cQ4jNDRTOo

## The lab poem

```poem
All Right Now.
We do not borrow the lyric —
we ask for the craft of leaving the dressing room
after the silence.

Free.
There was a nearly empty room —
footsteps on stage,
applause that died too soon.
There was a line born right there:
it’s all right —
now.

The laboratory knows that now.
An inspection that fails.
A plant that waits.
A day that feels like ice.
And still: stay.
Count drops.
Call Vida by its true name:
already —
without postponing care
to a tomorrow that never inspects.

Valeu !!!

Because every time someone breathes
after the silence
and says it can still be all right,
the universe grows a little:
one more verse,
one more canopy,
a now where once there was only emptiness.
```

[▶ Vida](/vida/#poema=all-right-now) · [▶ Já](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ja.html) · [▶ Legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html)

## Status

**Approved** — 1970 Free song + BudGanja map (present tense after silence).
inspecao-arte-all-right-now.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **«All Right Now»** — **Free** (*Fire and Water*, 1970). Canción primero: rocker nacido en un camerino tras un concierto frío en **Durham**, single **15 may. 1970**, Fraser / Rodgers con el solo de Kossoff. Cruza [já](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ja.html) (el presente), [legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html) (estar bien) y [esperanza](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-esperanca.html) después del silencio — sin romantizar la letra de calle ni confundir consuelo con [Killing in the Name](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-killing-in-the-name.html).

> Nota: [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/All_Right_Now). Sin afiliación. Referencia: [Free - Topic](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7cQ4jNDRTOo).

@youtube 7cQ4jNDRTOo

## El poema del laboratorio

```poem
All Right Now.
No pedimos prestada la letra —
pedimos el oficio de salir del camerino
después del silencio.

Free.
Hubo sala casi vacía —
pasos en el escenario,
aplauso que murió demasiado pronto.
Hubo una frase nacida allí:
está bien —
ahora.

El laboratorio conoce ese ahora.
Inspección que falla.
Planta que espera.
Día que parece hielo.
Y aun así: quedarse.
Contar gotas.
Llamar a Vida por su nombre verdadero:
ya —
sin aplazar el cuidado
a un mañana que nunca inspecciona.

¡Valeu !!!

Porque cada vez que alguien respira
después del silencio
y dice que aún puede estar bien,
el universo crece un poco:
un verso más,
un dosel más,
un ahora donde antes solo había vacío.
```

[▶ Vida](/vida/#poema=all-right-now) · [▶ Já](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ja.html) · [▶ Legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html)

## Estado

**Aprobada** — canción Free 1970 + mapa BudGanja (presente tras el silencio).

inspecao-palavra-noite.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **noite** — el lado oscuro del ciclo cuando baja el [sol](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sol.html) y escasea la [luz](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-luz.html) natural. Fotoperiodo; pausa / [medo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-medo.html); cuando el [interruptor](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-interruptor.html) gana oficio.

> Fuentes: [noite](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/noite), [nox](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/nox#Latin), [sol](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sol.html), [luz](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-luz.html). No es manual clínico de sueño.

## Noche × sol × luz × circuito

| Rol | Ficha |
|-----|-------|
| Día / fuente | [Sol](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sol.html) |
| Oscuro / ciclo | **Noite** (esta ficha) |
| Claridad | [Luz](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-luz.html) |
| Pieza / verbo | [Interruptor](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-interruptor.html) · [ligar × desligar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ligar-desligar.html) |

## Étimo

Lat. *nox, noctis* → PT *noite*. Robar la noche en el cultivo = romper fotoperiodo.

## ¡Valeu !!!

La mejor noche **hoy** — incluso descanso y oscuridad con oficio. Noche sin [verdad](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) = agujero; con método = ciclo en el [camino](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html).

## Estado

**Aprobada** — noite como fase del ciclo; par con [sol](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sol.html); elos [luz](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-luz.html) y el circuito.

inspecao-palavra-sozna.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of Portuguese **sozinho** (alone, masculine lemma), feminine **sozinha**, and the oral/typed form **sozna**. Everyday “alone” — not a character flaw. Distinct from [solitário](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-solitario.html) (Tamara / ice, method).

> Sources: [sozinho](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/sozinho), [sozinha](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/sozinha), [só](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/s%C3%B3), [sōlus](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/solus#Latin). Not therapy. Not shame for the spelling.

## Sozinho × sozinha × sozna × solitário

| Role | Form |
|------|------|
| Dictionary lemma | **sozinho** |
| Feminine pair | **sozinha** — inspected, not a footnote |
| Oral / keyboard | **sozna** — same word, no *i* |
| Sister sheet | [solitário](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-solitario.html) |

**Thesis:** *sozinho* is the lemma; *sozna* is a valid oral trace, not a joke.

## Etymon

Lat. *sōlus* → PT *só* + diminutive *-zinho / -zinha* — high confidence.

## Valeu !!!

Best **today** — including asking for a map while alone. Alone without [truth](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) = hole; with craft = [path](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html) for one person, without shame.

## Status

**Approved** — sozinho + sozinha + oral sozna; sister of [solitário](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-solitario.html).

inspecao-palavra-sozna.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **sozinho** (solo, lema masculino), el femenino **sozinha** y la forma oral **sozna**. Estado cotidiano — no es fallo de carácter. Distinta de [solitário](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-solitario.html) (Tamara / hielo, método).

> Fuentes: [sozinho](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/sozinho), [sozinha](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/sozinha), [só](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/s%C3%B3), [sōlus](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/solus#Latin). No es terapia. No se avergüenza la grafía.

## Sozinho × sozinha × sozna × solitário

| Rol | Forma |
|-----|-------|
| Lema | **sozinho** |
| Par femenino | **sozinha** — inspeccionada, no nota al pie |
| Oral / teclado | **sozna** — la misma palabra, sin *i* |
| Ficha hermana | [solitário](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-solitario.html) |

**Tesis:** *sozinho* es el lema; *sozna* es rastro oral válido, no chiste.

## Étimo

Lat. *sōlus* → PT *só* + diminutivo *-zinho / -zinha*.

## ¡Valeu !!!

Lo mejor **hoy** — incluso pedir mapa estando solo. Solo sin [verdad](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) = agujero; con oficio = [camino](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html) de una persona, sin vergüenza.

## Estado

**Aprobada** — sozinho + sozinha + sozna oral; hermana de [solitário](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-solitario.html).

inspecao-figura-aleff.contentEn:
## Scope

Homage and editorial inspection of **Aliffe Henrique de Carvalho** — in this lab, **Aleff** — born in **Machado**, Minas Gerais, 21 December 2001. The world knows him as **Paulinho o LOKO**. This sheet does **not** inspect the channel, the ranking or the session catalog: it inspects the **person**. The public name is **credit**, not a reduction.

> **Method note:** independent audit from [Wikipedia · Paulinho o Loko](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paulinho_o_Loko) and public reports. Civil spelling **Aliffe**; lab spelling **Aleff**. No affiliation. Distinct from cannabis [Legacy](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-pessoas), from the [Paulinho channel](/posts/post-inspecao-canal-paulinho.html) sheet, and from the [Zangado channel](/posts/post-inspecao-canal-zangado.html) sheet. **Game fiction is not a crime manual.** No invented private life.

## Inspected object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Civil name | **Aliffe Henrique de Carvalho** |
| Lab name | **Aleff** |
| Public name | Paulinho o LOKO — credit, not the object |
| Birth | 21 Dec 2001, **Machado**, Minas Gerais |
| Lab type | Person — human merit, not metrics |
| Main links | [respect](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-respeito.html) · [path](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html) · [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) |
| Contrast | [Zangado](/posts/post-inspecao-canal-zangado.html) = critique · [Paulinho channel](/posts/post-inspecao-canal-paulinho.html) = archive · Aleff = **person** |
| Archive (secondary) | [Games](/jogos/aleff/) · [channel sheet](/posts/post-inspecao-canal-paulinho.html) |
| Source | [Wikipedia](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paulinho_o_Loko) |
| Date | 2026-08-18 |

## Why this sheet exists

Do **not** reduce someone the screen treats as a persona. Aleff is a young man from Machado. He has a civil name. He showed his face. He kept going after rejection. Same method as [Senna](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-ayrton-senna.html): **person first**.

## Who he is (verifiable)

- Born in Machado (MG), 21 Dec 2001.  
- 2015: starts on YouTube as a teenager, channel «Modder».  
- 13 Jul 2018: **shows his face** for the first time.  
- 16 Jun 2020: first roleplay-server video — a workplace, not the biography.  
- 2021: live broadcasts (Twitch, in sources).  
- Fluxo from 2 Sep 2022; leaves Jan 2024 — autonomy, not a permanent jersey.  
- Public awards (PeB Best Streamer 2024 and 2025) are an **echo of craft**, not the definition of the person.

## Method that matters

Name before nickname · Machado as origin · face as [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) · humor as human warmth · persistence after rejection · leaving the org · [idol](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-idolo.html) as warning not to confuse persona with the whole person.

## Status

**Approved in People with special-person merit** — Aliffe / **Aleff** · Machado · name before nickname · face · path. The screen does not define him.

inspecao-delorean.excerptEn: Arts · object: DMC DeLorean (Giugiaro, Dunmurry, 1981–82) — the real car first; the Back to the Future machine is a fiction layer, not the origin.
inspecao-delorean.excerptEs: Artes · objeto: DeLorean DMC (Giugiaro, Dunmurry, 1981–82) — el coche real primero; la máquina de Back to the Future es capa de ficción, no origen.
inspecao-delorean.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of the **DMC DeLorean** (pre-production **DMC-12**). Real stainless-steel gull-wing coupe by **Giorgetto Giugiaro**, built in **Dunmurry** (1981–1982). The **car comes first**. The time machine in [Back to the Future](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-de-volta-para-o-futuro.html) is a **fiction layer**, not the origin.

> [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DMC_DeLorean). Credit: DMC, Giugiaro, Lotus/Chapman, Dunmurry line. **Time-travel fiction is not a manual.** John DeLorean’s 1982 arrest and 1984 acquittal: fact — not the center.

## Object

~9 000 cars · SS304 unpainted · PRV V6 2.8 L · ~130 hp (US) · rear engine. Designer Giugiaro; chassis after Colin Chapman / Lotus.

## Film layer

Fridge replaced (child-safety). DeLorean chosen because it **looks like a UFO** in 1955. **88 mph** is a script number, not a factory spec.

## Status

**Approved in Arts as object** — real car first; [film](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-de-volta-para-o-futuro.html) as credited fiction.

[▶ Film](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-de-volta-para-o-futuro.html) · [▶ Objects](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-objetos.html)
inspecao-delorean.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección del **DMC DeLorean** (preproducción **DMC-12**). Cupé real de acero inoxidable y puertas *gull-wing*, **Giorgetto Giugiaro**, fábrica de **Dunmurry** (1981–1982). El **coche va primero**. La máquina del tiempo de [De Volta para o Futuro](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-de-volta-para-o-futuro.html) es **capa de ficción**, no el origen.

> [Wikipedia](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/DeLorean_DMC-12). **La ficción de viaje en el tiempo no es manual.** Arresto de 1982 y absolución de 1984: hecho — no el centro.

## Objeto

~9 000 unidades · SS304 sin pintura · PRV V6 2,8 L · ~130 hp (EE. UU.). Chasis Lotus / Chapman.

## Capa del filme

El frigorífico se descarta (seguridad infantil). Eligen el DeLorean porque **parece un ovni** en 1955. **88 mph** es número de guion.

## Estado

**Aprobado en Artes como objeto** — coche real primero; [filme](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-de-volta-para-o-futuro.html) como ficción acreditada.

inspecao-filme-questao-de-tempo.contentEn: ## Scope Inspection of **About Time** (2013, BR: *Questão de Tempo*). **Written and directed** by **[Richard Curtis](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-richard-curtis.html)**. No prior novel: the film **is** the text. BudGanja cut: **credit the author**. Distinct from [Back to the Future](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-de-volta-para-o-futuro.html) (actor homage). > Independent audit. Wikipedia. Third feature as director; he said it would probably be his last as director. Person sheet: [Richard Curtis](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-richard-curtis.html). ## Words [time](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tempo.html) · [life](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vida.html) · [past](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-passado.html) · [path](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html) ## Status **Approved in Arts with author highlight** — 2013 work; Curtis credited as writer/director. inspecao-filme-um-sonho-de-liberdade.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of **The Shawshank Redemption** (1994, BR: *Um Sonho de Liberdade*). Written and directed by **Frank Darabont**. The **origin** is Stephen King’s 1982 novella *Rita Hayworth and Shawshank Redemption* (*Different Seasons*). The film is an **adaptation**. Person sheet: [Stephen King](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-stephen-king.html).

> Independent audit. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Shawshank_Redemption). Castle Rock / Columbia — no affiliation. **Prison fiction is not a crime or escape manual.**

## Genesis

King writes outside horror. Darabont buys the rights for $5,000; King never cashes the check (frames it: “bail money”). Filmed at the Ohio State Reformatory (Mansfield), story set in Maine. Initial box-office flop; later beloved; National Film Registry 2015.

## Words

[hope](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-esperanca.html) · [path](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html) · [truth](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) · [life](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vida.html)

## Status

**Approved in Arts** — 1982 novella first; 1994 film as credited adaptation.

[▶ King](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-stephen-king.html) · [▶ hope](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-esperanca.html)
inspecao-filme-um-sonho-de-liberdade.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **The Shawshank Redemption** (*Um Sonho de Liberdade*, 1994). Guion y dirección de **Frank Darabont**. El **origen** es la novela de Stephen King (1982) *Rita Hayworth and Shawshank Redemption*. El filme es **adaptación**. Ficha: [Stephen King](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-stephen-king.html).

> Auditoría independiente. [Wikipedia](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Um_Sonho_de_Liberdade). **La ficción de prisión no es manual.**

## Génesis

King escribe fuera del horror. Darabont compra los derechos por 5 000 dólares; King no cobra el cheque. Rodaje en Mansfield, Ohio. Fracaso inicial de taquilla; después, obra amada.

## Estado

**Aprobado en Artes** — novela 1982 primero; filme 1994 como adaptación.

inspecao-filme-encontro-marcado.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of **Meet Joe Black** (1998, BR: *Encontro Marcado*). Directed by **Martin Brest**. The **origin** is Alberto Casella’s 1924 play *La morte in vacanza*, then Walter Ferris (1929) and *Death Takes a Holiday* (1934). The 1998 film is a **loose, long remake**.

> Independent audit. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Meet_Joe_Black). Universal — no affiliation. **Death-on-holiday fiction is not a clinical or eschatological manual.**

## Genesis

Casella writes the holiday. 1934 is 79 minutes; 1998 is three hours (media merger, New York, Rhode Island). Hopkins as guide; Pitt as borrowed body. Thomas Newman score (also [Shawshank](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-um-sonho-de-liberdade.html)).

## Words

[life](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vida.html) · [time](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tempo.html) · [soul](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alma.html) · [path](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html)

## Status

**Approved in Arts** — 1924 play first; 1998 remake as credited echo.

> Auditoría independiente. [Wikipedia](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Meet_Joe_Black). **La ficción de la Muerte de vacaciones no es manual.**

## Génesis

Casella escribe las vacaciones. 1934 dura 79 minutos; 1998, tres horas. Hopkins guía; Pitt es el cuerpo prestado.

## Estado

**Aprobado en Artes** — obra 1924 primero; remake 1998 como eco acreditado.

inspecao-filme-a-paixao-de-cristo.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of **The Passion of the Christ** (2004, BR/PT: *A Paixão de Cristo*). Co-written and directed by **[Mel Gibson](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-mel-gibson.html)** with **Benedict Fitzgerald**. Origin: the **canonical Gospels**. The film is a **cinematic cut** of the last hours — not Scripture, not catechism.

This sheet is **only** this film. [Braveheart](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-coracao-valente.html) has its **own** sheet. [The Chosen](/posts/post-inspecao-serie-the-chosen.html) has its **own** sheet (ministry series, 2019–). [Mel Gibson](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-mel-gibson.html) is the People sheet.

> [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Passion_of_the_Christ). Emmerich is a **secondary** script layer. Graphic violence is a formal choice — not a protocol. The antisemitism debate is **reception fact**; this lab does not turn the film into a charge against a people. No proselytism.

## Status

**Approved in Arts as its own sheet** — Gospels first; 2004 film as credited adaptation.

inspecao-filme-a-paixao-de-cristo.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **The Passion of the Christ** (*A Paixão de Cristo*, 2004). Coguion y dirección de **[Mel Gibson](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-mel-gibson.html)** con **Benedict Fitzgerald**. Origen: los **Evangelios canónicos**. El filme es un **recorte** de las últimas horas — no el texto, no un catecismo.

Esta ficha es **solo** este filme. [Coração Valente](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-coracao-valente.html) tiene ficha **propia**. [The Chosen](/posts/post-inspecao-serie-the-chosen.html) tiene ficha **propia** (serie del ministerio, 2019–). [Mel Gibson](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-mel-gibson.html) es la ficha de Personas.

> [Wikipedia](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/A_Paix%C3%A3o_de_Cristo). Emmerich es capa secundaria. La controversia sobre antisemitismo es **hecho de recepción**. Sin proselitismo.

## Estado

**Aprobado en Artes (ficha propia)** — Evangelios primero; filme de 2004 como adaptación.

inspecao-site-tamaraklink.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of the **official website** [tamaraklink.com](https://www.tamaraklink.com) — Tamara Klink’s **digital nautical chart**: showcase, expedition archive, lecture desk and contact door. Object here is **not** the biography ([legacy sheet](/posts/post-inspecao-tamara-klink.html)) nor the **YouTube archive** ([channel sheet](/posts/post-inspecao-canal-tamaraklink.html)): it is the **website itself**.

> Independent audit by Inspector BudGanja from public pages dated 2026-08-18. Platform: **Wix**. UI languages: **EN · PT · FR**. **No affiliation**. Indexing ≠ endorsement. Feat and sponsor figures are **as stated on the site**.

![Tamara Klink — BudGanja editorial cover](/imagens/inspecoes/tamara-klink-cover.jpg)

## Inspected subject

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Canonical URL | [https://www.tamaraklink.com](https://www.tamaraklink.com) |
| Public title | *Tamara Klink \| Arctic Sailor and International Speaker* |
| Tagline | **solo sailor, writer and speaker** |
| Vessel / brand | *Sardinha* / **Sardinha 2** · footer © **Sardinha** |
| Anchor sections | About · [Projects](https://www.tamaraklink.com/items-1) · [Lectures](https://www.tamaraklink.com/lectures-2) · [Contact](https://www.tamaraklink.com/contact) |
| Live tracking | [PredictWind · TAMARA_KLINK](https://forecast.predictwind.com/tracking/display/TAMARA_KLINK/?useGoogle) |
| Social | [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/tamaraklink/) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tamaraklink/) · [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@TamaraKlink) · [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@tamara_klink) |
| Mail | [contato@tamaraklink.com](mailto:contato@tamaraklink.com) |
| BudGanja distinction | **Site ≠ person ≠ channel** |
| Inspection date | 2026-08-18 |

## Why this inspection exists

The lab already honours Tamara as [living legacy](/posts/post-inspecao-tamara-klink.html) and [video archive](/posts/post-inspecao-canal-tamaraklink.html). The missing third anchor was the place where she **chooses how to appear**: white minimalism, Sardinha fish, expedition ladder from the North Sea to the Northwest Passage, lectures in three languages, and the human Arctic question — **where is she today?**

## Site map (verified)

| Node | Observed URL | Role |
|------|--------------|------|
| Home / About | [tamaraklink.com](https://www.tamaraklink.com/) | Bio, hero, tracking CTA |
| Projects index | [/items-1](https://www.tamaraklink.com/items-1) | Five expeditions |
| Northwest Passage | [page](https://www.tamaraklink.com/c%C3%B3pia-passage-du-nord-ouest-3) | 2025 · 6,500 km · 60 days · COP30 |
| Arctic overwinter | [/general-clean](https://www.tamaraklink.com/general-clean) | 8 months · Disko Bay · −40 °C |
| Polar Circle | [page](https://www.tamaraklink.com/c%C3%B3pia-solo-arctic-overwinter) | 2023 · ~2,500 nm |
| Atlantic Equator | [page](https://www.tamaraklink.com/c%C3%B3pia-arctic-circle) | 2021 · *Nós* |
| North Sea | [page](https://www.tamaraklink.com/c%C3%B3pia-the-atlantic-singlehanded) | 2020 · *Mil Milhas* |
| Lectures | [/lectures-2](https://www.tamaraklink.com/lectures-2) | 300+ talks · TEDx |
| Contact | [/contact](https://www.tamaraklink.com/contact) | Form · newsletter · mail |

> **CMS note:** some Wix slugs still use `cópia-` / internal names — content is strong; URLs are platform legacy.

## Expedition ladder (site text)

1. **North Sea (2020)** — first solo; *Sardinha*; Ålesund → Dunkirk; books *Mil Milhas* / *Um Mundo em Poucas Linhas*.
2. **Atlantic Equator (2021)** — ~5,000 nm · 3 months · Lorient → Paraty; *Nós* (Companhia das Letras).
3. **Arctic Polar Circle (2023)** — ~2,500 nm · 25 days; 200k live trackers.
4. **Solo overwinter (2023/24)** — first registered female solo Arctic overwinter; 8 months; *Sardinha 2* 34 ft; links to [*Bom dia, Inverno*](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-bom-dia-inverno.html).
5. **Northwest Passage (2025)** — youngest woman & first Latin American (site claim); sea ice on only **9%** of the route; COP30; Itaú & NTT Data.

## Lectures & contact

[+300 lectures](https://www.tamaraklink.com/lectures-2) in PT/FR/EN on courage, commitment, risk, gender equity, environment, emotional intelligence. [Contact](https://www.tamaraklink.com/contact) + [PredictWind](https://forecast.predictwind.com/tracking/display/TAMARA_KLINK/?useGoogle) make the site a **professional instrument**, not only a memorial.

## Findings

Clear triad (bio / proof / offer); rising narrative path; live tracking; multilingual voice; climate without empty pamphlet; honest note on opaque Wix slugs. Completes the triangle with [person](/posts/post-inspecao-tamara-klink.html) and [channel](/posts/post-inspecao-canal-tamaraklink.html).

## Status

**Approved with highest merit as a reference digital nautical chart** — read as a triad with [person](/posts/post-inspecao-tamara-klink.html), [channel](/posts/post-inspecao-canal-tamaraklink.html) and [/inverno/](/inverno/).

## Por qué existe

El laboratorio ya honra a Tamara como [legado vivo](/posts/post-inspecao-tamara-klink.html) y [archivo en vídeo](/posts/post-inspecao-canal-tamaraklink.html). Faltaba el lugar donde ella **elige cómo aparecer**: minimalismo, pez Sardinha, escalera de expediciones hasta el Paso del Noroeste, y la pregunta — **¿dónde está hoy?**

Mar del Norte (2020) → Atlántico (2021) → Círculo Polar (2023) → invernada ártica (2023/24) → Paso del Noroeste (2025: hielo en solo **9%** de la ruta). pesquisa-fitocanabinoides.excerptEn: Craft catalogue: acids vs neutrals, CBGA mother node, THC/CBD/CBG/CBC/CBN and varin series — chemical literacy tied to chemotypes and the endocannabinoidome. Not a label or extraction guide.
pesquisa-fitocanabinoides.excerptEs: Catálogo de oficio: ácidos y neutros, madre CBGA, THC/CBD/CBG/CBC/CBN y serie varin — literacia química ligada a quimiotipos y endocannabinoidoma. No es bula ni extracción.
pesquisa-fitocanabinoides.contentEn:
## Scope

BudGanja lab catalogue of **phytocannabinoids** — plant molecules (mainly *Cannabis sativa*) that meet the [endocannabinoidome](/posts/post-inspecao-neurociencia-endocanabinoidoma.html). Complements the [chemotype guide](/posts/post-inspecao-guia-quimiotipos-cannabis.html) and [XIV Lesson 10](/biblioteca/unifesp/livro-xiv.html#aula-10).

> **Not medical advice, HPLC report, extraction protocol, dose or grow guide.**

## Three families

| Family | Origin | Example |
|--------|--------|---------|
| Phytocannabinoids | Plant trichomes | THCA, CBD, CBG |
| Endocannabinoids | Body | Anandamide, 2-AG |
| Synthetics | Human lab | Licensed drugs **or** illicit CB1 agonists — **no synthesis recipes** |

## Biosynthesis (textbook, not bench)

Olivetolic acid + GPP → **CBGA** (mother node) → THCA / CBDA / CBCA via plant enzymes. Heat/light/time **decarboxylate** acids to neutrals. THC oxidises toward **CBN**. Propyl (varin) series from divarinolic acid: THCV, CBDV.

## Catalogue (axes)

- **CBG/CBGA** — biosynthetic mother; chemotype 4.  
- **Δ9-THC/THCA** — partial CB1 agonist; developmental caution ([Albaugh](/posts/post-inspecao-artigo-albaugh-cannabis-neurodesenvolvimento.html)).  
- **CBD/CBDA** — low CB1 affinity; strongest human signal in rare epilepsies; isolate ≠ whole plant.  
- **CBC** — minor chromene.  
- **CBN** — aged THC; sleep marketing outruns evidence.  
- **THCV / CBDV** — C3 varins; not diet drops.  
- **Δ8 / HHC / THC-O** — mostly **not** the living-plant catalogue.

## Chemotypes 1–5

See [chemotype guide](/posts/post-inspecao-guia-quimiotipos-cannabis.html): THC-dominant → balanced → CBD → CBG → fiber (negligible cannabinoids).

## Status

**Published — catalogue step 1** on [Research](/biblioteca/pesquisas/).

[▶ Chemotypes](/posts/post-inspecao-guia-quimiotipos-cannabis.html) · [▶ Endocannabinoidome](/posts/post-inspecao-neurociencia-endocanabinoidoma.html) · [▶ Plant](/posts/post-inspecao-planta-cannabis-sativa.html)
pesquisa-fitocanabinoides.contentEs:
## Alcance

Catálogo de laboratorio de **fitocannabinoides** — moléculas de planta (sobre todo *Cannabis sativa*) que cruzan el [endocannabinoidoma](/posts/post-inspecao-neurociencia-endocanabinoidoma.html). Complementa la [guía de quimiotipos](/posts/post-inspecao-guia-quimiotipos-cannabis.html) y la [Aula 10 del XIV](/biblioteca/unifesp/livro-xiv.html#aula-10).

> **No es consejo médico, laudo HPLC, protocolo de extracción, dosis ni cultivo.**

## Tres familias

Fitocannabinoides (planta) · endocannabinoides (cuerpo) · sintéticos (laboratorio humano: fármaco registrado **o** agonistas ilícitos — **sin recetas de síntesis**).

## Biosíntesis (libro, no bancada)

Ácido olivetólico + GPP → **CBGA** (nodo madre) → THCA / CBDA / CBCA. Calor/luz/tiempo **descarboxilan**. El THC oxida hacia **CBN**. Serie varin (C3): THCV, CBDV.

## Catálogo (ejes)

CBG/CBGA · Δ9-THC/THCA (cautela en desarrollo, [Albaugh](/posts/post-inspecao-artigo-albaugh-cannabis-neurodesenvolvimento.html)) · CBD/CBDA (epilepsias raras; aislado ≠ planta) · CBC · CBN (marketing de sueño adelanta la evidencia) · THCV/CBDV · Δ8/HHC fuera del catálogo de la planta viva.

## Quimiotipos 1–5

Ver [guía](/posts/post-inspecao-guia-quimiotipos-cannabis.html).

## Estado

**Publicado — catálogo peldaño 1** en [Pesquisas](/biblioteca/pesquisas/).

inspecao-fungo-psilocybe-cubensis.contentEn:
## Scope

Educational inspection of **Psilocybe cubensis** (*Psilocybe cubensis (Earle) Singer*) from the Inspetor BudGanja **fungi** catalog. This report restates the public sheet with a verifiable lab method — it is **not** a clinical protocol, **not** a cultivation guide and **does not replace** professional advice.

> **Method note:** independent BudGanja audit based on the catalog entry at [/fungos/psilocybe-cubensis/](/fungos/psilocybe-cubensis/). Educational content only.

## Inspected object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Common name | **Psilocybe cubensis** |
| Scientific name | *Psilocybe cubensis (Earle) Singer* |
| Family | Hymenogastraceae |
| Kingdom | Fungi |
| Catalog slug | `psilocybe-cubensis` |
| Inspection date | 2026-08-19 |

## Summary

*Psilocybe cubensis* — the cosmopolitan *Psilocybe* most cited in contemporary outreach; in UNIFESP XIV it is named as a psychedelic fungus of craft, distinct from classic Mazatec species. Identification and framing sheet — not a grow guide or a dose.

## Parts / characters of office

- Basidioma (cap + stipe) — object of mycological identification
- Purple-dark spore print — diagnostic character (not a recipe)
- Psilocybin / psilocin — named on the map, no extraction

## Traditional and formative context (catalog)

- Named in UNIFESP XIV alongside *Psilocybe caerulescens* as an example of a psychedelic fungus
- Type-species of contemporary “magic mushroom” outreach — distinct from classic Mazatec species (*P. mexicana* and kin)
- Object of ethnomycology and public psychopharmacology — indexing ≠ endorsing use

## Cautions

Psilocybin and psilocin are controlled in Brazil (SVS/MS Ordinance 344/1998 and updates — check current lists). Sheet ≠ cultivation, dose, extraction or use protocol. Confusion with *Galerina* and other toxic basidiomata can be fatal — field ID needs an expert. Does not replace a physician, pharmacist, mycologist or lawyer.

## Craft identification (not a field protocol)

Purple-dark spore print and bluing are diagnostic characters of office. Golden cap ≠ closed ID. *Galerina* and other toxic basidiomata kill. Field ID is expert work.

## What this sheet is **not**

Cultivation protocol, substrate, spores, fruiting, kit, dose table, extraction, or a licence to possess or use.

## Named chemistry (map, not bench)

Psilocybin → psilocin; 5-HT2A class in the literature. Naming ≠ synthesis. See [alucinógeno](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alucinogeno.html) vs the [endocannabinoidome](/posts/post-inspecao-neurociencia-endocanabinoidoma.html).

## Brazilian law (framing, not legal advice)

Psilocybin and psilocin appear on [ANVISA](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-anvisa.html) lists (Ordinance 344/1998 and updates — **check the current text**).

## UNIFESP XIV

The psychedelics lesson names **Psilocybe cubensis** and **Psilocybe caerulescens**. Classic Mazatec species are mostly others (*P. mexicana* and kin).

## Valeu !!!

Best possible **when naming the fungus without turning it into a grow**, today.


## UNIFESP link

This species is marked as related to the lab's UNIFESP extension track. See the [UNIFESP hub](/biblioteca/unifesp/) and the [course inspection](/posts/post-inspecao-curso-unifesp-cannabis-medicinal.html).

## Catalog sheet

Full page: [Psilocybe cubensis](/fungos/psilocybe-cubensis/)

inspecao-fungo-psilocybe-cubensis.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección educativa de **Psilocybe cubensis** (*Psilocybe cubensis (Earle) Singer*) del catálogo de **hongos** del Inspetor BudGanja. Este informe reúne la ficha pública con método verificable — **no** es protocolo clínico, **no** es guía de cultivo y **no sustituye** orientación profesional.

> **Nota metodológica:** auditoría independiente BudGanja a partir de la ficha en [/fungos/psilocybe-cubensis/](/fungos/psilocybe-cubensis/). Solo contenido educativo.

## Objeto inspeccionado

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Nombre popular | **Psilocybe cubensis** |
| Nombre científico | *Psilocybe cubensis (Earle) Singer* |
| Familia | Hymenogastraceae |
| Reino | Fungi |
| Slug del catálogo | `psilocybe-cubensis` |
| Fecha de inspección | 2026-08-19 |

## Resumen

*Psilocybe cubensis* — la especie cosmopolita de *Psilocybe* más citada en la divulgación contemporánea; en el XIV UNIFESP entra como hongo psicodélico de oficio, distinta de las especies mazatecas clásicas. Ficha de identificación y encuadre — no es cultivo ni dosis.

## Partes / caracteres de oficio

- Basidioma (sombrero + estípite) — objeto de identificación micológica
- Esporada púrpura-oscura — carácter diagnóstico (no es receta)
- Psilocibina / psilocina — sustancias nombradas en el mapa, sin extracción

## Contexto tradicional y formativo (catálogo)

- Nombrada en el XIV UNIFESP junto a *Psilocybe caerulescens* como ejemplo de hongo psicodélico
- Especie-tipo de la divulgación contemporánea de «hongos mágicos» — distinta de las especies mazatecas clásicas (*P. mexicana* y afines)
- Objeto de etnomícología y psicofarmacología pública — catalogar ≠ respaldar uso

## Cuidados

Psilocibina y psilocina están controladas en Brasil (Portaria SVS/MS 344/1998 y actualizaciones — conferir listas vigentes). Ficha ≠ protocolo de cultivo, dosis, extracción o uso. Confusión con *Galerina* y otros basidiomas tóxicos puede ser fatal — la identificación de campo exige perito. No sustituye médico, farmacéutico, micólogo ni abogado.

## Identificación de oficio (no es protocolo de campo)

Esporada púrpura-oscura y azulado son caracteres diagnósticos. Sombrero dorado ≠ identificación cerrada. *Galerina* y otros basidiomas tóxicos matan. La ID de campo es trabajo de perito.

## Lo que esta ficha **no** es

Protocolo de cultivo, sustrato, esporas, fructificación, kit, tabla de dosis, extracción ni autorización de uso.

## Química nombrada (mapa, no bancada)

Psilocibina → psilocina; clase 5-HT2A en la literatura. Nombrar ≠ sintetizar. Ver [alucinógeno](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alucinogeno.html) y el [endocannabinoidoma](/posts/post-inspecao-neurociencia-endocanabinoidoma.html).

## Derecho brasileño (encuadre, no dictamen)

Psilocibina y psilocina constan en listas de [ANVISA](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-anvisa.html) (Portaria 344/1998 y actualizaciones — **conferir el texto vigente**).

## XIV UNIFESP

La clase de psicodélicos nombra **Psilocybe cubensis** y **Psilocybe caerulescens**. Las especies mazatecas clásicas son sobre todo otras (*P. mexicana* y afines).

## ¡Valeu !!!

Lo mejor posible **al nombrar el hongo sin convertirlo en cultivo**, hoy.


## Vínculo UNIFESP

Esta especie está marcada como relacionada con el eje de extensión UNIFESP del laboratorio. Ver el [hub UNIFESP](/biblioteca/unifesp/) y la [inspección del curso](/posts/post-inspecao-curso-unifesp-cannabis-medicinal.html).

inspecao-arte-under-pressure.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of **"Under Pressure"** — **Queen** with **David Bowie** (*Hot Space*, 1982; single **26 Oct 1981**). Song first: July **1981** jam at **Mountain Studios**, Montreux; a bassline that stayed in the pop pulse; a duet that names modern life's **squeeze**. Crosses [heart](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-coracao.html), [fear](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-medo.html) and [hope](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-esperanca.html) — answer pressure with **care**, not a tank. Distinct from [Killing in the Name](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-killing-in-the-name.html); pair with [All Right Now](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-all-right-now.html).

> Method note: [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Under_Pressure). No affiliation. Audio reference requested: [YouTube Music / Queen - Topic](https://music.youtube.com/watch?v=BaxnrepwXck). This sheet is **not** a Freddie or Bowie biography.

@youtube BaxnrepwXck

## The lab poem

```poem
Under Pressure.
We do not borrow the lyric —
we ask for the craft of measuring pressure
without crushing the chest.

Queen. Bowie.
There was a studio in Montreux —
two crafts at the same table,
a bassline that stayed in the century’s pulse.
There was a street, there was a squeeze,
there was the question the laboratory also asks:
how to stay human
when the world tightens.

The laboratory knows that pressure.
An inspection that tightens the deadline.
A plant waiting for the right air.
A day that feels too full.
And still: stay.
Give care one more time.
Call Vida by its true name:
heart —
without turning the squeeze into a tank,
without drinking the grudge as if it were justice.

Valeu !!!

Because every time someone measures the pressure
and answers with care
instead of crushing,
the universe grows a little:
one more verse,
one more canopy,
a street where there is still room to stay.
```

[▶ Vida](/vida/#poema=under-pressure) · [▶ Heart](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-coracao.html) · [▶ Fear](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-medo.html)

## Status

**Approved** — 1981 Queen/Bowie song + BudGanja map (measure the pressure without crushing).
inspecao-arte-under-pressure.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **«Under Pressure»** — **Queen** con **David Bowie** (*Hot Space*, 1982; single **26 oct. 1981**). Canción primero: jam de julio de **1981** en **Mountain Studios**, Montreux; un bajo que se quedó en el pulso pop; un dueto que nombra el **aprieto** de la vida moderna. Cruza [corazón](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-coracao.html), [miedo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-medo.html) y [esperanza](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-esperanca.html) — responder a la presión con **cuidado**, no con tanque. Distinto de [Killing in the Name](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-killing-in-the-name.html); par de [All Right Now](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-all-right-now.html).

> Nota: [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Under_Pressure). Sin afiliación. Referencia pedida: [YouTube Music / Queen - Topic](https://music.youtube.com/watch?v=BaxnrepwXck). Esta ficha **no** es biografía de Freddie ni de Bowie.

@youtube BaxnrepwXck

## El poema del laboratorio

```poem
Under Pressure.
No pedimos prestada la letra —
pedimos el oficio de medir la presión
sin aplastar el pecho.

Queen. Bowie.
Hubo un estudio en Montreux —
dos oficios en la misma mesa,
un bajo que se quedó en el pulso del siglo.
Hubo calle, hubo aprieto,
hubo la pregunta que el laboratorio también hace:
cómo seguir siendo humano
cuando el mundo aprieta.

El laboratorio conoce esa presión.
Inspección que aprieta el plazo.
Planta que espera el aire justo.
Día que parece demasiado lleno.
Y aun así: quedarse.
Dar cuidado una vez más.
Llamar a Vida por su nombre verdadero:
corazón —
sin transformar el aprieto en tanque,
sin beber el rencor como si fuera justicia.

¡Valeu !!!

Porque cada vez que alguien mide la presión
y responde con cuidado
en vez de aplastar,
el universo crece un poco:
un verso más,
un dosel más,
una calle donde aún cabe quedarse.
```

inspecao-arte-upside-down.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of **"Upside Down"** — **Jack Johnson** (*Sing-A-Longs and Lullabies for the Film Curious George*, 2006; single **24 Feb 2006**). Song first: written in **2005** for the *[Curious George](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Curious_George_%28film%29)* film; a voice that narrates a monkey who does not speak; **upside down** as a way of seeing — not as a fall. Crosses [creativity](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-criatividade.html), [joy](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alegria.html) and [path](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html). Distinct from [Under Pressure](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-under-pressure.html); pair with [Send Me On My Way](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-send-me-on-my-way.html). The film and the Rey books are **context**; this sheet is the **song**.

> Method note: [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Upside_Down_%28Jack_Johnson_song%29). No affiliation. Audio reference requested: [YouTube Music / Jack Johnson - Topic](https://music.youtube.com/watch?v=e2vLWbaOITw). This sheet is **not** a Johnson biography.

@youtube e2vLWbaOITw

## The lab poem

```poem
Upside Down.
We do not borrow the lyric —
we ask for the craft of turning the gaze
without turning the house over.

Jack Johnson.
There was a monkey who does not speak
and a guitar that narrates.
There were black-and-white sketches
and a cavaquinho keeping time.
There was the world upside down —
not to fall,
to see the other side of the same street.

The laboratory knows that inversion.
An inspection that changes angle.
A plant seen from the root.
A day that looks backwards
until someone looks again.
And still: stay curious.
Take the step with care.
Call Vida by its true name:
looking —
without turning the flip into confusion,
without calling the world a mistake
just because it stands on its head.

Valeu !!!

Because every time someone inverts the gaze
and inspects with joy
instead of closing the door,
the universe grows a little:
one more verse,
one more canopy,
a street where the sky also fits on the ground.
```

## Alcance

Inspección de **«Upside Down»** — **Jack Johnson** (*Sing-A-Longs and Lullabies for the Film Curious George*, 2006; single **24 feb. 2006**). Canción primero: escrita en **2005** para el filme *[Curious George](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Curious_George_%28film%29)*; una voz que narra a un mono que no habla; **al revés** como modo de ver — no como caída. Cruza [creatividad](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-criatividade.html), [alegría](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alegria.html) y [camino](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html). El filme y los libros de los Rey son **contexto**; esta ficha es la **canción**.

## El poema del laboratorio

```poem
Upside Down.
No pedimos prestada la letra —
pedimos el oficio de voltear la mirada
sin voltear la casa.

Jack Johnson.
Hubo un mono que no habla
y una guitarra que narra.
Hubo bocetos en blanco y negro
y un cavaquinho marcando el paso.
Hubo el mundo al revés —
no para caer,
para ver el otro lado de la misma calle.

El laboratorio conoce esa inversión.
Inspección que cambia de ángulo.
Planta que se ve por la raíz.
Día que parece al contrario
hasta que alguien mira de nuevo.
Y aun así: quedarse curioso.
Dar el paso con cuidado.
Llamar a Vida por su nombre verdadero:
mirar —
sin transformar el vuelco en confusión,
sin creer que el mundo es error
solo porque está de cabeza.

¡Valeu !!!

Porque cada vez que alguien invierte la mirada
e inspecciona con alegría
en vez de cerrar la puerta,
el universo crece un poco:
un verso más,
un dosel más,
una calle donde el cielo también cabe en el suelo.
```

## The lab poem

```poem
How Bizarre.
We do not borrow the lyric —
we ask for the craft of naming the strange
without turning life into a joke
or into panic.

OMC. Pauly. Ōtara.
There was a suburb they called a millionaires’ club
as irony —
and a groove that left there without asking the map for permission.
There was a mariachi trumpet in the hip-hop,
an Impala sliding through the clip,
a voice that tells the bizarre
the way one inspects a street:
not to laugh at the neighbour,
to see what the radio pretended not to exist.

The laboratory knows that name.
A day that will not close.
A mix that “should not” work.
A path that looks crooked
until someone stays and measures.
And still: call things by their name.
Stay alright with the inexplicable.
Take the step without erasing the origin.

Valeu !!!

Because every time someone names the bizarre
and inspects with joy
instead of crushing or mocking,
the universe grows a little:
one more verse,
one more canopy,
a street where the strange also fits the craft.
```

```poem
How Bizarre.
No pedimos prestada la letra —

sin transformar la vida en chiste
ni en pánico.

OMC. Pauly. Ōtara.

hasta que alguien se queda y mide.
```

**Seems:** messiah of innovation.  
**Is:** a **name** on top of **jobs** (work). Genius without a trail is [ídolo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-idolo.html).

## 3. BudGanja correction

**Jobs ≠ life manual.** If you say Jobs, know whether you mean a **person** or **work**. Admire the deed ([genial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-genial.html)) without handing over the [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html). Train [skill](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-skill.html) with a trail. Close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-figura-steve-jobs.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of **Steve Jobs** (1955–2011). Not a product history: **person** vs [ídolo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-idolo.html), the word [Jobs](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-jobs.html), and the viral claim *“his kids only got phones after 18.”*

> Sources: [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steve_Jobs), [Bilton, *NYT*, 10 Sep 2014](https://www.nytimes.com/2014/09/11/fashion/steve-jobs-apple-was-a-low-tech-parent.html) (late-2010 call). **Not an authorized biography.**

## The “until 18” claim

**Documented (Jobs, 2010):** the kids **hadn’t used the iPad**; “we limit how much technology our kids use at home.”  
**Documented (Isaacson):** kitchen-table dinners — books, history; no iPad/computer at the table.  
**Viral “18”:** **weak** as a quote from him. Likely mix of *Wait Until **8th*** (8th grade) + other Valley parents (~14 / ~16 in Bilton’s wider reporting).

**Calendar:** Eve was ~13 when Jobs died (Oct 2011). He **could not** apply “phone at 18” to the younger children in his lifetime.

## Why they limited (inspectable)

Presence at dinner; the product captures attention by design; home ≠ keynote. Not a published manifesto “ban until 18.” See [phone & children](/posts/post-inspecao-celular-riscos-saude-criancas.html). Close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) — with the [truth](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) of what was said, without an invented age.

## Status

**Approved** — “phone at 18” **fails as a citation**, **passes as a meme to inspect**; fact = home limit + unused iPad (2010).

> Fuentes: [Wikipedia](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steve_Jobs), [Bilton, *NYT*, 10 sep. 2014](https://www.nytimes.com/2014/09/11/fashion/steve-jobs-apple-was-a-low-tech-parent.html). **No es biografía autorizada.**

## La afirmación «a los 18»

**Documentado (Jobs, 2010):** los hijos **no habían usado el iPad**; «limitamos cuánta tecnología usan en casa».  
**Documentado (Isaacson):** cena en la mesa — libros, historia; sin iPad/ordenador.  
**Viral «18»:** **débil** como cita suya. Probable mezcla de *Wait Until **8th*** (8.º curso) + otros padres de Silicon Valley.

**Calendario:** Eve tenía ~13 años cuando Jobs murió (oct. 2011). **No pudo** aplicar «móvil a los 18» a los más pequeños en vida.

## Por qué limitaban

Presencia en la mesa; el producto captura atención; casa ≠ escenario. No hay manifiesto «prohibido hasta los 18». Ver [celular e niños](/posts/post-inspecao-celular-riscos-saude-criancas.html). Cerrar con [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Estado

**Aprobado** — «móvil a los 18» **no pasa como cita**, **sí como meme a inspeccionar**; hecho = límite en casa + iPad (2010).

## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **gêmeos** (“twins”; typed **gemeos**). Field question: relation to *genius* / genial / Aladdin? **Letter-trap, not shared etymon.** *Gêmeos* ← Lat. *geminus* (twin, double). *[Gênio](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/g%C3%AAnio)* / [genial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-genial.html) ← Lat. *genius*. **Gemini** is the Latin name of the pair (constellation / sign). Links: [relação](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-relacao.html), [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Sources: [gêmeo](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/g%C3%AAmeo), [Gemini](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Gemini). **Not a horoscope, not an AI review.**

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Anchor | **gêmeos** · oral **gemeos** |
| Path | *geminus* (twins) ≠ *genius* (spirit / ingenuity) ≠ genie of the lamp |
| Date | 2026-08-19 |

## 2. Seems vs is

**Seems:** *gênio* and *gêmeos* are one family.  
**Is:** two Latin roots. The lamp grants wishes ([abracadabra](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-abracadabra.html)); twins share a birth ([relação](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-relacao.html)).

## 3. Correction

**Twins ≠ genie ≠ “genial!”** If the mouth said Geneo / génio, see [genial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-genial.html). Close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) in **this** pair of hands.

## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **lâmpada** (typed **lampada**). It is the **vessel** — in the room it holds [light](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-luz.html); in the tale it holds Aladdin’s genie. Two lamps, one word: **circuit** (switch, watts) vs **wish** (rub, three desires). Links: [ligar × desligar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ligar-desligar.html), [abracadabra](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-abracadabra.html), [genial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-genial.html), [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

| Not | The genie (tenant) · [gêmeos](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gemeos.html) (twins) · the [sun](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sol.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-19 |

## 2. Seems vs is

**Seems:** the glass *is* the magic.  
**Is:** the glass is a **container**. Light is the effect. The genie is a wish-story. The craft click is [ligar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ligar-desligar.html).

## 3. Correction

**Lamp = vessel.** If you hear lampada, read lâmpada. Rubbing the bulb is not [turning it on](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ligar-desligar.html). Close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) at this socket.

inspecao-palavra-esfregar.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **esfregar** (“to rub”) — the **tale’s false gesture** on the [lamp](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lampada.html) map. In the room, rubbing is friction (clean, warm, polish). In [Aladdin](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aladim) it is the **hand cue** that summons the genie — tactile cousin of [abracadabra](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-abracadabra.html). Rubbing the bulb is not [turning it on](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ligar-desligar.html). Links: [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html), [wishes](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-desejos.html), [three](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tres.html), [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Sources: [esfregar](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/esfregar), [Aladdin](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aladim). **Not a cleaning manual, not an electrical protocol.**

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Anchor | **esfregar** · Lat. *fricare* |
| Not | [Ligar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ligar-desligar.html) (circuit) · the genie · [twins](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gemeos.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-19 |

## 2. Seems vs is

**Seems:** friction *wakes* the spirit.  
**Is:** friction is craft or theatre. The switch is the lab [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html).

## 3. Correction

**Rub ≠ on.** Palm on the [switch](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-interruptor.html), not on the glass. Close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) in this hand.

## Status

**Approved** — friction sheet; tale cue × circuit click.

inspecao-palavra-esfregar.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **esfregar** («frotar») — el **gesto falso del cuento** en el mapa de la [lámpara](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lampada.html). En el cuarto, frotar es fricción. En [Aladino](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aladim) es la **señal de la mano** que llama al genio — primo táctil de [abracadabra](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-abracadabra.html). Frotar el vidrio no es [encender](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ligar-desligar.html). Vínculos: [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html), [deseos](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-desejos.html), [tres](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tres.html), [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Fuentes: [esfregar](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/esfregar), [Aladino](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aladim). **No es manual de limpieza ni protocolo eléctrico.**

## 1. Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Ancla | **esfregar** · lat. *fricare* |
| No es | [Ligar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ligar-desligar.html) · el genio · [gêmeos](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gemeos.html) |
| Fecha | 2026-08-19 |

## 2. Parece × es

**Parece:** la fricción *despierta* al espíritu.  
**Es:** fricción es oficio o teatro. El interruptor es el [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) del lab.

## 3. Corrección

**Frotar ≠ encender.** Palma en el [interruptor](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-interruptor.html), no en el vidrio. Cerrar con [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Estado

**Aprobada** — ficha de fricción; señal del cuento × clic del circuito.

inspecao-palavra-desejos.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **desejos** (“wishes”; singular **desejo**). After rubbing the [lamp](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lampada.html), this is the **content** the genie is paid to deliver. Living PT: will / appetite / project. In popular [Aladdin](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aladim) retellings, wishes come as a **pack** — often [three](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tres.html). A wish **points**; craft **walks**. Links: [esfregar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-esfregar.html), [abracadabra](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-abracadabra.html), [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Sources: [desejo](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/desejo), [*desiderium*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/desiderium). **Not a wish-list, not clinical psychology.** *De + sidus* is etymology, not a horoscope, not [twins](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gemeos.html).

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Anchor | **desejos** · **desejo** |
| Path | Lat. *desiderium* |
| Date | 2026-08-19 |

## 2. Seems vs is

**Seems:** three wishes settle the life.  
**Is:** a tale quota. The lab translates one wish into one [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html).

## 3. Correction

**Wishes point; craft fulfils.** If the mouth said **3**, see [três](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tres.html). Close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html), not the third wish.

## Status

**Approved** — will × tale pack; quota on the sister sheet.

inspecao-palavra-tres.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **três** (digit **3**, typed **tres**). After *desejos*, this is the **quota** of the tale — **three wishes**. Not arithmetic, not theology. In popular [Aladdin](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aladim) retellings: [rub](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-esfregar.html) the [lamp](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lampada.html), spend **three** [wishes](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-desejos.html). The classical *Nights* lamp-genie is **not** a constant the lab can swear. **3** here is the **popular pack**. Links: [abracadabra](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-abracadabra.html), [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Sources: [três](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/tr%C3%AAs), [rule of three](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rule_of_three_(writing)). **Not Disney plot authentication.**

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Anchor | **três** · **3** · **tres** |
| Path | Lat. *trēs* |
| Date | 2026-08-19 |

## 2. Seems vs is

**Seems:** the lamp *owes* three wishes.  
**Is:** a narrative ceiling. Craft counts **one** [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html).

## 3. Correction

**3 = story cap.** Do not invent the third Aladdin episode. Close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) on **this** step.

## Status

**Approved** — cardinal + popular wish quota; classic not sworn.

inspecao-expressao-fim-da-linha.excerptEn: Sayings: “fim da linha” — limit of the tape, of life and of the belt; lab case = colored shell + chocolate (M&M's format); links cinta, vida, industrial chocolate.
inspecao-expressao-fim-da-linha.excerptEs: Dichos: «fim da linha» — límite de la cinta, de la vida y de la línea; caso lab = cáscara de color + chocolate (formato M&M's); vínculos cinta, vida, chocolate industrial.
inspecao-expressao-fim-da-linha.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of the Brazilian saying **“fim da linha”** (end of the line) — end of a route, of options, of [tape / cinta](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-cinta.html), of [life](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vida.html), and of a **factory belt**. Lab case: **candy-coated chocolate** (popular **M&M's** format): the shell wraps like tape; the core is chocolate ([life](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vida.html) the shell keeps until the last gesture). Links [cinta](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-cinta.html), [vida](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vida.html) / trail [Vida](/vida/), [industrial chocolate](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-chocolate.html); close [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Independent BudGanja audit. Object = the **living phrase** and the **format** (shell + core), not the brand. **No affiliation with Mars / M&M's.** Not a factory manual, not a death sermon, not medical advice.

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Saying | **fim da linha** |
| Type | BR oral locution — terminus · limit · belt |
| Lab case | Colored shell + chocolate (M&M's format) |
| Links | [cinta](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-cinta.html) · [vida](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vida.html) · [chocolate](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-chocolate.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-19 |

## Reading

**H1:** the candy shell is **tape** — it wraps; it is not the core.  
**H2:** the chocolate is **life** — what the tape protects.  
**H3:** *fim da linha* names the last of the belt, the last of the reel, and the arc of life — without fusing death and craft.  
**H4:** the reply is [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) **on this remaining tape**, today.

## The poem

```poem
They said the tape ends
when the reel will not pull.
Half a lie.
The tape ends when the hand
stops inspecting what still winds.

There is an end of the line at the station —
last platform, a door that opens and does not go on.
There is another on the factory belt:
the candy comes out in color,
shell intact, core hidden.

The shell is tape.
The chocolate is life.
While the tape holds,
life does not melt in the hand.
When the line finishes,
the shell delivers what it kept.

This is not a sermon on death.
It is craft of what remains:
count what still fits on this reel,
do not pretend the belt is eternal,
do not cinch the plant with tape
as if the end excused the knot.

Valeu !!!
before the last platform —
with the right tape,
with life named,
with the candy inspected
and not only eaten.
```

## Verdict

**Approved** — end-of-the-line saying; M&M's-format case (shell = tape, core = life); [cinta](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-cinta.html) · [vida](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vida.html) · [chocolate](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-chocolate.html).

inspecao-expressao-fim-da-linha.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de la locución brasileña **«fim da linha»** (fin de la línea) — fin de trayecto, de opciones, de [cinta / fita](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-cinta.html), de [vida](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vida.html) y de **cinta de fábrica**. Caso de laboratorio: **confite de chocolate con cáscara de color** (formato popular **M&M's**): la cáscara envuelve como cinta; el núcleo es el chocolate (la [vida](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vida.html) que la cáscara guarda hasta el último gesto). Vínculos [cinta](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-cinta.html), [vida](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vida.html) / senda [Vida](/vida/), [chocolate industrial](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-chocolate.html); cierre [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Auditoría independiente. Objeto = la **frase viva** y el **formato** (cáscara + núcleo), no la marca. **Sin afiliación con Mars / M&M's.** No es manual de fábrica ni sermón de muerte.

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Expresión | **fim da linha** |
| Tipo | Locución oral BR — término · límite · cinta |
| Caso lab | Cáscara de color + chocolate (formato M&M's) |
| Vínculos | [cinta](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-cinta.html) · [vida](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vida.html) · [chocolate](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-chocolate.html) · [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Fecha | 2026-08-19 |

## Lectura

**H1:** la cáscara es **cinta** — envuelve; no es el núcleo.  
**H2:** el chocolate es **vida** — lo que la cinta protege.  
**H3:** *fim da linha* nombra el último de la cinta, el último del rollo y el arco de la vida — sin fundir muerte y oficio.  
**H4:** la respuesta es [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) **en este resto de cinta**, hoy.

## El poema

```poem
Dijeron que la cinta se acaba
cuando el carrete ya no tira.
Mentira a medias.
La cinta se acaba cuando la mano
deja de inspeccionar lo que aún enrolla.

Hay un fin de línea en el metro —
último andén, puerta que abre y no sigue.
Hay otro en la cinta de la fábrica:
el confite sale de color,
cáscara intacta, núcleo escondido.

La cáscara es cinta.
El chocolate es vida.
Mientras la cinta sujeta,
la vida no se derrite en la mano.
Cuando la línea termina,
la cáscara entrega lo que guardaba.

No es sermón de muerte.
Es oficio de lo que queda:
contar lo que aún cabe en este rollo,
no fingir que la cinta es eterna,
no apretar la planta con la fita
como si el fin justificara el nudo.

Valeu !!!
antes del último andén —
con la cinta cierta,
con la vida nombrada,
con el confite inspeccionado
y no solo comido.
```

## Veredicto

**Aprobada** — locución de fin de línea; caso formato M&M's (cáscara = cinta, núcleo = vida); [cinta](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-cinta.html) · [vida](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vida.html) · [chocolate](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-chocolate.html).

inspecao-expressao-a-benca.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of Brazilian **“a bença”** (asking a blessing — oral form of *bênção*). Living ritual: **ask** → **[Deus te abençoe](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-deus-abencoe.html)** (God bless you) → **dorme com Deus** (sleep with God) → **amém** (amen; typed **amem**). Sister sheet [Deus abençoe](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-deus-abencoe.html) **gives**; this sheet **asks** and **puts the day to bed**.

> Independent BudGanja audit. Respect for faith; **no** proselytizing. Sheet ≠ catechism.

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Anchor | **a bença** |
| Sequence | ask → God bless you → sleep with God → amen |
| Tipography | **benca** / **amem** → **bença** / **amém** |
| Links | [Deus abençoe](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-deus-abencoe.html) · [mãe](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mae.html) · [noite](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-noite.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-19 |

## Reading

**H1:** *a bença* is the **request** — distinct from giving.  
**H2:** *Deus te abençoe* is the living **answer**.  
**H3:** *dorme com Deus* inspects [night](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-noite.html) as care, not a sleep protocol.  
**H4:** *amém* / typed *amem* is the **seal**, not proof.  
**H5:** then [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## The poem

```poem
Your blessing, father.
Your blessing, mother.
It is not a contract.
It is the hand that asks
before the day is put to bed.

God bless you —
the answer that returns the request
without weighing desert.
Whoever asks does not buy.
Whoever blesses does not charge.

Sleep with God.
Not a flight from night.
The room inspected:
low light, the chest still here,
the line of sleep without blackmail.

Amen.
Living typing: amem.
A short seal — the yes that closes
without turning blessing into proof.

Valeu !!!
after the blessing —
with respect,
no catechism,
with the gesture that still fits
this hand.
```

## Verdict

**Approved** — asking a blessing · night · amen; sister [Deus abençoe](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-deus-abencoe.html); [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-expressao-a-benca.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **«a bença»** (pedir la bendición — forma oral de *bênção*). Rito vivo: **pedir** → **[Deus te abençoe](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-deus-abencoe.html)** → **dorme com Deus** → **amém** (teclado **amem**). La ficha hermana [Deus abençoe](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-deus-abencoe.html) **da**; esta **pide** y **acuesta el día**.

> Auditoría independiente. Respeto a la fe; **sin** proselitismo. Ficha ≠ catecismo.

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Ancla | **a bença** |
| Secuencia | pedir → Dios te bendiga → duerme con Dios → amén |
| Tipografía | **benca** / **amem** → **bença** / **amém** |
| Vínculos | [Deus abençoe](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-deus-abencoe.html) · [mãe](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mae.html) · [noite](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-noite.html) · [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Fecha | 2026-08-19 |

## Lectura

**H1:** *a bença* es el **pedido**.  
**H2:** *Deus te abençoe* es la **respuesta**.  
**H3:** *dorme com Deus* inspecciona la [noche](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-noite.html).  
**H4:** *amém* / *amem* es el **sello**, no una prueba.  
**H5:** luego [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## El poema

```poem
La bendición, padre.
La bendición, madre.
No es contrato.
Es la mano que pide
antes de acostar el día.

Dios te bendiga —
la respuesta que devuelve el pedido
sin pesar el merecimiento.
Quien pide no compra.
Quien bendice no cobra.

Duerme con Dios.
No es huida de la noche.
Es el cuarto inspeccionado:
luz baja, el pecho aún aquí,
la línea del sueño sin chantaje.

Amén.
Tipografía viva: amem.
Sello corto — el sí que cierra
sin convertir la bendición en prueba.

Valeu !!!
después de la bendición —
con respeto,
sin catecismo,
con el gesto que aún cabe
en esta mano.
```

## Veredicto

**Aprobada** — pedir bendición · noche · amén; hermana [Deus abençoe](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-deus-abencoe.html); [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-palavra-vassoura.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of Portuguese **vassoura** — chiefly the **broom** (handle + bristles), plus history and curiosities. Links [esfregar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-esfregar.html), [lavar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lavar.html), [risco](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html), [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html). The European “witch’s broom” appears as a **documented historical hypothesis** (UNIFESP XIV), **not** as a recipe. Tropane nightshades are **toxic**.

> Method note: [Wiktionary · vassoura](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/vassoura), [Livro XIV](/biblioteca/unifesp/livro-xiv.html). Naming folklore ≠ teaching it.

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **vassoura** |
| Etymon | Lat. *versōria* — high confidence |
| Lab type | Sweeping tool × floor craft |
| Links | [esfregar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-esfregar.html) · [lavar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lavar.html) · [risco](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-19 |

## 2. History

Portuguese *vassoura* comes from Latin *versōria* (turning / sweeping). English *broom* named the **shrub** first, then the tool. Brazilian brooms often used **piaçava** fibre. Witch-hunt imagery stuck a rider to the handle; UNIFESP XIV notes tropane Solanaceae in that folklore, stresses they are **not** classic psychedelics, and refuses the cliché that only women were blamed. In Brazilian cacao, **witches’ broom** is a **fungal disease** (*Moniliophthora perniciosa*), not a sabbat.

## 3. Curiosities

PT *vassoura* and Spanish *escoba* share the job, not the etymon. *Vassourada* can mean a scolding. The lab files the tale and **does not** copy unguents.

## 4. Valeu !!!

Best possible **on this actual floor**, today. Sweep without sweeping [verdade](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) under the rug.

## Status

**Approved** — object · craft · documented curiosity · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).
