inspecao-palavra-vassoura.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **vassoura** — sobre todo la **escoba** (mango + cerdas), con historia y curiosidades. Vínculos [esfregar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-esfregar.html), [lavar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lavar.html), [risco](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html), [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html). La «escoba de la bruja» entra como **hipótesis histórica documentada** (UNIFESP XIV), **no** como receta. Las solanáceas tropánicas son **tóxicas**.

> Nota: [Wikcionario · vassoura](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/vassoura), [Livro XIV](/biblioteca/unifesp/livro-xiv.html). Nombrar el folclore ≠ enseñarlo.

## 1. Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Palabra | **vassoura** |
| Étimo | lat. *versōria* |
| Tipo lab | Utensilio de barrer × oficio del suelo |
| Vínculos | [esfregar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-esfregar.html) · [lavar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lavar.html) · [risco](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html) · [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Fecha | 2026-08-19 |

## 2. Historia

El portugués hereda *vassoura* del latín *versōria*. El inglés *broom* nombró primero el arbusto. En Brasil, la fibra de **piaçava** marca el oficio. El imaginario de la bruja pegó una jinete al mango; el Libro XIV corrige: el tropano no es psicodélico clásico, y no todo quedó «en la cuenta de la mujer». En el cacao brasileño, **escoba de bruja** es una **enfermedad fúngica**, no un aquelarre.

## 3. Curiosidades

*Vassoura* y *escoba* son primas de oficio, no el mismo étimo. *Vassourada* también es bronca. El lab ficha el cuento y **no** copia ungüentos.

## 4. ¡Valeu !!!

Lo mejor posible **en este suelo concreto**, hoy.

## Estado

**Aprobada** — objeto · oficio · curiosidad documentada · [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Scope

Inspection of **every word** in **[MEQUETREFE | PORTA PALAVRA #5](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4Ot7Mqlhlbo)** (Gregorio Duvivier / Porta dos Fundos) **on this same page**. Door-word: **mequetrefe** (field slip *meqyetrefe*). The rest is the thrift shop: aging words, clinical substitutes, Anglicisms.

> Independent audit. **Not a full dictionary, not political satire, not clinical advice.** Credit: Duvivier / Porta dos Fundos.

## Anchor video

@youtube 4Ot7Mqlhlbo

Thesis: words are born, go senile, die; the dictionary is a **thrift shop**.

## Clusters (all on this page)

| Cluster | Pieces |
|---------|--------|
| Door | **mequetrefe** (busybody / rascal / nobody; etymon disputed: *meco+trefe*) · coroca · lambisgóia · sigaíta |
| Sadness ladder | jururu · borocochô · cabisbaixo · melancólico · macambúzio · taciturno · sorumbático → depression / dysthymia |
| Attention / joy / “madness” | desligado→ADHD · geniosa→bipolar · faceiro/serelepe→mania · biruta/zureta/avariado/lelé→psychotic |
| Child / blow | peralta/traquinas→ODD · supapo/safanão/cascudo → Ritalin / Venvanse |
| Intensity / clothes / sport | pra Dedel/burro/cachorro/caramba · caraca/caracoles · pinimba→ranço · zoeira/troça/galhofa→bullying · cooper→running · janota/frajola · garbo/galhardia |
| Lie / brand / revival | lorota→fake news · caô/balela/embuste→narrative/storytelling · rebranding · flirt/paquera · cacarecos · brechó · dicionário |

**Correction:** clinical names do not erase nuance; keeping an old word is not using it to shrink people. Close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Status

**Approved** — full Porta Palavra #5 lexicon on one page.

inspecao-loja-principia.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of Brazilian dermocosmetic brand **Principia**. The field line «most recommended by dermatologists» is audited as a **claim**, not copied as fact.

> Independent audit. Sources: [site](https://www.principiaskin.com/), [Panorama Farmacêutico](https://panoramafarmaceutico.com.br/dermocosmeticos-de-alta-performance/). **Not medical advice, not a SKU review, not an endorsement.**

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Company | PRINCIPIA COMÉRCIO DE COSMÉTICOS LTDA · CNPJ 34.506.209/0001-43 |
| Founded | 2019 (products 2020) |
| Lab type | Shop / brand — catalog × prescription claim |
| Date | 2026-08-20 |

## The claim

Press citing **Memed**: in 18 months Principia became the **second** most **prescribed** dermocosmetic brand in Brazil — not “the most”, not forever. Visiting ~13k dermatologists is sales force, not an independent eternal ranking.

## Correction

Cosmetic ≠ medicine ([ANVISA](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-anvisa.html)). “Dermatologically tested” ≠ drug approval. Concentrations on the label are the solid literacy point. Close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Status

**Approved** — claim audited; no clinical endorsement.

## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **Paraguai** — the **country** (ES/EN **Paraguay**). Field slip **PARAGYACYY** mixes the country with Brazilian **[Paraguaçu](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-paraguacu.html)**. The etymon is **disputed**. Links: [Paraguayan War](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-guerra-do-paraguai.html), [war trophies](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trofeus-de-guerra.html), [cannon](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-canhao.html), [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

| Not | [Paraguaçu](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-paraguacu.html) (Brazil) |
| Date | 2026-08-20 |

## 2. Seems vs is

**Seems:** one mashed name.  
**Is:** country ≠ Brazilian toponym. The war is a [path](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html), not the whole country.

## 3. Correction

**Paraguai = country.** If the mouth said PARAGYACYY, open this sheet **and** [Paraguaçu](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-paraguacu.html). Close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

Inspección de **Paraguai** — el **país** (ES/EN **Paraguay**). El lapsus **PARAGYACYY** mezcla el país con el topónimo brasileño **[Paraguaçu](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-paraguacu.html)**. El étimo está **en disputa**. Vínculos: [Guerra](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-guerra-do-paraguai.html), [trofeos](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trofeus-de-guerra.html), [cañón](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-canhao.html), [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Fuentes: [Paraguai](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paraguai). **No es guía de viaje ni fallo de frontera.**

## 1. Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Ancla | **Paraguai** · **Paraguay** |
| No es | [Paraguaçu](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-paraguacu.html) |
| Fecha | 2026-08-20 |

## 2. Parece × es

**Parece:** un solo nombre aplastado.  
**Es:** país ≠ topónimo brasileño.

## 3. Corrección

**Paraguai = país.** Si la boca dijo PARAGYACYY, abrir esta ficha **y** [Paraguaçu](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-paraguacu.html). Cerrar con [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Estado

**Aprobada** — ficha de país; lapsus separado.

inspecao-expressao-templo-de-cristo-corp.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of **“o templo de Cristo, corpo e alma”** (lab request in caps: **O TEMPLO DE CRISTO CORPO E ALMA**). Living formula: **temple** + **Christ** + **body and soul** (wholeness). Sisters [filho de deus](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-filho-de-deus.html), [jesusamado](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-jesusamado.html), [Deus abençoe](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-deus-abencoe.html); [soul](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alma.html); [Portuguese](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lingua-portuguesa.html) soil.

> Independent BudGanja audit. Respect for faith; **no** proselytizing. Sheet ≠ catechism. Temple is **not** a weapon against the body.

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Saying | **o templo de Cristo, corpo e alma** |
| Pieces | temple (*templum*) · Christ (*Khristós*) · body (*corpus*) · [soul](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alma.html) (*anima*) |
| Anchor idiom | **corpo e alma** — the whole person, not two halves |
| Links | [filho de deus](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-filho-de-deus.html) · [soul](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alma.html) · [heart](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-coracao.html) · [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) · [truth](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-20 |

## Reading

**H1:** four clear etymons; the **formula** is the object.  
**H2:** *corpo e alma* in PT = **wholeness** more than dualism.  
**H3:** cultural map — John’s “temple of his body”; Pauline body-as-temple — **not** doctrine in this sheet.  
**H4:** close with craft: inhabit without splitting body from [soul](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alma.html).

## Limits

No catechism · no shaming the body · no church affiliation · formula ≠ lab proof.

## Verdict

**Approved** — dwelling · name · wholeness; sisters [filho de deus](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-filho-de-deus.html) / [soul](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alma.html); [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

Hermanas [filho de deus](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-filho-de-deus.html), [jesusamado](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-jesusamado.html), [Deus abençoe](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-deus-abencoe.html); [alma](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alma.html); suelo de la [lengua portuguesa](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lingua-portuguesa.html).

inspecao-arte-bitter-sweet-symphony.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of **"Bitter Sweet Symphony"** — **The Verve** (*Urban Hymns*, 1997; single **16 Jun 1997**). Song first: Olympic Studios, Ashcroft / Youth / Malone; a string loop from the Andrew Oldham Orchestra version of *The Last Time*. Crosses [life](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vida.html), [legal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-legal.html) and [path](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html). The **2 Jun 1996** crash stays on the sister sheet — **or not**. Requested audio: [Spotify · 1995 album](https://open.spotify.com/track/2XGRcNVv7uJozHCRLl7SG8).

> Method note: [Wikipedia](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vira-Vira). No affiliation. Clip: [VEVO](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1WjI3DLOk4c). This sheet is **not** a biography or an obituary. The lab does **not** reproduce the full lyric and does **not** treat the song as a protocol for humiliating Portuguese people or women.

@youtube 1WjI3DLOk4c

## The lab poem

```poem
Vira-Vira.
We do not borrow the lyric —
we ask for the craft of turning
without turning a people into a joke
or the first clip into a relic.

Mamonas. Dinho. Júlio.
There was a vira that already danced on another stage
and a Guarulhos rock that learned the step.
There was a clip with little money —
Rasec in the back, a grandmother recognising him.
There were those who expected a lawsuit
and found friendship.

The laboratory knows that turn.
Joy that does not crush the neighbour.
Genre first — vira, Arrebita, craft.
A stage joke ≠ a protocol of humiliation.
Pair of the yellow Brasília: another clip, same band.
The fall stays on the sister sheet —
or not.
Here the step turns, not the sky.

Valeu !!!

Because every time someone parodies a genre
and leaves the people standing
instead of turning the dance into a target,
the universe grows a little:
one more verse,
one more canopy,
a vira
where Portugal still fits
without being a sales stage.
```

inspecao-arte-vira-vira.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **«Vira-Vira»** — **Mamonas Assassinas** (álbum homónimo, **1995**; EMI; **Rick Bonadio**). Canción primero: rock cómico corto que parodia el **vira** portugués — un **género** y el escenario de Roberto Leal, no un pueblo a aplastar. Cruza [alegría](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alegria.html), [lengua portuguesa](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lingua-portuguesa.html) y [respeto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-respeito.html). Par de [Pelados em Santos](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-pelados-em-santos.html): el **otro** videoclip; este el primero, con pocos recursos. El accidente del **2 jun. 1996** queda en la ficha hermana — **o no**. Audio: [Spotify · álbum 1995](https://open.spotify.com/track/2XGRcNVv7uJozHCRLl7SG8).

> Nota: [Wikipedia](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vira-Vira). Sin afiliación. Videoclip: [VEVO](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1WjI3DLOk4c). Esta ficha **no** es biografía ni necrológico. El laboratorio **no** reproduce la letra íntegra ni trata la canción como protocolo de humillación.

@youtube 1WjI3DLOk4c

## El poema del laboratorio

```poem
Vira-Vira.
No pedimos prestada la letra —
pedimos el oficio de virar
sin transformar a un pueblo en chiste
ni el primer videoclip en reliquia.

Mamonas. Dinho. Júlio.
Hubo un vira que ya bailaba en otro escenario
y un rock de Guarulhos que aprendió el paso.
Hubo un clip con poco dinero —
Rasec al fondo, la abuela reconociéndolo.
Hubo quien esperaba un juicio
y encontró amistad.

El laboratorio conoce ese giro.
Alegría que no aplasta al vecino.
Género primero — vira, Arrebita, oficio.
Chiste de escenario ≠ protocolo de humillación.
Par de la Brasília amarilla: otro clip, misma banda.
La caída queda en la ficha hermana —
o no.
Aquí gira el paso, no el cielo.

¡Valeu !!!

Porque cada vez que alguien parodia un género
y deja al pueblo de pie
en vez de transformar el baile en blanco,
el universo crece un poco:
un verso más,
un dosel más,
un vira
donde aún cabe Portugal
sin ser escenario de venta.
```

inspecao-palavra-tonico.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of Portuguese **[tônico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonico.html)** / **tônicos** (EN *tonic*). One etymon — Gr. *tónos* / Lat. *tonus* (“tension, pitch, string”) — many offices. Field request: **tones of the word** and **other meanings**. Map them; **do not** fuse them.

> Independent audit. **Sheet ≠ recipe, diagnosis, or music lesson.**

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **tônico** / **tônicos** |
| Etymon | Gr. [*tónos*](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonos.html) → Lat. *tonus* — **high** confidence |
| Links | [tónos](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonos.html) · [Portuguese](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lingua-portuguesa.html) · [Pfaffia](/posts/post-inspecao-planta-pfaffia.html) · [isotônico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-isotonico.html) · [aff](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aff.html) · [jesusudavi](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-jesusudavi.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-20 |

## Meanings (keep apart)

1. **Word stress** — tonic syllable / intensity peak in the mouth.  
2. **Lab tone** — glossary *tone* (caution, awe, warm, joy, truth, calm, hope, danger).  
3. **Herbal tonic** — popular “tonifying” tradition ([Pfaffia](/posts/post-inspecao-planta-pfaffia.html), [cat’s claw](/posts/post-inspecao-planta-unha-de-gato.html), [cinchona](/posts/post-inspecao-planta-quina.html)).  
4. **Ayurvedic tonic** — jelly *rasāyana* in [UNIFESP XIV](/posts/post-inspecao-curso-unifesp-cannabis-medicinal.html), not a BR tea.  
5. **Tonic-clonic** — seizure type; literacy, **not** diagnosis.  
6. **Musical tonic** — scale degree I.  
7. **Muscle tone** — background tension.  
8. **Cosmetic tonic** — market lotion.  
9. **Tonic water** — quinine aperitif ≠ antimalarial bark tea.

**Verdict:** one *tónos*, nine offices; [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) after the map.

inspecao-palavra-isotonico.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of Portuguese **[isotônico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-isotonico.html)** (*isotonic*). Field request: **isolate tônico**. Split **iso-** (Gr. *ísos*, equal) + **[tônico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonico.html)** (Gr. *tónos*, tension). Do **not** fuse with herbal tonic, stressed syllable, or tonic water.

> Independent audit. **Sheet ≠ saline recipe, sports-drink brand, or training protocol.**

## Isolate the piece

Here **tônico** is **equal tension** (osmosis or muscle). It is **not** syllable stress, glossary *tone*, [Pfaffia](/posts/post-inspecao-planta-pfaffia.html), or tonic water ([cinchona](/posts/post-inspecao-planta-quina.html)).

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **isotônico** |
| Pieces | **iso-** + **[tônico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonico.html)** |
| Sisters | hypotonic · hypertonic |
| Links | [tônico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonico.html) · [água](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-agua.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-20 |

## Three offices

1. **Osmosis / saline** — same osmotic pressure as plasma (e.g. 0.9% NaCl).  
2. **Muscle** — isotonic contraction: tension ~ constant, length changes.  
3. **Shelf** — drink labelled “isotonic”; a **claim**, not proof.

**Verdict:** *iso-* locks [tônico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonico.html) to **equality**; [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) after the label.

inspecao-palavra-isotonico.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **[isotônico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-isotonico.html)** (*isotónico*). Pedido: **aislar el tônico**. Partir **iso-** (gr. *ísos*, igual) + **[tônico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonico.html)** (gr. *tónos*, tensión). **No** fusionar con tónico vegetal, sílaba tónica ni agua tónica.

> Auditoría independiente. **Ficha ≠ receta de suero, marca de bebida ni protocolo de entreno.**

## Aislar la pieza

Aquí **tônico** es **tensión igual** (ósmosis o músculo). **No** es acento, *tone* del glosario, [Pfaffia](/posts/post-inspecao-planta-pfaffia.html) ni agua tónica ([quina](/posts/post-inspecao-planta-quina.html)).

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Palabra | **isotônico** |
| Piezas | **iso-** + **[tônico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonico.html)** |
| Hermanas | hipotónico · hipertónico |
| Vínculos | [tônico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonico.html) · [água](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-agua.html) · [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Fecha | 2026-08-20 |

## Tres oficios

1. **Ósmosis / suero** — misma presión osmótica que el plasma.  
2. **Músculo** — contracción isotónica: tónus ~ constante, longitud cambia.  
3. **Góndola** — bebida «isotónico»; un **claim**, no una prueba.

**Veredicto:** *iso-* fija [tônico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonico.html) a la **igualdad**; [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) después de la etiqueta.

inspecao-arte-santa-ceia.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of **The Last Supper** (*A Última Ceia*; spoken BR: **Santa Ceia**) — mural by **[Leonardo da Vinci](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-leonardo-da-vinci.html)** (c. **1495–1498**), refectory of **Santa Maria delle Grazie**, Milan. Origin: the **canonical Gospels**. The painting is a **cut of one instant** — the betrayal announcement and the table’s [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) — not Scripture, not liturgy, not catechism.

The lab request arrived as oral **«santa ceia leonardp davint»** → canonical **The Last Supper · Leonardo da Vinci**. Biography: [Leonardo da Vinci](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-leonardo-da-vinci.html) (People).

> **Method note:** [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Last_Supper_%28Leonardo%29) · [PT](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/A_%C3%9Altima_Ceia_%28Leonardo_da_Vinci%29) · [Smarthistory](https://smarthistory.org/leonardo-last-supper/) (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XCg7o4onjxs). Public domain (d. 1519). No affiliation. **Painting ≠ sacrament ≠ homily.** *The Da Vinci Code* (2003) is **reception fiction**, not art history. Distinct from cannabis [Legacy](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-pessoas). No proselytism.

Sister Arts sheet: [The Passion of the Christ](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-a-paixao-de-cristo.html) — another Gospel cut (2004 film). Method pair: [The Alchemist](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-o-alquimista.html) (work first).

## Inspected object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Titles | **The Last Supper** · *L'Ultima Cena* · PT *A Última Ceia* · spoken BR **Santa Ceia** |
| Author | [Leonardo da Vinci](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-leonardo-da-vinci.html) |
| Dates / place | **c. 1495–1498** · Santa Maria delle Grazie, Milan |
| Size / technique | ~460 × 880 cm · tempera and oil on dry plaster (**not** buon fresco) |
| Instant | “One of you will betray me” (John 13:21 and synoptics) |
| BudGanja type | Art — **work first**; author in People; Gospels as genesis |
| Date | 2026-08-20 |

## Hypotheses

**H1:** value starts in the **Gospels**; Leonardo chooses the **second after the sentence**.  
**H2:** spoken **Santa Ceia** (sacrament) and catalogue **Last Supper** coexist; this sheet inspects the **wall**.  
**H3:** the dry technique buys time for [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) and pays in decay.  
**H4:** vanishing point at Christ’s right temple is [pattern](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-pattern.html), not ornament.  
**H5:** the beloved disciple is **John**, not Magdalene.  
**H6:** close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) — look until the gesture speaks.

## The table (left → right)

Bartholomew, James the Less, Andrew | **Judas**, Peter, John | **Christ** | Thomas, James the Greater, Philip | Matthew, Thaddeus, Simon.

Judas sits **with** the Twelve (break from the isolated-Judas tradition). No painted halo: the central window frames the head. Peter’s knife, Thomas’s finger, John’s youthful recline — workshop reading, not a novel.

## Lab thesis

| Theme | Gloss |
|-------|-------|
| Betrayal announcement | [Truth](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) at the table — inspection, not a blame show |
| [Gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) | Visible text; each hand is a sentence |
| Perspective | [Pattern](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-pattern.html) that serves the instant |
| Dry technique | [Creativity](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-criatividade.html) that accepts not lasting |
| Restoration 1978–1999 | Care for what remains — not “repaint Leonardo” |
| *Da Vinci Code* | Reception; **not** method |

1943 bombing: the refectory fell; the sandbagged wall survived. What we see now is mural + time + conservation.

## Status

**Approved in Arts as its own sheet** — Gospels first; 1495–1498 mural as credited cut; John ≠ Magdalene; author in [Leonardo da Vinci](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-leonardo-da-vinci.html).

inspecao-arte-santa-ceia.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **La última cena** (*A Última Ceia*; habla BR: **Santa Ceia**) — mural de **[Leonardo da Vinci](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-leonardo-da-vinci.html)** (c. **1495–1498**), refectorio de **Santa Maria delle Grazie**, Milán. Origen: los **Evangelios canónicos**. La pintura es un **recorte de un instante** — el anuncio de la traición y el [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) de la mesa — no el texto, no la liturgia, no un catecismo.

El pedido llegó en oralidad **«santa ceia leonardp davint»** → forma canónica **La última cena · Leonardo da Vinci**. Biografía: [Leonardo da Vinci](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-leonardo-da-vinci.html) (Personas).

> **Nota metodológica:** [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Last_Supper_%28Leonardo%29) · [PT](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/A_%C3%9Altima_Ceia_%28Leonardo_da_Vinci%29) · [Smarthistory](https://smarthistory.org/leonardo-last-supper/). Dominio público (m. 1519). **Pintura ≠ sacramento ≠ homilía.** *The Da Vinci Code* (2003) es **ficción de recepción**. Sin proselitismo.

Ficha hermana: [A Paixão de Cristo](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-a-paixao-de-cristo.html). Par de método: [O Alquimista](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-o-alquimista.html).

## Objeto inspeccionado

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Títulos | **La última cena** · *L'Ultima Cena* · PT *A Última Ceia* · habla BR **Santa Ceia** |
| Autor | [Leonardo da Vinci](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-leonardo-da-vinci.html) |
| Fechas / lugar | **c. 1495–1498** · Santa Maria delle Grazie, Milán |
| Técnica | Témpera y óleo sobre yeso seco — **no** *buon fresco* |
| Instante | «Uno de vosotros me va a entregar» (Juan 13,21) |
| Tipo BudGanja | Arte — **obra primero**; autor en Personas |
| Fecha | 2026-08-20 |

## Hipótesis

**H1:** el valor empieza en los **Evangelios**; Leonardo elige el segundo después de la frase.  
**H2:** **Santa Ceia** (sacramento) y **Última Cena** (catálogo) conviven; esta ficha inspecciona el **muro**.  
**H3:** la técnica en seco compra tiempo para el [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) y paga en ruina.  
**H4:** el discípulo amado es **Juan**, no Magdalena.  
**H5:** cierre = [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## La mesa (izq. → der.)

Bartolomé, Santiago el Menor, Andrés | **Judas**, Pedro, Juan | **Cristo** | Tomás, Santiago el Mayor, Felipe | Mateo, Tadeo, Simón.

Judas **en** la mesa. Sin aureola pintada: la ventana central enmarca la cabeza. *The Da Vinci Code* no es método.

## Estado

**Aprobada en Artes (ficha propia)** — Evangelios primero; mural 1495–1498; Juan ≠ Magdalena; autor en [Leonardo da Vinci](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-leonardo-da-vinci.html).

inspecao-figura-leonardo-da-vinci.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of **Leonardo di ser Piero da Vinci** (15 Apr 1452, Vinci — 2 May 1519, Amboise). Craft of **looking until the [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) speaks** — not a “universal genius” poster or a novel biography. Primary Arts link: [The Last Supper / Santa Ceia](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-santa-ceia.html).

> [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leonardo_da_Vinci) / [PT](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leonardo_da_Vinci). No affiliation. Distinct from cannabis [Legacy](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-pessoas). *Mona Lisa* and the Vitruvian Man are **career context**, not Arts sheets in this delivery. *The Da Vinci Code* is **not** a source. No invented private life.

People pair: [Paulo Coelho](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-paulo-coelho.html) — another author × work.

## Inspected object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Name | **Leonardo da Vinci** |
| Dates | 1452 (Vinci) — 1519 (Amboise) |
| Craft | Painter · draughtsman · engineer · anatomist (notebooks) |
| Anchor | [The Last Supper](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-santa-ceia.html) (1495–1498, Milan) |
| Date | 2026-08-20 |

## Who (verifiable)

Verrocchio’s workshop in Florence. Milan under Ludovico Sforza: the years of [The Last Supper](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-santa-ceia.html). Later Florence, Rome, France (Francis I, Clos Lucé). Mirror-written notebooks are a **work method**, not a thriller cipher. The Turin red-chalk portrait is a **debated** self-portrait — this lab does not close the face.

## Craft for this lab

| Trait | Gloss |
|-------|-------|
| Workshop first | [Skill](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-skill.html) inherited and rehearsed |
| Body and table | Anatomy and the [Supper](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-santa-ceia.html): [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) as visible [truth](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) |
| Time on the wall | Dry technique — [creativity](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-criatividade.html) that pays in decay |
| Perspective | [Pattern](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-pattern.html) in service of the instant |
| Close | [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |

Open [The Last Supper](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-santa-ceia.html) for the **mural**. Open [The Passion of the Christ](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-a-paixao-de-cristo.html) for the **2004 film**. This sheet is the **person**.

## Status

**Approved in People** — Leonardo da Vinci; primary link [The Last Supper](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-santa-ceia.html).

## Scope

Inspection of **The Chosen** (BR/PT: *Os Escolhidos*, 2019–). Created, directed and co-written by **Dallas Jenkins**. Origin: the **canonical Gospels**. The series is a **multi-season dramatization** of the ministry — Jesus through the eyes of those who met him — not Scripture, not catechism.

This sheet is **only** the series. [The Passion of the Christ](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-a-paixao-de-cristo.html) (2004) has its **own** sheet (last hours, another screen).

> [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Chosen_(TV_series)). Opening titles declare condensed timelines and added backstories. Crowdfunding / free official app is a **distribution craft**, not a miracle. No proselytism. This lab does **not** host the show or point to piracy.

inspecao-expressao-os-doze-apostolos.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of **“[os doze apóstolos](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-os-doze-apostolos.html)”** — the **named set** in Christian tradition and a **living phrase** in Brazilian Portuguese (church, speech, metaphor of a complete team). The lab request also arrived as *os dozes apostulos* (analogical plural + no accent): the sheet anchors **os doze apóstolos**. Sisters [filho de deus](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-filho-de-deus.html), [temple of Christ, body and soul](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-templo-de-cristo-corpo-e-alma.html), [The Passion of the Christ](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-a-paixao-de-cristo.html); [Portuguese](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lingua-portuguesa.html) soil. Vida poem: [The Twelve](/vida/#poema=os-doze-apostolos).

> Independent BudGanja audit. Object = the **name of the set** and the word **apostle** (Gk. *apóstolos*, “one sent”). Respect for faith; **no** proselytizing. **Sheet ≠ catechism, ≠ saint list, ≠ twelve biographies.** Gospel lists **diverge** on one or two names — we **declare variation**, we do not pick a church. No religious affiliation. The Judas debate **must not** become hatred of a people: [respect](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-respeito.html) first.

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Saying (lab) | **os doze apóstolos** (the twelve apostles) |

| Date | 2026-08-20 |

## Form

**os doze apóstolos** is the lab form. *dozes* stays as **orality of the request**, not a moral correction. *Apostle* ≠ automatic synonym of *disciple*: the Twelve are disciples; **not every** disciple is one of the Twelve.

## The twelve — working table (Western list common in BR)

Cultural memory, not historical proof in this sheet.

| # | Name | Lab office |
|---|------|------------|
| 1 | **Simon Peter** | Fall and **stay** — [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) after failure |
| 2 | **Andrew** | Bring the other without erasing him |
| 3 | **James the Greater** | Short fire on the [path](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html) |
| 4 | **John** | Word and [relation](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-relacao.html) |
| 5 | **Philip** | Invitation — not pressure |
| 6 | **Bartholomew** (Nathanael) | Without guile — [truth](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) |
| 7 | **Thomas** | **Inspect** before swearing — kin of this lab |
| 8 | **Matthew** | From the tax table to the sending table |
| 9 | **James the Less** | “Less” in the name ≠ less in the craft |
| 10 | **Jude Thaddaeus** | Do not confuse the **name** with Iscariot |
| 11 | **Simon the Zealot** | Political fire × sending — do not mix |
| 12 | **Judas Iscariot** | Map the fall **without** [revenge](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-vinganca-mata-alma-envenena.html) and without hatred of a people |

**Restoration:** **Matthias** ([Acts](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atos_dos_Ap%C3%B3stolos) 1) restores the twelve.  
**Apostle and not of the Twelve:** **Paul**.  
**Companion who writes, not of the Twelve:** **[Luke](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-lucas-evangelista.html)** — physician of men and of souls.

**H1:** value = **being sent**, not a pedestal of lab saints.  
**H2:** lists in [Matthew](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Evangelho_segundo_Mateus) 10, [Mark](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Evangelho_segundo_Marcos) 3, [Luke](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Evangelho_segundo_Lucas) 6, [Acts](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atos_dos_Ap%C3%B3stolos) 1 are **not letter-identical**.  
**H3:** Thomas is craft-kin: seeing is not lack of [soul](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alma.html).  
**H4:** close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) — today’s sending, no pulpit.

## Brazilian uses

Tradition set · church / place-name · “the twelve” as a closed team · modern title **Apostle** in some churches (**not** the first-century Twelve) · **Judas** as insult (name the wound; do not lynch; no antisemitism) · **Thomas** as doubter (right to inspect) · **Peter** as rock (rise; no infallible [idol](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-idolo.html)).

## Limits

No catechism · no full biography of each · no hatred via Judas · no mockery of living faith · do not collapse today’s title with the Twelve · do not force-harmonize lists.

## Verdict

**Approved** — named set · living BR phrase · craft of being sent; divergent lists declared; Judas and Matthias on the map without poison; Thomas as inspection’s pair; [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-expressao-os-doze-apostolos.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **«[os doze apóstolos](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-os-doze-apostolos.html)»** — el **conjunto nombrado** de la tradición cristiana y la **frase viva** en el portugués de Brasil (iglesia, oralidad, metáfora de equipo completo). El pedido del lab también llegó como *os dozes apostulos* (plural analógico + sin acento): la ficha ancla **os doze apóstolos**. Hermanas [filho de deus](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-filho-de-deus.html), [el templo de Cristo, cuerpo y alma](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-templo-de-cristo-corpo-e-alma.html), [La Pasión de Cristo](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-a-paixao-de-cristo.html); suelo de la [lengua portuguesa](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lingua-portuguesa.html). Poema Vida: [Los doce](/vida/#poema=os-doze-apostolos).

> Auditoría independiente. Objeto = el **nombre del conjunto** y la voz **apóstol** (gr. *apóstolos*, «enviado»). Respeto a la fe; **sin** proselitismo. **Ficha ≠ catecismo, ≠ santoral, ≠ doce biografías.** Las listas evangélicas **divergen** en uno o dos nombres — se **declara la variación**. Sin afiliación religiosa. El debate sobre Judas **no** se vuelve odio a un pueblo: [respeto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-respeito.html) primero.

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Expresión (lab) | **os doze apóstolos** (los doce apóstoles) |
| Pedido / oral | *os dozes apostulos* · *os 12 apostolos* |
| Núcleo | **apóstol** — *enviado* (no «jefe» ni [ídolo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-idolo.html)) |
| Tipo | Conjunto nombrado × frase viva × oficio de envío |
| Vínculos | [filho de deus](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-filho-de-deus.html) · [templo](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-templo-de-cristo-corpo-e-alma.html) · [Pasión](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-a-paixao-de-cristo.html) · [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) · [camino](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html) · [verdad](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) · [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Fuente | [Wikipedia · Doce Apóstoles](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doze_Ap%C3%B3stolos) · [EN](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apostles_in_the_New_Testament) · [Wikcionario](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/ap%C3%B3stolo) |
| Fecha | 2026-08-20 |

## Forma

**os doze apóstolos** es la forma lab. *dozes* queda como **oralidad del pedido**, no como corrección moral. *Apóstol* ≠ sinónimo automático de *discípulo*.

## Los doce — mesa de trabajo (lista occidental corriente en BR)

Memoria cultural, no prueba histórica en esta ficha.

| # | Nombre | Oficio lab |
|---|--------|------------|
| 1 | **Simón Pedro** | Caer y **quedarse** — [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) después de la falla |
| 2 | **Andrés** | Traer al otro sin borrarlo |
| 3 | **Santiago el Mayor** | Fuego corto en el [camino](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html) |
| 4 | **Juan** | Palabra y [relación](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-relacao.html) |
| 5 | **Felipe** | Invitación — no presión |
| 6 | **Bartolomé** (Natanael) | Sin dolo — [verdad](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) |
| 7 | **Tomás** | **Inspeccionar** antes de jurar — par del lab |
| 8 | **Mateo** | De la mesa del impuesto a la del envío |
| 9 | **Santiago el Menor** | «Menor» en el nombre ≠ menor en el oficio |
| 10 | **Judas Tadeo** | No confundir el **nombre** con Iscariote |
| 11 | **Simón el Zelote** | Fuego político × envío — no mezclar |
| 12 | **Judas Iscariote** | Mapear la caída **sin** [venganza](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-vinganca-mata-alma-envenena.html) y sin odio a un pueblo |

**Restauración:** **Matías** ([Hechos](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atos_dos_Ap%C3%B3stolos) 1) repone los doce.  
**Apóstol y no de los Doce:** **Pablo**.  
**Compañero que escribe, no de los Doce:** **[Lucas](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-lucas-evangelista.html)** — médico de hombres y de almas.

**H1:** el valor es el **envío**, no el pedestal.  
**H2:** las listas de [Mateo](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Evangelho_segundo_Mateus) 10, [Marcos](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Evangelho_segundo_Marcos) 3, [Lucas](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Evangelho_segundo_Lucas) 6 y [Hechos](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atos_dos_Ap%C3%B3stolos) 1 **no coinciden letra a letra**.  
**H3:** Tomás es par de oficio: ver no es falta de [alma](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alma.html).  
**H4:** cierre = [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Usos en BR

Conjunto de la tradición · iglesia / topónimo · «los doce» como equipo cerrado · título moderno **Apóstol** en algunas iglesias (**no** los Doce del siglo I) · **Judas** como insulto (nombrar la herida; no linchar; no antisemitismo) · **Tomás** como dudoso (derecho a inspeccionar) · **Pedro** como piedra (levantarse; no [ídolo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-idolo.html) infalible).

## Límites

Sin catecismo · sin biografía completa de cada uno · sin odio vía Judas · sin burla de la fe viva · no colapsar el título de hoy con los Doce · no forzar armonía de listas.

## Veredicto

**Aprobada** — conjunto nombrado · frase viva BR · oficio de envío; listas divergentes declaradas; Judas y Matías en el mapa sin veneno; Tomás como par de la inspección; [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **Moçambique** — the **country** (EN **Mozambique**; Swahili *Msumbiji*). Field request: relate **tónos** with **esqueiro biq**. The slip mixes **[BIC lighter](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-isqueiro-bic.html)** with **Biq** (sheikh *Musa ibn Bique*, traditional etymon). The word’s stress (*tónos*) falls on **BI**. Links: [tonic](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonico.html), [Portuguese](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lingua-portuguesa.html), [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Sources: [Moçambique](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mo%C3%A7ambique), [Musa ibn Bique](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musa_ibn_Bique). **Not a travel guide.** Homophony Biq × BIC is **not** brand genealogy.

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Anchor | **Moçambique** · **Mozambique** |
| Stress | *Mo-çam-**BI**-que* |
| Not | [BIC lighter](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-isqueiro-bic.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-20 |

## 2. Seems vs is

**Seems:** the country is named after a lighter.  
**Is:** the name comes from the **island** and the **sheikh**; BIC (1973) is a later homophone. *esqueiro* is a slip for *isqueiro* (and, in Minho, a small ladder).

## 3. Correction

**Moçambique = country.** If the mouth said *esqueiro biq*, open this sheet **and** [BIC lighter](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-isqueiro-bic.html). The [tonic](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonico.html) of the word is **BI**. Close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Status

**Approved** — country sheet; slip and *tónos* separated.

inspecao-figura-lucas-evangelista.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of **Luke the Evangelist** — in Brazilian Portuguese, **São Lucas** — and the living epithet **“[physician of men and of souls](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-lucas-evangelista.html)”**. The BudGanja cut is **not** closed hagiography or a theology class: it is the **traditional person** (companion of Paul, attributed author of the [Gospel of Luke](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Evangelho_segundo_Lucas) and [Acts](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atos_dos_Ap%C3%B3stolos)) and the **double craft** the name carries — care for the **body** without abandoning the **[soul](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alma.html)**. Vida poem: [Physician of men and of souls](/vida/#poema=lucas-medico-de-homens-e-de-almas).

> Independent audit. Sources: [Wikipedia · Luke](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Luke_the_Evangelist), [PT](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lucas_o_Evangelista), [Luke](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Evangelho_segundo_Lucas), [Acts](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atos_dos_Ap%C3%B3stolos), [Colossians](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ep%C3%ADstola_aos_Colossenses) **4:14**. Respect for faith; **no** proselytizing. **Sheet ≠ catechism, ≠ clinical protocol, ≠ every legend.** Distinct from cannabis [Legacy](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-pessoas). **Luke is not one of the [Twelve](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-os-doze-apostolos.html).** No religious affiliation. No medical advice.

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Name (lab) | **Lucas** / Luke (Gk. *Loukâs*) |
| Epithet | **médico de homens e de almas** (physician of men and of souls) |
| Textual hook | [Colossians](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ep%C3%ADstola_aos_Colossenses) **4:14** — “Luke, the beloved physician” |
| Works | [Luke](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Evangelho_segundo_Lucas) + [Acts](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atos_dos_Ap%C3%B3stolos) (two volumes) |
| The Twelve | **Not** one of the [twelve apostles](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-os-doze-apostolos.html) — companion of **Paul** |
| Symbol | Winged ox (tradition) |
| Type | Person — craft of care (body × [soul](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alma.html)) |
| Links | [temple, body and soul](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-templo-de-cristo-corpo-e-alma.html) · [filho de deus](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-filho-de-deus.html) · [soul](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alma.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-20 |

## Hypotheses

**H1:** value = **double craft** — treat the body **without** abandoning the [soul](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alma.html); name the [soul](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alma.html) **without** shaming the body ([temple](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-templo-de-cristo-corpo-e-alma.html)).  
**H2:** “physician” has a **textual hook** (Col 4:14); “of souls” is **tradition / preaching**, not a verse with that phrase.  
**H3:** Luke **does not** sit with the [Twelve](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-os-doze-apostolos.html).  
**H4:** close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) — today’s care, no pulpit, **no** clinical protocol.

## Who (verifiable synthesis)

Named in the Pauline letters: Col 4:14; Philemon 24; 2 Timothy 4:11. Tradition attributes Luke–Acts, dedicated to Theophilus. The “we” passages in Acts are **disputed** (companion vs literary device). **Not** on the lists of the [Twelve](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-os-doze-apostolos.html). Painter-of-Mary stories = **later legend**.

## The epithet — two halves

| Piece | Source | Confidence |
|-------|--------|------------|
| **Physician** (men / bodies) | Col 4:14 — *iatros* | **High** (text) |
| **Of souls** | Preaching, hagiography, pious BR speech | **Medium** (tradition, not a verse) |
| Winged ox | Tetramorph assigned to Luke | Iconography |

*Men* here = **humans** (bodies), not “males only.” Do not fuse the halves without saying where the text ends and piety begins.

## Brazilian uses

Saint Luke (cult / 18 Oct.) · the epithet on posters and in preaching · Gospel of Luke as canonical text · [The Chosen](/posts/post-inspecao-serie-the-chosen.html) / [Passion](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-a-paixao-de-cristo.html) as **other objects** (screen) · “physician of the soul” as metaphor (care, not a fake clinical title).

## Limits

No catechism · no medical advice · Col 4:14 names a **craft**, not a modern medical school · “of souls” is not that phrase in a verse · not one of the [Twelve](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-os-doze-apostolos.html) · not a lab [idol](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-idolo.html) · Mary-painter legend ≠ biography · “we” passages remain disputed · [Ticão](/posts/post-inspecao-padre-ticao.html) / [Carlini](/posts/post-inspecao-elisaldo-carlini.html) = care in the catalog, not first-century cannabis.

## Verdict

**Approved in People** — Luke the Evangelist as the **companion who treats and writes**; epithet with both halves declared (text × tradition); **outside** the [Twelve](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-os-doze-apostolos.html); wholeness with [temple](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-templo-de-cristo-corpo-e-alma.html); [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-figura-lucas-evangelista.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **Lucas el Evangelista** — en el portugués de Brasil, **São Lucas** — y del epíteto vivo **«[médico de hombres y de almas](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-lucas-evangelista.html)»**. El recorte BudGanja **no** es hagiografía cerrada ni clase de teología: es la **persona tradicional** (compañero de Pablo, autor atribuido del [Evangelio según Lucas](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Evangelho_segundo_Lucas) y de los [Hechos](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atos_dos_Ap%C3%B3stolos)) y el **oficio doble** que el nombre carga — cuidar el **cuerpo** sin abandonar el **[alma](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alma.html)**. Poema Vida: [Médico de hombres y de almas](/vida/#poema=lucas-medico-de-homens-e-de-almas).

> Auditoría independiente. Fuentes: [Wikipedia · Lucas](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lucas_o_Evangelista), [EN](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Luke_the_Evangelist), [Lucas](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Evangelho_segundo_Lucas), [Hechos](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atos_dos_Ap%C3%B3stolos), [Colosenses](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ep%C3%ADstola_aos_Colossenses) **4,14**. Respeto a la fe; **sin** proselitismo. **Ficha ≠ catecismo, ≠ protocolo clínico, ≠ cada leyenda.** Distinto del [Legado](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-pessoas) cannábico. **Lucas no es uno de los [Doce](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-os-doze-apostolos.html).** Sin afiliación religiosa. Sin consejo médico.

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Nombre (lab) | **Lucas** (gr. *Loukâs*) |
| Epíteto | **médico de homens e de almas** (médico de hombres y de almas) |
| Ancla textual | [Colosenses](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ep%C3%ADstola_aos_Colossenses) **4,14** — «Lucas, el médico amado» |
| Obras | [Lucas](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Evangelho_segundo_Lucas) + [Hechos](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atos_dos_Ap%C3%B3stolos) (dos tomos) |
| Los Doce | **No** es uno de los [doce apóstoles](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-os-doze-apostolos.html) — compañero de **Pablo** |
| Símbolo | Buey alado (tradición) |
| Tipo | Persona — oficio de cuidado (cuerpo × [alma](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alma.html)) |
| Vínculos | [templo, cuerpo y alma](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-templo-de-cristo-corpo-e-alma.html) · [filho de deus](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-filho-de-deus.html) · [alma](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alma.html) · [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Fecha | 2026-08-20 |

## Hipótesis

**H1:** el valor es el **oficio doble** — tratar el cuerpo **sin** abandonar el [alma](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alma.html); nombrar el [alma](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alma.html) **sin** avergonzar el cuerpo ([templo](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-templo-de-cristo-corpo-e-alma.html)).  
**H2:** «médico» tiene **gancho textual** (Col 4,14); «de almas» es **tradición / predicación**, no un versículo con esa frase.  
**H3:** Lucas **no** se sienta con los [Doce](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-os-doze-apostolos.html).  
**H4:** cierre = [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) — el cuidado de hoy, sin púlpito, **sin** protocolo clínico.

## Quién (síntesis verificable)

Nombrado en las cartas paulinas: Col 4,14; Filemón 24; 2 Timoteo 4,11. La tradición le atribuye Lucas–Hechos, dedicado a Teófilo. Los pasajes «nosotros» en Hechos están **en disputa**. **No** figura en las listas de los [Doce](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-os-doze-apostolos.html). El pintor de María = **leyenda posterior**.

## El epíteto — dos mitades

| Pieza | Fuente | Confianza |
|-------|--------|-----------|
| **Médico** (hombres / cuerpos) | Col 4,14 — *iatros* | **Alta** (texto) |
| **De almas** | Predicación, hagiografía, habla piadosa BR | **Media** (tradición, no versículo) |
| Buey alado | Tetramorfo asignado a Lucas | Iconografía |

*Hombres* aquí = **humanos** (cuerpos), no «solo varones». No fundir las mitades sin decir dónde acaba el texto y dónde empieza la piedad.

## Usos en BR

San Lucas (culto / 18 oct.) · el epíteto en carteles y predicación · Evangelio de Lucas como texto canónico · [The Chosen](/posts/post-inspecao-serie-the-chosen.html) / [Pasión](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-a-paixao-de-cristo.html) como **otro objeto** (pantalla) · «médico del alma» como metáfora (cuidado, no título clínico falso).

## Límites

Sin catecismo · sin consejo médico · Col 4,14 nombra un **oficio**, no una facultad moderna · «de almas» no es esa frase en un versículo · no es uno de los [Doce](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-os-doze-apostolos.html) · no [ídolo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-idolo.html) del lab · leyenda del pintor ≠ biografía · los «nosotros» siguen en disputa · [Ticão](/posts/post-inspecao-padre-ticao.html) / [Carlini](/posts/post-inspecao-elisaldo-carlini.html) = cuidado en el catálogo, no cannabis del siglo I.

## Veredicto

**Aprobado en Personas** — Lucas el Evangelista como el **compañero que trata y escribe**; epíteto con las dos mitades declaradas (texto × tradición); **fuera** de los [Doce](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-os-doze-apostolos.html); entereza con [templo](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-templo-de-cristo-corpo-e-alma.html); [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Scope

Editorial inspection of Greek **[tónos](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonos.html)** (τόνος). Field request: **tónos**, **[vomitar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vomitar.html)**, **[commitar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-commitar.html)** — three sheets. This one is the **root**: tension, pitch, string. It is **not** the Portuguese map [tônico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonico.html) nor the compound [isotônico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-isotonico.html).

> Independent audit. **Sheet ≠ Ancient Greek class, diagnosis, or recipe.**

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **tónos** / τόνος |
| Etymon | Gr. *teínō* “to stretch” → *tónos* → Lat. *tonus* → PT [tônico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonico.html) — **high** confidence |
| Links | [tônico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonico.html) · [isotônico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-isotonico.html) · [vomitar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vomitar.html) · [commitar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-commitar.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-20 |

## Root vs daughter

*tónos* **names the tension**. [tônico](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonico.html) **spreads the nine Portuguese offices**. Do not fuse root, tea, syllable, or sports drink.

## Office triad

1. **[tónos](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonos.html)** — hold (know where it tightens).  
2. **[vomitar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vomitar.html)** — release what must not stay.  
3. **[commitar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-commitar.html)** — record what stays.

**Verdict:** root sheet approved; [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) after the map.

1. **Git** — snapshot + message; not push, PR, or deploy.  
2. **Lab** — published sheet / diary trace — praise like [genial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-genial.html) comes **after**.  
3. **EN *commit to*** — to pledge; does not erase PT *compromisso*.

**Triad:** hold ([tónos](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonos.html)) → drop noise ([vomitar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vomitar.html)) → **commitar** the clean remainder.

inspecao-patinete-eletrico-criancas.excerptEn: Objects: e-scooter as battery locomotion — not a motorized toy; INMETRO ≤24 V vs CONTRAN 996; cell ≠ BYD Blade; falls, traffic and fire; no endorsement.
inspecao-patinete-eletrico-criancas.excerptEs: Objetos: patinete eléctrico como locomoción a batería — no es juguete con motor; INMETRO ≤24 V × CONTRAN 996; celda ≠ BYD Blade; caídas, vía y fuego; sin endoso.
inspecao-patinete-eletrico-criancas.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of the **electric scooter** as **battery-powered locomotion**. Field request: BYD as a car brand → batteries → **children’s scooters and dangers**. This sheet starts with the **object the child stands on**. BYD enters as **industrial genealogy** (cells first, cars later) — not as a showroom.

> Independent audit. Sources: [INMETRO electric toys](https://www.gov.br/inmetro/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/perguntas-frequentes/avaliacao-da-conformidade/brinquedos/brinquedos-eletricos-devem-ser-certificados), [CONTRAN Resolution 996/2023](https://www.gov.br/transportes/pt-br/assuntos/transito/conteudo-contran/resolucoes/Resolucao9962023.pdf), [BYD](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BYD_Company). **Not medical, legal or buying advice. Not a SKU review. Not an endorsement.**

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Object | Electric kick scooter (e-scooter) — wheels + motor + **battery** |
| Cut | Children; body, road and cell hazards |
| Distinct from | Push scooter · e-bike · moped · BYD car |
| Date | 2026-08-21 |

## Three classes the marketplace glues together

| Class | Anchor |
|-------|--------|
| **Electric toy** | Max **24 V**; INMETRO toy mark. Above 24 V, or meant for public roads, **is not** a toy ([INMETRO](https://www.gov.br/inmetro/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/perguntas-frequentes/avaliacao-da-conformidade/brinquedos/brinquedos-eletricos-devem-ser-certificados)). |
| **Self-propelled device** | ≤ **1000 W**, factory speed ≤ **32 km/h**; bell, lights, limiter; no federal plate/licence. **No minimum age** in 996. |
| **Moped** | Above those limits — ACC / category A, registration. |

## The battery

**BYD** (1995, Wang Chuanfu) is a **battery company that later built cars**. The Blade Battery (LFP, 2020) is industrial cell craft. A children’s marketplace pack **does not inherit** that nail-penetration demo. Same physics family ([fire](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fogo.html)); different object, different duty.

Charge with the original charger, in sight, on a hard surface. A swollen pack is out of service.

## Child hazards

Falls and head injury; speed vs age; mixing with cars; silent motor; extra passenger (usually forbidden); device mass; water; phone-on-bars (see [phone sheet](/posts/post-inspecao-celular-riscos-saude-criancas.html)). “It’s just a toy” and “the child already knows the push scooter” are **claims**, not facts.

## Status

**Approved** as equipment verification — battery locomotion; three risk layers; BYD as cell genealogy only. No endorsement. No magic age.

[▶ INMETRO](https://www.gov.br/inmetro/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/perguntas-frequentes/avaliacao-da-conformidade/brinquedos/brinquedos-eletricos-devem-ser-certificados) · [▶ CONTRAN 996](https://www.gov.br/transportes/pt-br/assuntos/transito/conteudo-contran/resolucoes/Resolucao9962023.pdf) · [▶ Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)
inspecao-patinete-eletrico-criancas.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección del **patinete eléctrico** como **locomoción a batería**. El pedido de campo: marca BYD → baterías → **patinetes, niñas/os y peligros**. La ficha empieza en el **objeto que la niña sube**. BYD entra como **genealogía industrial** (célula primero, coche después) — no como vitrina.

> Auditoría independiente. Fuentes: [INMETRO](https://www.gov.br/inmetro/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/perguntas-frequentes/avaliacao-da-conformidade/brinquedos/brinquedos-eletricos-devem-ser-certificados), [CONTRAN 996/2023](https://www.gov.br/transportes/pt-br/assuntos/transito/conteudo-contran/resolucoes/Resolucao9962023.pdf). **No es consejo médico, jurídico ni de compra. No es endoso.**

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Objeto | Patinete eléctrico — ruedas + motor + **batería** |
| Recorte | Infancia; cuerpo, vía y celda |
| Distinto de | Patinete de empujar · e-bike · ciclomotor · coche BYD |
| Fecha | 2026-08-21 |

## Tres clases que el marketplace pega

| Clase | Ancla |
|-------|--------|
| **Juguete eléctrico** | Máx. **24 V** + sello INMETRO. Por encima de 24 V, o para vía pública, **no** es juguete. |
| **Autopropulsado** | ≤ **1000 W**, ≤ **32 km/h**; timbre, luces, limitador. La 996 **no** fija edad mínima. |
| **Ciclomotor** | Por encima — ACC / categoría A, registro. |

## La batería

**BYD** (1995) es **empresa de celdas que después hizo coches**. Blade Battery (LFP, 2020) es oficio industrial. El pack del patinete infantil **no hereda** ese ensayo. Misma física ([fuego](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fogo.html)); otro objeto.

Cargar con el cargador del objeto, a la vista, sobre superficie dura. Pack hinchado = fuera de servicio.

## Peligros infantiles

Caída y cabeza; velocidad × edad; mezcla con coches; motor silencioso; segundo pasajero (en regla, prohibido); masa del aparato; agua; celular en el manillar ([ficha del celular](/posts/post-inspecao-celular-riscos-saude-criancas.html)). «Es solo un juguete» es **claim**.

## Estado

**Aprobada** — locomoción a batería; tres capas de riesgo; BYD solo como genealogía de la celda. Sin endoso. Sin edad mágica.

inspecao-palavra-tanzania.excerptEn: Words: “Tanzânia” — country (Tan+Zan+-ia, 1964); Taz = clipping; ≠ Tasmania; relation with the slip Taz Manaia; Valeu !!!
inspecao-palavra-tanzania.excerptEs: Palabras: «Tanzânia» — país (Tan+Zan+-ia, 1964); Taz = hipocorístico; ≠ Tasmania; relación con el lapsus Taz Manaia; ¡Valeu !!!
inspecao-palavra-tanzania.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **Tanzânia** — the East African **country** (EN/Swahili **Tanzania**). Field request: **relation** with **[Taz Manaia](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-taz-manaia.html)**. The name is a 1964 portmanteau: **Tan**ganyika + **Zan**zibar + **-ia**. **Tanzania ≠ Tasmania**. **Taz** is a clipping and also the Looney Tunes devil. **Taz Manaia** is a slip toward *Taz-Mania* plus Māori *manaia* — not a verified public biography. Links: [relation](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-relacao.html), [Mozambique](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mocambique.html), [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Sources: [Tanzânia](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tanz%C3%A2nia), [Tanganyika](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tanganica), [Zanzibar](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zanzibar). **Not a travel guide.**

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Anchor | **Tanzânia** · **Tanzania** |
| Etymon | Tan + Zan + -ia (1964) |
| Capital | Dodoma (official); Dar es Salaam = largest city |
| Not | [Tasmania](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tasm%C3%A2nia) · *Taz-Mania* · invented celebrity |
| Date | 2026-08-21 |

## 2. Seems vs is

**Seems:** Taz Manaia is the country’s mascot or a famous person from Tanzania.  
**Is:** Tanzania is a **state**. Taz is a **nickname** and a **cartoon**. [Taz Manaia](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-taz-manaia.html) is an **oral slip**. The [relation](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-relacao.html) is lexical — the *between* — not a biography.

## 3. Correction

**Tanzânia = country.** If the mouth said *Taz Manaia*, open this sheet **and** [Taz Manaia](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-taz-manaia.html). Close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Status

**Approved** — country sheet; slip and relation separated.

[▶ Words](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-palavras) · [▶ Taz Manaia](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-taz-manaia.html) · [▶ Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)
inspecao-palavra-tanzania.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **Tanzânia** — el **país** de África Oriental (EN/suajili **Tanzania**). Pedido: **relación** con **[Taz Manaia](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-taz-manaia.html)**. El nombre es portmanteau de 1964: **Tan**ganica + **Zan**zíbar + **-ia**. **Tanzanía ≠ Tasmania**. **Taz** es hipocorístico y también el diablo de Looney Tunes. **Taz Manaia** es lapsus hacia *Taz-Mania* más el *manaia* māori — no biografía pública verificada. Vínculos: [relação](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-relacao.html), [Moçambique](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mocambique.html), [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Fuentes: [Tanzânia](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tanz%C3%A2nia). **No es guía de viaje.**

## 1. Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Ancla | **Tanzânia** · **Tanzania** |
| Étimo | Tan + Zan + -ia (1964) |
| Capital | Dodoma (oficial); Dar es-Salam = ciudad mayor |
| No es | [Tasmania](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tasm%C3%A2nia) · *Taz-Mania* · celebridad inventada |
| Fecha | 2026-08-21 |

## 2. Parece × es

**Parece:** Taz Manaia es la mascota del país o alguien famoso.  
**Es:** Tanzania es un **Estado**. Taz es **apodo** y **dibujo**. [Taz Manaia](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-taz-manaia.html) es **lapsus oral**. La [relação](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-relacao.html) es léxica — el *entre* — no biografía.

## 3. Corrección

**Tanzânia = país.** Si la boca dijo *Taz Manaia*, abrir esta ficha **y** [Taz Manaia](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-taz-manaia.html). Cerrar con [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Estado

**Aprobada** — ficha de país; lapsus y relación separados.

inspecao-palavra-taz-manaia.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of the field form **Taz Manaia** — glued to **[Tanzânia](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tanzania.html)** by the request *relation with taz manaia*. This lab found **no stable public biography**. It reads an **oral object**: **Taz-Mania** (Warner, 1991–1995) written as a personal name, the clipping **Taz** (Tanzania × Tasmanian Devil), and Māori **manaia** (guardian / messenger in carving). Links: [relation](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-relacao.html), [meneia](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-meneia.html) (PT homophony only), [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Sources: [Taz-Mania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taz-Mania), [Manaia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manaia_(mythological_creature)). **Not a biography. Not Māori ethnography.** Name the manaia with [respect](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-respeito.html).

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Anchor | **Taz Manaia** |
| Not | the country [Tanzânia](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tanzania.html) · a verified Person sheet |
| Date | 2026-08-21 |

## 2. Seems vs is

**Seems:** a famous person from Tanzania.  
**Is:** a **slip-cluster**. Tanzania is the [country sheet](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tanzania.html). *Taz-Mania* is a cartoon on a poster Tasmania. *Manaia* is a Māori motif — not a Taz mascot.

## 3. Correction

**Taz Manaia = oral slip.** Country = [Tanzânia](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tanzania.html). The [relation](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-relacao.html) is the lexical *between* (Taz as clipping), not a life story. Close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Status

**Approved** — slip sheet; relation named without inventing a person.

inspecao-palavra-taz-manaia.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de la forma de campo **Taz Manaia** — pegada a **[Tanzânia](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tanzania.html)** por el pedido *relación con taz manaia*. Este lab **no** halló biografía pública estable. Lee un **objeto oral**: **Taz-Mania** (Warner, 1991–1995) escrito como antropónimo, el recorte **Taz** (Tanzania × demonio de Tasmania) y el **manaia** māori (guardián / mensajero en la talla). Vínculos: [relação](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-relacao.html), [meneia](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-meneia.html) (solo homofonía PT), [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Fuentes: [Taz-Mania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taz-Mania), [Manaia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manaia_(mythological_creature)). **No es biografía ni etnografía māori.** Nombrar el manaia con [respeito](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-respeito.html).

## 1. Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Ancla | **Taz Manaia** |
| No es | el país [Tanzânia](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tanzania.html) · ficha de Persona verificada |
| Fecha | 2026-08-21 |

## 2. Parece × es

**Parece:** alguien famoso de Tanzania.  
**Es:** un **lapsus-cluster**. Tanzania es la [ficha del país](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tanzania.html). *Taz-Mania* es dibujo en una Tasmania de cartel. *Manaia* es motivo māori — no mascota del Taz.

## 3. Corrección

**Taz Manaia = lapsus oral.** País = [Tanzânia](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tanzania.html). La [relação](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-relacao.html) es el *entre* léxico (Taz como recorte), no una vida. Cerrar con [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Estado

**Aprobada** — ficha de lapsus; relación nombrada sin inventar persona.

inspecao-palavra-xiaomi.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of **[Xiaomi](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-xiaomi.html)** — correct brand spelling (pinyin). Field input *xioomi*; correction like [Grok](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-grok.html): *xioomi* → **Xiaomi**. Covers the **lexical object**, the Chinese etymon 小米 *xiǎomǐ* (“millet / little rice”), the **layer clash** (humble grain × handset × tech idol), and the BudGanja correction: [object](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-objetos.html) with a trail, no brand pedestal. Links: [Jobs](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-jobs.html), [ídolo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-idolo.html), [skill](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-skill.html), [phone / children](/posts/post-inspecao-celular-riscos-saude-criancas.html), [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Method note: [Xiaomi](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Xiaomi), [小米](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%E5%B0%8F%E7%B1%B3), [Xiaomi (EN)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Xiaomi). **Not a product review, not a founder biography.** *xioomi* is a trail (like [sozna](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sozna.html)); the anchor is **Xiaomi**.

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Anchor | **Xiaomi** (correct) · *xioomi* (BR oral trail) · **小米** millet |
| Path | Chin. *xiǎomǐ* “millet” × 2010 Beijing brand × BR pronunciation *xiômi* |
| Links | [Jobs](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-jobs.html) · [ídolo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-idolo.html) · [objects](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-objetos.html) · [phone](/posts/post-inspecao-celular-riscos-saude-criancas.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-21 |

## 2. Seems vs is

**Seems:** cheap-phone shortcut / “iPhone of the poor”.  
**Is:** the **correct brand name** on a **grain**; *xioomi* is the BR trail. Price without a trail is only price. The [phone risk](/posts/post-inspecao-celular-riscos-saude-criancas.html) does not change with the logo.

## 3. BudGanja correction

**Xiaomi ≠ consumption manual.** If you say Xiaomi, know whether you mean a **word**, a **brand**, or **this** device. *xioomi* → **Xiaomi**. Admire the deed ([genial](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-genial.html)) without handing the [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) to the logo. Treat the handset as an [object](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-objetos.html). Close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

**Approved** — **Xiaomi** (*xioomi* → Xiaomi) × millet 小米; anti-pedestal; links [Jobs](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-jobs.html) · [ídolo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-idolo.html) · [phone](/posts/post-inspecao-celular-riscos-saude-criancas.html); [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Scope

Do not confuse with **ICL Cursos e Preparatórios** ([iclcursos.com.br](https://iclcursos.com.br/)) — a different exam-prep school.

Founded **2020** by Eduardo Moreira, Rafael Donatiello and Jessé Souza. 200–400+ recorded courses behind a subscription; journalism on the free portal and YouTube (~8 h/day). Postgraduate *lato sensu* with [FESPSP](https://www.fespsp.org.br/). The institute **states a progressive/left stance** — recorded as fact, not as this lab's vote.

Does **not** replace [UNIFESP cannabis extension](/posts/post-inspecao-curso-unifesp-cannabis-medicinal.html) or [ESAPP Agronomy](/posts/post-inspecao-esapp-agronomia-paraguacu-paulista.html).

inspecao-plataformas-ensino-govbr.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial map of **Brazil’s free federal learning stack** under [gov.br](https://www.gov.br/) / [MEC](https://www.gov.br/mec/pt-br): **video** ([Canal Educação](https://www.youtube.com/@canaleducacaobr) — @canaleducacaobr), **languages** ([MEC Idiomas](https://www.gov.br/mec/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/perguntas-frequentes/mec-idiomas) — English and Spanish), **books** ([MEC Livros](https://meclivros.mec.gov.br/)), plus **AVAMEC** (courses/certificates) and **MEC Enem** (exam practice). Independent audit; **no affiliation**. Catalogues and loan rules change. **Cataloguing ≠ political endorsement.**

One login: **gov.br** (CPF). Apps also listed at [aplicativos.mec.gov.br](https://aplicativos.mec.gov.br/).

| Need | Open |
|------|------|
| Educational TV / YouTube | [Canal Educação](https://www.youtube.com/@canaleducacaobr) · live [EBC](https://canaleducacao.ebc.com.br/) |
| English / Spanish | [MEC Idiomas](https://www.gov.br/mec/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/perguntas-frequentes/mec-idiomas) |
| Free library | [MEC Livros](https://meclivros.mec.gov.br/) — ~8k titles at 2026 launch; 14-day loans on licensed works |
| Certified short courses | [AVAMEC](https://avamec.mec.gov.br/) |
| Enem drills / AI essay | [MEC Enem](https://app.mecenem.mec.gov.br) |

Does **not** replace the [UNIFESP cannabis extension](/posts/post-inspecao-curso-unifesp-cannabis-medicinal.html) or paid [ICL Courses](/posts/post-inspecao-icl-cursos.html). Screen-time limits still apply ([phone × children](/posts/post-inspecao-celular-riscos-saude-criancas.html)). Canal Educação is **not** ingested into this lab’s cultivation [/videos/](/videos/) hub.

## Status

**Approved** as the public-education map on the academic-extension series. Confirm access on official pages.

[▶ Books](https://meclivros.mec.gov.br/) · [▶ Languages](https://www.gov.br/mec/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/perguntas-frequentes/mec-idiomas) · [▶ Canal Educação](https://www.youtube.com/@canaleducacaobr) · [▶ gov.br](https://www.gov.br/)
inspecao-plataformas-ensino-govbr.contentEs:
## Alcance

Mapa editorial de la **oferta federal gratuita de enseñanza** en [gov.br](https://www.gov.br/) / [MEC](https://www.gov.br/mec/pt-br): **vídeo** ([Canal Educação](https://www.youtube.com/@canaleducacaobr) — @canaleducacaobr), **idiomas** ([MEC Idiomas](https://www.gov.br/mec/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/perguntas-frequentes/mec-idiomas) — inglés y español), **libros** ([MEC Livros](https://meclivros.mec.gov.br/)), más **AVAMEC** (cursos/certificados) y **MEC Enem** (simulacros). Auditoría independiente; **sin afiliación**. Los acervos cambian. **Indexar ≠ respaldo político.**

Un login: **gov.br** (CPF). Apps en [aplicativos.mec.gov.br](https://aplicativos.mec.gov.br/).

| Quiero | Abrir |
|--------|-------|
| TV educativa / YouTube | [Canal Educação](https://www.youtube.com/@canaleducacaobr) · vivo [EBC](https://canaleducacao.ebc.com.br/) |
| Inglés / español | [MEC Idiomas](https://www.gov.br/mec/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/perguntas-frequentes/mec-idiomas) |
| Biblioteca gratuita | [MEC Livros](https://meclivros.mec.gov.br/) — ~8 mil obras en el lanzamiento 2026; préstamo 14 días en obras licenciadas |
| Cursos con certificado | [AVAMEC](https://avamec.mec.gov.br/) |
| Enem / redacción con IA | [MEC Enem](https://app.mecenem.mec.gov.br) |

**No** sustituye el [curso UNIFESP](/posts/post-inspecao-curso-unifesp-cannabis-medicinal.html) ni los [cursos ICL](/posts/post-inspecao-icl-cursos.html) de pago. El tiempo de pantalla sigue contando ([celular × niños](/posts/post-inspecao-celular-riscos-saude-criancas.html)). Canal Educação **no** entra en el hub [/videos/](/videos/) de cultivo de este laboratorio.

## Estado

**Aprobada** como ficha-mapa de enseñanza pública. Confirmar el acceso en las páginas oficiales.

inspecao-palavra-cuca.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of Brazilian **Cuca** — the **children’s bogey** of the lullaby (“nana neném, que a Cuca vem pegar”) and of Monteiro Lobato’s *Sítio do Picapau Amarelo* (alligator-headed witch). Also notes the slang *cuca* = “head,” and the diminutive **cucuca**. Not a streamer bio.

> Independent audit. Sources: [Wiktionary](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/cuca), [Cuca (folklore)](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cuca_(folclore)). Respect for the child: [fear](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-medo.html) is named, not used as a weapon.

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word / figure | **Cuca** (diminutive **cucuca**) |
| Anchor | Brazilian children’s lore + *Sítio* |
| Links | [fear](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-medo.html) · [respect](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-respeito.html) · [every child is born a scientist](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-toda-crianca-nasce-cientista.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-21 |

## Status

**Approved** — children’s-story Cuca filed; *cucuca* = diminutive of the same figure; game handles stay off this sheet.

[▶ Words](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-palavras) · [▶ Fear](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-medo.html) · [▶ Respect](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-respeito.html) · [▶ Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)
inspecao-palavra-cuca.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de la **Cuca** brasileña — el **bicho de historia infantil** (nana «que a Cuca vem pegar») y la bruja de cabeza de caimán del *Sítio do Picapau Amarelo*. También la jerga *cuca* = cabeza, y el diminutivo **cucuca**. No es ficha de streamer.

> Auditoría independiente. Fuentes: [Wikcionario](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/cuca), [Cuca (folclore)](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cuca_(folclore)). [Miedo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-medo.html) con [respeto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-respeito.html) a la infancia.

## Estado

**Aprobada** — Cuca de cuento infantil; *cucuca* = diminutivo; el canal de juego queda aparte.

inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.titleEn: Inspection: Trocadilho — face + garlic, and why it is not polymorphism
inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.titleEs: Inspección: Trocadilho — cara + ajo, y por qué no es polimorfismo
inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.excerptEn: Words: pun / calembour — cara+alho is a joke + folk etymology, not polymorphism or a portmanteau; sisters agglutination and Tanzania; Valeu !!!
inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.excerptEs: Palabras: trocadilho (calembur) — cara+alho es juego + etimología popular, no polimorfismo ni palabra-valija; hermanas aglutinación y Tanzanía; ¡Valeu !!!
inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **trocadilho** (pun / Fr. *calembour*). Field request: *cara* + *alho* forming another meaning — is that **polymorphism**? Lab answer: **no**. This sheet names the **joke**. Sisters: [aglutinação](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aglutinacao.html) (real compounding) and [polimorfismo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-polimorfismo.html) (many forms, other craft). True portmanteau: [Tanzânia](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tanzania.html).

> Independent audit. Sources: [Trocadilho](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trocadilho), [portmanteau](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Palavra-valise). The *cara+alho* gag lands on an existing **swear-word** — the sheet inspects the **mechanism**, not the insult.

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **trocadilho** · **calembur** |
| Field request | face + garlic → another word; polymorphism? |
| Not | [polymorphism](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-polimorfismo.html) · historical agglutination of that vocable · a newly coined blend |
| Date | 2026-08-21 |

## 2. Four names

| Name | What it does | Lab example |
|------|----------------|-------------|
| **Pun / calembour** | Read A+B as C | *cara* + *alho* |
| **[Agglutination](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aglutinacao.html)** | Pieces fuse into a real compound | *planalto* |
| **Portmanteau** | Blend that **creates** a word | [Tanzania](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tanzania.html) |
| **[Polymorphism](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-polimorfismo.html)** | Many forms of the same thing | biology / code — **not** this joke |

**Verdict:** the joining that makes another meaning here is a **pun**. [Folk etymology](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-etimologia.html) ≠ etymon.

## Status

**Approved** — pun named; polymorphism refused; agglutination and portmanteau kept apart.

[▶ Words](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-palavras) · [▶ Agglutination](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aglutinacao.html) · [▶ Polymorphism](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-polimorfismo.html) · [▶ Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)
inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **trocadilho** (juego de palabras / *calembur*). Pedido: *cara* + *alho* forman otro sentido — ¿es **polimorfismo**? Respuesta del lab: **no**. Esta ficha nombra el **juego**. Hermanas: [aglutinação](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aglutinacao.html) y [polimorfismo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-polimorfismo.html). Palabra-valija verdadera: [Tanzânia](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tanzania.html).

> Auditoría independiente. Fuentes: [Trocadilho](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trocadilho). El gag *cara+alho* desemboca en un **taco** ya existente — se inspecciona el **mecanismo**, no el insulto.

## 1. Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Palabra | **trocadilho** · **calembur** |
| No es | [polimorfismo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-polimorfismo.html) · aglutinación histórica de ese vocablo |
| Fecha | 2026-08-21 |

## 2. Cuatro nombres

**Trocadilho** = el juego. **[Aglutinação](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aglutinacao.html)** = soldadura gramatical real. **Palabra-valija** = [Tanzânia](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tanzania.html). **[Polimorfismo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-polimorfismo.html)** = varias formas — **no** este chiste.

## Estado

**Aprobada** — juego nombrado; polimorfismo rechazado.
