inspecao-palavra-aglutinacao.titleEn: Inspection: Agglutination — grammatical fusion (and why cara+alho only looks like it)
inspecao-palavra-aglutinacao.titleEs: Inspección: Aglutinación — la soldadura gramatical (y por qué cara+alho solo parece)
inspecao-palavra-aglutinacao.excerptEn: Words: agglutination — compounding by fusion (planalto); cara+alho is a mask, the right name is pun; ≠ polymorphism; Valeu !!!
inspecao-palavra-aglutinacao.excerptEs: Palabras: aglutinación — composición por fusión (planalto); cara+alho es máscara, el nombre cierto es trocadilho; ≠ polimorfismo; ¡Valeu !!!
inspecao-palavra-aglutinacao.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **aglutinação** — school-grammar **compounding by fusion** (pieces glue and lose a slice). The *cara+alho* gag *looks* like this; the sister sheet [trocadilho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html) shows it is a **pun**, not the etymon. True portmanteau: [Tanzânia](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tanzania.html).

> Independent audit. Source: [Composition](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Composi%C3%A7%C3%A3o_(lingu%C3%ADstica)). Not a morphology treatise. Not clinical agglutination of cells.

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **aglutinação** (agglutination) |
| Pair | juxtaposition (*guarda-chuva*) vs fusion (*planalto*) |
| Not | [pun](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html) · [polymorphism](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-polimorfismo.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-21 |

**Verdict:** agglutination **gives birth** to the compound. *Cara+alho* only **wears** that mask.

## Status

**Approved** — fusion compounding filed; the garlic joke sent to [trocadilho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html).

[▶ Words](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-palavras) · [▶ Pun](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html) · [▶ Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)
inspecao-palavra-aglutinacao.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **aglutinação** — composición escolar por **fusión** (las piezas se pegan y pierden un trozo). El gag *cara+alho* **parece** esto; la ficha [trocadilho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html) muestra que es **juego**, no étimo. Palabra-valija: [Tanzânia](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tanzania.html).

> Auditoría independiente. Fuente: [Composición](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Composi%C3%A7%C3%A3o_(lingu%C3%ADstica)). No es aglutinación clínica de células.

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Palabra | **aglutinação** |
| Par | yuxtaposición (*guarda-chuva*) × fusión (*planalto*) |
| No es | [trocadilho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html) · [polimorfismo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-polimorfismo.html) |
| Fecha | 2026-08-21 |

## Estado

**Aprobada** — fusión gramatical fichada; el chiste del ajo va a [trocadilho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html).

[▶ Palabras](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-palavras) · [▶ Trocadilho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html) · [▶ ¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)

inspecao-palavra-polimorfismo.titleEn: Inspection: Polymorphism — many forms of the same (not cara+alho)
inspecao-palavra-polimorfismo.titleEs: Inspección: Polimorfismo — varias formas de lo mismo (no es cara+alho)
inspecao-palavra-polimorfismo.excerptEn: Words: polymorphism (poly+morphē) — biology, code, allomorphy; cara+alho is not this, it is a pun; sister agglutination; Valeu !!!
inspecao-palavra-polimorfismo.excerptEs: Palabras: polimorfismo (poly+morphē) — biología, código, alomorfia; cara+alho no es esto, es trocadilho; hermana aglutinación; ¡Valeu !!!
inspecao-palavra-polimorfismo.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **polimorfismo** (polymorphism) — **many forms** of the same thing. Field request: is *cara+alho* polymorphism? Lab answer: **no**. That joke is a [pun](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html). This sheet covers biology, programming, and (at the edge) allomorphy. Grammatical fusion: [aglutinação](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aglutinacao.html).

> Independent audit. Sources: [Polymorphism](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polimorfismo), [biology](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polimorfismo_(biologia)), [OOP](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polimorfismo_(programa%C3%A7%C3%A3o_orientada_a_objetos)). Not a genetics lecture.

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **polimorfismo** · *poly-* + *morphē* |
| Crafts | biology · programming · allomorphy |
| Not | [pun](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html) · [agglutination](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aglutinacao.html) · portmanteau |
| Date | 2026-08-21 |

**Verdict:** polymorphism = many forms **of the same**. *Cara+alho* = two pieces **read as** a third that **already was something else**.

## Status

**Approved** — polymorphism filed; the garlic joke sent to [trocadilho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html).

[▶ Words](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-palavras) · [▶ Pun](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html) · [▶ Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)
inspecao-palavra-polimorfismo.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **polimorfismo** — **varias formas** de lo mismo. Pedido: ¿*cara+alho* es polimorfismo? Respuesta: **no**. Ese juego es [trocadilho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html). Esta ficha cubre biología, programación y (al margen) alomorfia. Fusión gramatical: [aglutinação](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aglutinacao.html).

> Auditoría independiente. Fuentes: [Polimorfismo](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polimorfismo). No es clase de genética.

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Palabra | **polimorfismo** · *poly-* + *morphē* |
| Oficios | biología · código · alomorfia |
| No es | [trocadilho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html) · [aglutinação](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aglutinacao.html) |
| Fecha | 2026-08-21 |

## Estado

**Aprobada** — polimorfismo fichado; el chiste del ajo va a [trocadilho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html).

inspecao-palavra-sinais-rem.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of Portuguese **[sinais REM](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sinais-rem.html)** — the **field of marks** (plural of [sinal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sinal.html)) under **two REM readings that do not fuse**: (1) **REM sleep** (*Rapid Eye Movement*), (2) the lab acronym **Relaxation · Endocannabinoid · Modular**. Contrast: signals ≠ sign-name ≠ [mensagem](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mensagem.html). Links: [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html), [nap](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-nap.html), [Sidarta](/posts/post-inspecao-sidarta-ribeiro.html), [endocannabinoidome](/posts/post-inspecao-neurociencia-endocanabinoidoma.html), [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Method note: [Wikipedia · REM sleep](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rapid_eye_movement_sleep), [Wiktionary · REM](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/REM#English). **Not** a sleep study, diagnosis, or dosing sheet. The lab acronym is a BudGanja craft map, not an official medical expansion.

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Form | **sinais REM** |
| REM 1 | Rapid Eye Movement — sleep stage (Aserinsky & Kleitman, 1953) |
| REM 2 | Relaxation · Endocannabinoid · Modular — lab map |
| Not | A single [sinal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sinal.html) · a full [message](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mensagem.html) · a clinical staging |
| Date | 2026-08-21 |

## 2. Two REM

Sleep column = physiological marks (rapid eyes, atonia, vivid dream reports, irregular autonomic). Lab column = tone drop, endogenous SEC, next-step modulation. Shared letters ≠ shared object.

## 3. Craft signals (lab)

[Tônus](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonos.html) / [peito](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-coracao.html) · [água](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-agua.html) · [sol](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sol.html) · [nap](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-nap.html) as readable [gestos](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) — not a sleep protocol.

## 4. Valeu !!!

Best possible **with the signals in view**, today. Anti-trap: “everything is a REM signal” without method = superstition.

## Status

**Approved** — plural field · two REM · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-palavra-sinais-rem.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **[sinais REM](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sinais-rem.html)** — el **campo de marcas** (plural de [sinal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sinal.html)) bajo **dos REM que no se funden**: (1) **sueño REM** (*Rapid Eye Movement*), (2) la sigla de oficio **Relajación · Endocanabinoide · Modular**. Contraste: señales ≠ signo-nombre ≠ [mensagem](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mensagem.html). Vínculos: [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html), [nap](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-nap.html), [Sidarta](/posts/post-inspecao-sidarta-ribeiro.html), [endocanabinoidoma](/posts/post-inspecao-neurociencia-endocanabinoidoma.html), [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Nota: [Wikipedia · sueño REM](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sono_REM). **No** es polisomnografía ni bula. La sigla del lab es mapa de oficio, no acrónimo clínico oficial.

## 1. Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Forma | **sinais REM** |
| REM 1 | Rapid Eye Movement — fase del sueño |
| REM 2 | Relajación · Endocanabinoide · Modular — mapa del lab |
| No es | Un solo [sinal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sinal.html) · un [mensaje](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mensagem.html) completo |
| Fecha | 2026-08-21 |

## 2. Dos REM

Columna sueño = marcas fisiológicas. Columna lab = tono, SEC endógeno, ajuste. Las mismas letras ≠ el mismo objeto.

## 3. Señales de oficio

[Tônus](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonos.html) / [pecho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-coracao.html) · [água](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-agua.html) · [sol](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sol.html) · [nap](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-nap.html) como [gestos](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) legibles — no protocolo de sueño.

## 4. ¡Valeu !!!

Lo mejor posible **con las señales a la vista**, hoy. Anti-trampa: «todo es señal REM» sin método = superstición.

## Estado

**Aprobado** — campo en plural · dos REM · [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-palavra-objetos-perigosos-incen.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial map of **dangerous objects for fire control** in the indoor lab — what can ignite, what cuts / warns / extinguishes, and brand names that only label SKUs. Field request: Mars Hydro BR, Vivosun, word origins, all related objects. **Not a fire-department manual.** Links: [fogo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fogo.html), [incêndio](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-incendio.html), [Mars Hydro](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mars-hydro.html), [Vivosun](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vivosun.html), [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Sources: [Fire (event)](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inc%C3%AAndio). **Not NR-23, not an extinguisher tutorial, not a brand ranking.** Logo ≠ electrical inspection.

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Anchor | **objectos perigosos para controle de incêndio** |
| Columns | Hazard × control × brand name |
| Date | 2026-08-21 |

## 2. Seems vs is

**Seems:** “I bought Mars / Vivosun, so it’s safe.”  
**Is:** electrical [objects](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-objetos.html) inside a [tent](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tenda.html); [risk](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html) lives in the **circuit** ([fonte](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fonte.html), [extensão](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-extensao.html)), not the logo.

## 3. Related objects

Brands: [Mars Hydro](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mars-hydro.html) · [Vivosun](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vivosun.html). Enclosure: [tenda](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tenda.html) · [exaustor](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-exaustor.html). Circuit: [fonte](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fonte.html) · [extensão](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-extensao.html) · [interruptor](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-interruptor.html). Element: [fogo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fogo.html) · [incêndio](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-incendio.html) · [extintor](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-extintor.html). Light: [lâmpada](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lampada.html) · [sol](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sol.html).

## 4. BudGanja correction

**Brand ≠ fire control.** Name the thing, put it in the right column, keep the [switch](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-interruptor.html) reachable. Close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Status

**Approved** — cluster map; word origins; related objects; [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-palavra-objetos-perigosos-incen.contentEs:
## Alcance

Mapa editorial de **objetos peligrosos para control de incendio** en el lab indoor — lo que puede encender, lo que corta / avisa / apaga, y las marcas que solo nombran el SKU. Pedido: Mars Hydro BR, Vivosun, origen de la palabra, todos los objetos relacionados. **No es manual de bomberos.** Vínculos: [fogo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fogo.html), [incêndio](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-incendio.html), [Mars Hydro](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mars-hydro.html), [Vivosun](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vivosun.html), [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Fuentes: [Incendio](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inc%C3%AAndio). **No es NR-23 ni ranking de marcas.** El logo no inspecciona el circuito.

## 1. Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Ancla | **objectos perigosos para controle de incêndio** |
| Columnas | Peligro × control × nombre de marca |
| Fecha | 2026-08-21 |

## 2. Parece × es

**Parece:** «compré Mars / Vivosun, está seguro».  
**Es:** [objetos](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-objetos.html) eléctricos dentro de una [tenda](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tenda.html); el [riesgo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html) está en el **circuito**.

## 3. Objetos relacionados

Marcas: [Mars Hydro](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mars-hydro.html) · [Vivosun](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vivosun.html). Recinto: [tenda](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tenda.html) · [exaustor](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-exaustor.html). Circuito: [fonte](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fonte.html) · [extensão](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-extensao.html) · [interruptor](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-interruptor.html). inspecao-palavra-fonte.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **fonte** as **power supply / LED driver** (Lat. *fons* “spring”). The hidden fire object behind the panel.

> Sources: [fonte](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/fonte). Other senses (spring, typeface, source) are not this sheet.

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Anchor | **fonte** |
| Path | Lat. *fons* → BR electrical slang “PSU / driver” |
| Cluster | [Fire-control map](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-objetos-perigosos-incendio.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-21 |

## 2. Seems vs is

**Seems:** the diodes are the hazard  
**Is:** often the **driver** against the mylar or on a skinny strip

## 3. BudGanja correction

**Name the driver as its own object.** Ventilate it; switch upstream. Close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Status

**Approved** — fonte; [fire cluster](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-objetos-perigosos-incendio.html); [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-palavra-exaustor.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **exaustor** (inline / exhaust fan) — the motor that empties the tent. Related to Mars iFresh and Vivosun AeroWave.

> Sources: [exaustor](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/exaustor). Airflow numbers live in the [ventilation sheet](/posts/post-inspecao-ventilacao-tenda.html).

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Anchor | **exaustor** |
| Path | Lat. *exhaurīre* “to drain / exhaust” |
| Cluster | [Fire-control map](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-objetos-perigosos-incendio.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-21 |

## 2. Seems vs is

**Seems:** ventilation is only climate  
**Is:** also an electrical motor against fabric and a carbon filter

## 3. BudGanja correction

**Size the fan; don’t pinch the duct; count its watts on the strip.** Close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Status

**Approved** — exaustor; [fire cluster](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-objetos-perigosos-incendio.html); [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Method note: word sheet ≠ clinical anatomy. Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

| Craft signal | the field, not one mark |

> Nota: ficha ≠ anatomía clínica. Cierre: [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

In 2026 the 13th falls on Friday three times (13 Feb, 13 Mar, **13 Nov**). The inspector works 13 November like the 12th or the 14th.

## Scope

Editorial inspection of **impression / pressure** (*impressão* / *pressão*). Field request also placed the **pressure cooker** and the **release valve**. Shared etymon: Lat. *premere* (“to press”). Pressure is the force; impression is the mark pressed **in**; the cooker is the vessel; the valve is the escape before [risk](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html) has no map.

> Independent audit. Sources: [Wiktionary](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/impress%C3%A3o), [pressure cooker](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Panela_de_press%C3%A3o), [Papin](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Denis_Papin). **Sheet ≠ cooking manual, ≠ how to block a valve, ≠ blood-pressure protocol.**

**H1:** impression = *in-* + pressure — force leaving a mark.  
**H2:** expression presses **out**; impression presses **in**.

inspecao-planta-alecrim-do-campo.contentEn:
## Scope

Educational inspection of **Field rosemary (alecrim-do-campo)** (*Baccharis dracunculifolia DC.*) from the Inspetor BudGanja medicinal plants catalog. This report restates the public plant sheet with a verifiable lab method — it is **not** a clinical protocol and **does not replace** professional health advice.

> **Method note:** independent BudGanja audit based on the catalog entry at [/plantas/alecrim-do-campo/](/plantas/alecrim-do-campo/). Educational content only.

## Inspected object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Common name | **Field rosemary (alecrim-do-campo)** |
| Scientific name | *Baccharis dracunculifolia DC.* |
| Family | Asteraceae |
| Catalog slug | `alecrim-do-campo` |
| Inspection date | 2026-08-21 |

## Summary

Cerrado native shrub (*Baccharis dracunculifolia*) — golden rosemary / vassourinha; botanical source of Brazilian green propolis (artepillin C). Do not confuse with kitchen rosemary (*Salvia rosmarinus*).

## Parts used

- Leaves and vegetative apices (traditional infusion)
- Flowers / golden inflorescences
- Bud resin (collected by bees → green propolis)

## Traditional uses (catalog)

- Folk infusion of leaves and flowers (cultural craft, not clinical posology)
- Digestive, respiratory and antiseptic-rinse tradition
- Botanical source of Brazilian green propolis (*Apis mellifera*)
- Pioneer species in restoring degraded land (ecological context)

## Cautions

Contraindicated in pregnancy and nursing. Not recommended under age 12. People on hypoglycemics: monitor glucose — tea does not replace medicine. Avoid excessive or prolonged use without guidance. Do not confuse with kitchen rosemary (*Salvia rosmarinus*) or carqueja (*Baccharis trimera*). Educational — avoid self-medication.


## Identity and etymology

**Field rosemary**, **golden rosemary** and **vassourinha** name *Baccharis dracunculifolia* DC. (Asteraceae) — a South American shrub common in the Cerrado. The epithet *dracunculifolia* describes the narrow leaf. **Not** kitchen [rosemary](/plantas/alecrim/) (*Salvia rosmarinus*, Lamiaceae). Mature twigs dry and brittle; bright-green lanceolate leaves, toothed on young shoots; petal-less golden inflorescences. Same genus as [carqueja](/plantas/carqueja/) (*B. trimera*), a different species.

Field photo by Inspetor BudGanja (21 August 2026) — dense garden shrub with packed narrow leaves:

![Field rosemary in situ — Inspetor BudGanja, 21 August 2026](/imagens/plantas/alecrim-do-campo-campo.jpg)

## Chemistry and markers

| Marker | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| Artepillin C (3,5-diprenyl-p-coumaric acid) | Prenylated phenolic marker of buds and Brazilian green propolis — the most cited chemical link between the plant and the bee product. |
| Baccharin and drupanin | Congener prenylated p-coumaric acids — profile shared by vegetative apices and green propolis. |
| Flavonoids (naringenin, isosakuranetin, kaempferide) | Aerial parts and propolis — phenolic contribution beyond prenylated acids. |
| Essential oil ((E)-nerolidol, spathulenol) | Volatile fraction of leaves and shoots; nerolidol is the most cited constituent of the aromatic fraction. |

**Limits of chemical readout:** profiles vary by cultivar, plant part, drying and preparation. This is **not** a clinical protocol or product assay.

## Uses and benefits (educational context)

| Theme | How the lab frames it |
| --- | --- |
| Botanical source of green propolis | *Apis mellifera* collects resin from buds and apices — the bee product concentrates plant markers (artepillin C). Link to the [honeybee](/animais/abelha/) sheet. This is **not** a supplement endorsement. |
| Traditional infusion (leaves and flowers) | Folk guides describe a short infusion of dried leaves/flowers after the boil (heat off). The lab treats this as **cultural craft**, not clinical posology or diabetes treatment. |
| Digestive, respiratory and topical tradition | Folk use in dyspepsia/gas, airways and antiseptic rinses. Scientific interest (anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, antimicrobial in models) **does not** replace diagnosis or medicine. |
| Glycemic interest (not a treatment) | Phenolics studied in glycemic models — **do not** replace metformin or other hypoglycemics. Hypoglycemia risk if combined with drug. |

**Limits of evidence:** folk tradition and scientific interest **do not** replace diagnosis, prescription or professional care.

## Reinforced cautions

**Contraindicated** in pregnancy and nursing (emmenagogue tradition; uterine-contraction risk cited in safety guides). Not recommended under age 12. People on hypoglycemics: monitor glucose — tea is **not** therapy. Avoid excessive or prolonged use without guidance. Distinguish from [carqueja](/plantas/carqueja/) and [rosemary](/plantas/alecrim/). Educational — avoid self-medication.

- [Inspection: Kitchen rosemary (*Salvia rosmarinus*) — do not confuse](/posts/post-inspecao-planta-alecrim.html)
- [Inspection: Carqueja (*Baccharis trimera*) — same genus](/posts/post-inspecao-planta-carqueja.html)

- [Inspection: Bee derivatives — adulterated honey vs propolis](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-abelha.html)

inspecao-planta-alecrim-do-campo.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección educativa de **Alecrim-do-campo (romero de campo)** (*Baccharis dracunculifolia DC.*) del catálogo de plantas medicinales del Inspetor BudGanja. Este informe reúne la ficha pública con método verificable del laboratorio — **no** es un protocolo clínico y **no sustituye** orientación profesional de salud.

> **Nota metodológica:** auditoría independiente BudGanja a partir de la ficha en [/plantas/alecrim-do-campo/](/plantas/alecrim-do-campo/). Solo contenido educativo.

## Objeto inspeccionado

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Nombre popular | **Alecrim-do-campo (romero de campo)** |
| Nombre científico | *Baccharis dracunculifolia DC.* |
| Familia | Asteraceae |
| Slug del catálogo | `alecrim-do-campo` |
| Fecha de inspección | 2026-08-21 |

## Resumen

Arbusto nativo del Cerrado (*Baccharis dracunculifolia*) — romero dorado / vassourinha; fuente botánica del propóleo verde brasileño (artepilina C). No confundir con el romero de cocina (*Salvia rosmarinus*).

## Partes usadas

- Hojas y ápices vegetativos (infusión tradicional)
- Flores / inflorescencias amarillo-oro
- Resina de brotes (cosecha por abejas → propóleo verde)

## Usos tradicionales (catálogo)

- Infusión popular de hojas y flores (oficio cultural, no posología clínica)
- Tradición digestiva, respiratoria y de enjuagues antisépticos
- Fuente botánica del propóleo verde brasileño (*Apis mellifera*)
- Especie pionera en recuperación de áreas degradadas (contexto ecológico)

## Cuidados

Contraindicado en embarazo y lactancia. No recomendado menores de 12 años. Diabéticos con hipoglucemiantes: monitorizar glucosa — el té no sustituye fármaco. Evitar uso excesivo o prolongado sin orientación. No confundir con romero de cocina (*Salvia rosmarinus*) ni carqueja (*Baccharis trimera*). Contenido educativo — evite automedicación.


## Identidad y etimología

**Alecrim-do-campo**, **alecrim dourado** y **vassourinha** nombran *Baccharis dracunculifolia* DC. (Asteraceae) — arbusto nativo de Sudamérica, frecuente en el Cerrado. El epíteto *dracunculifolia* describe la hoja estrecha. **No es** el [romero de cocina](/plantas/alecrim/) (*Salvia rosmarinus*, Lamiaceae). Ramas maduras secas y quebradizas; hojas lanceoladas verde brillante, dentadas en brotes; inflorescencias amarillo-oro sin pétalos. Mismo género que la [carqueja](/plantas/carqueja/) (*B. trimera*), especie distinta.

Foto de campo del Inspetor BudGanja (21 de agosto de 2026) — arbusto denso de jardín, hojas estrechas:

![Alecrim-do-campo en campo — Inspetor BudGanja, 21 de agosto de 2026](/imagens/plantas/alecrim-do-campo-campo.jpg)

## Química y marcadores

| Marcador | Notas |
| --- | --- |
| Artepilina C (ácido 3,5-diprenil-p-cumárico) | Marcador fenólico prenilado de yemas y del propóleo verde brasileño — el vínculo químico más citado entre la planta y el producto de las abejas. |
| Baccharina y drupanina | Ácidos p-cumáricos prenilados congéneres — perfil compartido entre ápices vegetativos y propóleo verde. |
| Flavonoides (naringenina, isosakuraneetina, kaempferídeo) | Partes aéreas y propóleo — contribución fenólica además de los ácidos prenilados. |
| Aceite esencial ((E)-nerolidol, espatulenol) | Fracción volátil de hojas y brotes; el nerolidol es el constituyente más citado de la fracción aromática. |

**Límites de la lectura química:** los perfiles varían según cultivar, parte usada, secado y preparación. Esto **no** es protocolo clínico ni análisis de producto.

## Usos y beneficios (contexto educativo)

| Tema | Cómo lo enmarca el laboratorio |
| --- | --- |
| Fuente botánica del propóleo verde | *Apis mellifera* recolecta resina de brotes y ápices — el producto de las abejas concentra marcadores de la planta (artepilina C). Vínculo con la ficha de la [abeja](/animais/abelha/). Esto **no** es endoso de suplemento. |
| Infusión tradicional (hojas y flores) | Guías populares describen infusión corta de hojas/flores secas tras el hervor (fuego apagado). El laboratorio lo trata como **oficio cultural**, no como posología clínica ni tratamiento de diabetes. |
| Tradición digestiva, respiratoria y tópica | Uso popular en dispepsia/gases, vías respiratorias y enjuagues antisépticos. El interés científico **no** sustituye diagnóstico ni fármaco. |
| Interés glucémico (no es tratamiento) | Fenólicos estudiados en modelos de glucemia — **no** sustituyen metformina ni otro hipoglucemiante. Riesgo de hipoglucemia si se combina con fármaco. |

**Límites de la evidencia:** la tradición popular y el interés científico **no** sustituyen diagnóstico, prescripción ni seguimiento profesional.

## Cuidados reforzados

**Contraindicado** en embarazo y lactancia (tradición emenagoga). No recomendado menores de 12 años. Diabéticos con hipoglucemiantes: monitorizar glucosa — el té **no** es terapéutica. Evitar uso excesivo o prolongado sin orientación. Distinguir de [carqueja](/plantas/carqueja/) y [romero](/plantas/alecrim/). Contenido educativo — evite automedicación.

inspecao-palavra-etimologia.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **etimologia** (etymology) — the craft of asking where a word came from. The [Words](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-palavras) series already used this method; the word itself had no sheet. Covers Greek *étymon* + *lógos*, **etymon vs folk etymology**, and the cluster [trocadilho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html) · [aglutinação](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aglutinacao.html) · [polimorfismo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-polimorfismo.html).

> Independent audit. Sources: [Etymology](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Etimologia), [folk etymology](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Etimologia_popular). Not a philology treatise. Method: [Duvivier](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-duvivier.html) · [truth](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html).

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **etimologia** · gr. *etymología* |
| Craft | origin → journey → use → caveat |
| Not | folk story that “fits too well” · moral weapon |
| Date | 2026-08-21 |

**Verdict:** etymology seeks the **true** origin (*étymos*). Folk etymology is a **false** story the mouth loves. *Cara+alho* is the lab example — see [trocadilho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html).

## Status

**Approved** — etymology named as the Palavras method; folk ≠ etymon.

inspecao-palavra-etimologia.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **etimologia** — el oficio de preguntar de dónde vino la palabra. La serie [Palabras](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-palavras) ya usaba el método; la palabra **no** tenía ficha. Cubre *étymon* + *lógos*, **étimo × etimología popular**, y el clúster [trocadilho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html) · [aglutinação](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-aglutinacao.html) · [polimorfismo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-polimorfismo.html).

> Auditoría independiente. Fuentes: [Etimología](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Etimologia), [etimología popular](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Etimologia_popular). No es tratado de filología.

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Palabra | **etimologia** · gr. *etymología* |
| Oficio | origen → viaje → uso → reserva |
| No es | historia que «encaja demasiado» · arma moral |
| Fecha | 2026-08-21 |

**Veredicto:** etimología busca el origen **verdadero** (*étymos*). Etimología popular es historia **falsa** que la boca ama. *Cara+alho* — [trocadilho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html).

## Estado

**Aprobada** — etimología fichada como método de Palabras; popular ≠ étimo.

inspecao-expressao-no-na-vida.titleEn: Inspection: nó na vida! — the knot in the arc, not yet disaster
inspecao-expressao-no-na-vida.titleEs: Inspección: nó na vida! — el nudo en el arco, aún no es desastre
inspecao-expressao-no-na-vida.excerptEn: Sayings: “nó na vida!” — knot in the arc of life; pair untying the knot; ≠ disaster; phew after; Valeu !!!
inspecao-expressao-no-na-vida.excerptEs: Dichos: «nó na vida!» — nudo en el arco de la vida; par desatar o nó; ≠ desastre; ufa después; ¡Valeu !!!
inspecao-expressao-no-na-vida.contentEn:
## Scope

Brazilian saying **“nó na vida!”** — a knot in [life](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vida.html). Pair: [desatar o nó](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-desatar-o-no.html). Not yet [desastre](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-desastre.html). Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

```poem
They said life is a thread
and the knot is punishment.
Half a lie.
The knot is the crossing —
where the rope meets itself.

There is a knot in the lace.
There is another in the chest.
There is a third on the map:
the path bends and does not lie.

It is not disaster yet.
It is a loop.
Whoever names the knot
has already begun to untie.
Whoever calls ruin the tightness
tightens more.

Phew comes after —
not in place of the gesture.

Valeu !!!
with the thread in hand,
without pretending life is smooth.
```

## Status

**Approved** — locution of the knot in the arc of life.

inspecao-expressao-no-na-vida.contentEs:
## Alcance

Dicho BR **«nó na vida!»** — nudo en la [vida](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vida.html). Par: [desatar o nó](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-desatar-o-no.html). Aún no es [desastre](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-desastre.html). Cierre: [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

```poem
Dijeron que la vida es un hilo
y el nudo es castigo.
Mentira a medias.
El nudo es el cruce —
donde la cuerda se encuentra a sí.

Hay un nudo en el cordón.
Hay otro en el pecho.
Hay un tercero en el mapa:
el camino dobla y no miente.

Aún no es desastre.
Es lazo.
Quien nombra el nudo
ya empezó a desatar.
Quien llama ruina al apriete
aprieta más.

Ufa viene después —
no en lugar del gesto.

Valeu !!!
con el hilo en la mano,
sin fingir que la vida es lisa.
```

## Estado

**Aprobada** — locución del nudo en el arco de la vida.

inspecao-expressao-desatar-o-no.contentEn:
## Scope

Brazilian saying **“desatar o nó”** (untie the knot). Craft on the [corda](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-corda.html) and in [life](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vida.html). Related to [desastre](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-desastre.html) by **method**, not etymon. After: [ufa](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ufa.html). Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

```poem
The rope does not ask for a sermon.
It asks for the right thread.
The knot is not offended
when the hand inspects
instead of pulling blind.

Untying is not disaster.
Disaster is the ill star —
another ancestor, another sky.
Here the craft is ground:
find the turn,
loosen without cutting life.

Phew is the air that leaves
when the loop yields.
Cool is the smile, if it fits.
Valeu !!!
with the knot still warm —
today, on this remaining rope.
```

## Status

**Approved** — locution of release; disaster is another ancestor.

inspecao-expressao-desatar-o-no.contentEs:
## Alcance

Dicho BR **«desatar o nó»**. Oficio en la [corda](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-corda.html) y en la [vida](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-vida.html). Relacionado con [desastre](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-desastre.html) por **método**, no por étimo. Después: [ufa](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-ufa.html). Cierre: [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

```poem
La cuerda no pide sermón.
Pide el hilo cierto.
El nudo no se ofende
cuando la mano inspecciona
en vez de tirar a ciegas.

Desatar no es desastre.
Desastre es la mala estrella —
otro abuelo, otro cielo.
Aquí el oficio es suelo:
hallar la vuelta,
soltar sin cortar la vida.

Ufa es el aire que sale
cuando el lazo cede.
Legal es la sonrisa, si cabe.
Valeu !!!
con el nudo aún caliente —
hoy, en este resto de cuerda.
```

inspecao-palavra-mara.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of the given name **Mara** in Brazilian Portuguese. Field note: an aunt. It was not the planned sheet. **It took time to arrive. She was thought of all day. It happened.**

The name **sits inside** [maravilha / maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html) (wonder). A short poem: the wonders of **paper boats**.

> Method: [Wiktionary · Mara](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/Mara). **Not an obituary.** The lab files the **name** that arrived.

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **Mara** |
| Lab type | Given name × wonder × paper boat |
| Arrival | Not the day’s intention — **it happened** |
| Wonder link | [maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html) ← *maravilha* ← Lat. *mirabilia* |
| ≠ | [Tamara](/posts/post-inspecao-tamara-klink.html) · Maria · [mar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mar.html) · Skt. *Māra* |
| Date | 2026-08-22 |

Hebrew *mārāh* (“bitter”, Ruth 1:20) is a **layer**, not a verdict on the person.

## 2. Poem — paper-boat wonders

> Fold one edge.
> Fold the other.
> The river fits in the palm.
> 
> It asks for no engine.
> It asks for no map.
> It asks only for a breath —
> and the wonder of floating
> even while being so small.
> 
> Mara was not today’s route.
> She arrived.
> Like the paper boat:
> no intention of ocean,
> with the craft of water.
> 
> Valeu !!!

Also on [Vida](/vida/#poema=barquinhos-de-papel).

## Status

**Approved** — Mara filed; glued to [wonder](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html); paper boats; [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

[▶ Words](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-palavras) · [▶ Maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html) · [▶ Poem](/vida/#poema=barquinhos-de-papel) · [▶ Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)
inspecao-palavra-mara.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección del nombre propio **Mara** en el portugués de Brasil. Nota de campo: la tía. No era la ficha prevista. **Tardó en llegar. Se pensó en ella todo el día. Sucedió.**

El nombre **cabe dentro** de [maravilha / maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html). Un poema breve: las maravillas de los **barquitos de papel**.

> Método: [Wikcionario · Mara](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/Mara). **No es necrológico.** El lab ficha el **nombre** que llegó.

## 1. Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Palabra | **Mara** |
| Tipo lab | Nombre × maravilla × barquito |
| Llegada | No era la intención del día — **sucedió** |
| Vínculo | [maravilhoso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html) ← *maravilha* ← lat. *mirabilia* |
| ≠ | [Tamara](/posts/post-inspecao-tamara-klink.html) · Maria · [mar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mar.html) · sánsc. *Māra* |
| Fecha | 2026-08-22 |

El hebreo *mārāh* («amarga», Rut 1:20) es **capa**, no veredicto sobre la persona.

## 2. Poema — maravillas de los barquitos de papel

> Dobla un margen.
> Dobla el otro.
> El río cabe en la palma.
> 
> No pide motor.
> No pide mapa.
> Pide solo un soplo —
> y la maravilla de flotar
> aunque sea tan poco.
> 
> Mara no era la ruta de hoy.
> Llegó.
> Como el barquito:
> sin intención de océano,
> con oficio de agua.
> 
> ¡Valeu !!!

También en [Vida](/vida/#poema=barquinhos-de-papel).

## Estado

**Aprobada** — Mara fichada; pega en [maravilla](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-maravilhoso.html); barquitos; [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-palavra-orfeu.titleEn: Inspection: Orfeu — the name, the lyre, and the Morpheus he is not
inspecao-palavra-orfeu.titleEs: Inspección: Orfeu — el nombre, la lira y el Morpheus que no es él
inspecao-palavra-orfeu.excerptEn: Words: “Orfeu” / Orpheus (Gk. Ὀρφεύς, uncertain etymon) — lyre and Eurydice; in BR, Black Orpheus; ear-glue with Matrix Morpheus, not the same etymon (Morpheus ← morphē); Valeu !!!
inspecao-palavra-orfeu.excerptEs: Palabras: «Orfeu» (gr. Ὀρφεύς, étimo incerto) — lira y Eurídice; en BR, Orfeu Negro; pegamento de oído con Morpheus de Matrix, no el mismo étimo (Morfeo ← morphē); ¡Valeu !!!
inspecao-palavra-orfeu.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of the **name Orfeu** (PT) / **Orpheus** — via Lat. *Orpheus*, Gk. **Ὀρφεύς**. Field request: relate it to **Morpheus** in [The Matrix](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-the-matrix.html).

This sheet inspects the **word**. It is not a myth encyclopedia and not a second [Jobim](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-tom-jobim.html) biography (*Black Orpheus*). Matrix enters as an **ear contrast**, not the same etymon.

> Independent audit. Sources: [Wiktionary · Orpheus](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Orpheus), [Morpheus](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Morpheus), [The Matrix](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-the-matrix.html). **Do not merge Orfeu / Orpheus with Morpheus.**

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **Orfeu** (PT given name / mythonym) |
| Path | PT Orfeu ← Lat. *Orpheus* ← Gk. **Ὀρφεύς** |
| Greek etymon | **Uncertain** (orphan hypothesis = not a verdict) |
| Requested link | [Matrix Morpheus](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-the-matrix.html) — **phonetic glue**, not etymon |
| ≠ | Morpheus (film) · Ovid’s Morpheus (*morphē* = form) · *Orfeo* / *Orphée* |

## Orfeu × Morpheus (Matrix)

| | **Orfeu / Orpheus** | **Morpheus** (Matrix) |
|--|---------------------|------------------------|
| Greek | **Ὀρφεύς** | **Μορφεύς** |
| Etymon | Uncertain — **not** *morphē* | **μορφή** *morphē* = form / shape |
| Role | Lyre; descent for Eurydice; looking back | Wakes Neo; the pill; “what is real?” |
| Sheet | This one (Words) | [The Matrix](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-the-matrix.html) (Arts) |

**Verdict:** the extra **M-** changes the object. Morpheus inherits Ovid’s dream-shaper. Orpheus inherits the musician who descends. They sound like cousins; they are **not** the same name.

Optional echo only (do not merge plots): underworld vs simulation; looking back vs taking the pill. The lab uses both as **choice parables**, not cosmologies.

## Status

**Approved** — Orfeu filed as a **name**; *Black Orpheus* is a layer; Matrix Morpheus is a cousin of the **ear**, not of the etymon. [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)

[▶ Words](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-palavras) · [▶ Matrix](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-the-matrix.html) · [▶ Jobim](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-tom-jobim.html)
inspecao-palavra-orfeu.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección editorial del **nombre Orfeu** (PT) / **Orfeo** — vía lat. *Orpheus*, gr. **Ὀρφεύς**. Pedido de campo: relacionarlo con **Morpheus** de [The Matrix](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-the-matrix.html).

Esta ficha inspecciona la **palabra**. No es enciclopedia del mito ni segunda biografía de [Jobim](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-tom-jobim.html) (*Orfeu Negro*). Matrix entra como **contraste de oído**, no como el mismo étimo.

> Auditoría independiente. Fuentes: [Wiktionary · Orpheus](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Orpheus), [Morpheus](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Morpheus), [The Matrix](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-the-matrix.html). **No fusionar Orfeu / Orfeo con Morpheus.**

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Palabra | **Orfeu** (antropónimo / mitónimo PT) |
| Vía | PT Orfeu ← lat. *Orpheus* ← gr. **Ὀρφεύς** |
| Étimo griego | **Incerto** (hipótesis «huérfano» = no veredicto) |
| Vínculo pedido | [Morpheus / Matrix](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-the-matrix.html) — **pegamento de oído**, no de étimo |
| ≠ | Morpheus (filme) · Morfeo (Ovidio, *morphē* = forma) · *Orfeo* / *Orphée* |

## Orfeu × Morpheus (Matrix)

| | **Orfeu / Orfeo** | **Morpheus** (Matrix) |
|--|-------------------|------------------------|
| Griego | **Ὀρφεύς** | **Μορφεύς** |
| Étimo | Incerto — **no** es *morphē* | **μορφή** *morphē* = forma / figura |
| Oficio | Lira; descenso por Eurídice; mirar atrás | Despierta a Neo; la píldora; «¿qué es real?» |
| Ficha | Esta (Palabras) | [The Matrix](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-the-matrix.html) (Artes) |

**Veredicto:** la **M-** extra cambia el objeto. Morpheus hereda al dador de forma del sueño (Ovidio). Orfeo hereda al músico que desciende. Suenan primos; **no son el mismo nombre**.

Eco opcional (no fusionar tramas): inframundo × simulación; mirar atrás × tomar la píldora. El laboratorio usa ambos como **parábolas de elección**.

## Estado

**Aprobada** — Orfeu fichado como **nombre**; *Orfeu Negro* es capa; el Morpheus de Matrix es primo del **oído**, no del étimo. [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)

inspecao-palavra-gratidao.titleEs: Inspección: Gratidão — cualidad de grato, no fórmula de obrigado
inspecao-palavra-gratidao.excerptEn: Words: “gratidão” (Late Lat. grātitūdō ← grātus) — named quality of receiving well; pieces grat- + -idão; ≠ obrigado (obligare) ≠ valeu (valēre); Valeu !!!
inspecao-palavra-gratidao.excerptEs: Palabras: «gratidão» (lat. tardío grātitūdō ← grātus) — cualidad de quien recibe bien; piezas grat- + -idão; ≠ obrigado (obligare) ≠ valeu (valēre); ¡Valeu !!!
inspecao-palavra-gratidao.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of Portuguese **gratidão** — the named **quality of being grateful** (recognition of a received good). Field cue: a short *grato*. Covers Late/Med. Lat. *grātitūdō* ← *grātus* + *-tūdō*, the pieces *grat-* + *-idão*, and a hard contrast with [Gratidão](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gratidao.html) (*obligare*) and [valeu](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) (*valēre*). Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Independent audit. Sources: [Wiktionary · gratitude](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/gratitude), [grātus](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/gratus). **Not etiquette. Not a debt protocol.** Do not merge *gratidão* with *obrigado*.

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **gratidão** (feminine noun) |
| Etymon | *grātus* (“pleasing, thankful”) + *-tūdō* → *grātitūdō* — high confidence |
| ≠ | [obrigado](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gratidao.html) (*obligare*, to bind) · [valeu](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) (*valēre*) · *graça* · *gratificação* · *grátis* |
| Sister (adjective) | *grato* — the quality **on** the person; this sheet names it |

## Pieces (veneno method)

| Piece | Everyday | Lab |
|-------|----------|-----|
| **grat-** | *grātus* — welcome, thankful | The good **entered** |
| **-idão** | Quality suffix | Names the **state**, not the spoken formula |
| **gratidão** | Recognition of a received good | Quality with [verdade](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) — no pose, no bill |

**Verdict:** *obrigado* sounds like gratitude in living use. The etymon **does not glue**. *Obligare* binds; *grātus* recognizes.

## Status

**Approved** — quality named; formulas stay on their own sheets. [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)

[▶ Words](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-palavras) · [▶ Gratidão](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gratidao.html) · [▶ Valeu](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)
inspecao-palavra-gratidao.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección editorial de **gratidão** (PT) / **gratitud** — la **cualidad nombrada** de quien es grato: reconocimiento del bien recibido. Señal de campo: un *grato* corto. Cubre lat. tardío *grātitūdō* ← *grātus* + *-tūdō*, las piezas *grat-* + *-idão*, y el contraste duro con [Gratidão](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gratidao.html) (*obligare*) y [valeu](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) (*valēre*). Cierre: [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Auditoría independiente. Fuentes: [Wiktionary · gratitude](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/gratitude), [grātus](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/gratus). **No es etiqueta ni protocolo de deuda.** No fusionar *gratidão* con *obrigado*.

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Palabra | **gratidão** (sustantivo femenino) |
| Étimo | *grātus* («agradable, agradecido») + *-tūdō* → *grātitūdō* — confianza alta |
| ≠ | [obrigado](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gratidao.html) (*obligare*) · [valeu](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) (*valēre*) · *graça* · *gratificação* · *grátis* |
| Hermano (adjetivo) | *grato* — la cualidad **en** la persona; esta ficha la nombra |

## Piezas (método veneno)

| Pieza | Común | Lab |
|-------|-------|-----|
| **grat-** | *grātus* — bienvenido, reconocido | El bien **entró** |
| **-idão** | Sufijo de cualidad | Nombra el **estado**, no la fórmula hablada |
| **gratidão** | Reconocimiento del bien recibido | Cualidad con [verdade](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) — sin pose, sin cuenta |

**Veredicto:** *obrigado* suena a gratitud en el uso vivo. El étimo **no pega**. *Obligare* liga; *grātus* reconoce.

## Estado

**Aprobada** — cualidad nombrada; las fórmulas quedan en sus fichas. [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)

[▶ Palabras](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-palavras) · [▶ Gratidão](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gratidao.html) · [▶ Valeu](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)

inspecao-palavra-teoria-das-cordas.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **teoria das cordas** — calque of English *string theory*. A **research program** in theoretical physics: particles as **vibrating one-dimensional strings**, not points. Distinct from the [corda](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-corda.html) object (rope). Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Independent audit. Sources: [String theory](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/String_theory), [PT](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Teoria_das_cordas). **Not a physics course, not experimental proof, not a tying manual.** The musical metaphor (χορδή) is the **name**; the math is the **craft**.

![Divulgation infographic — String theory](/imagens/inspecoes/teoria-das-cordas-infografico.jpg)

*Divulgation infographic (popular map). Useful for the **names**; **not** proof. The Tesla line in the footer is a popular attribution — not evidence of superstrings.*

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Phrase | **teoria das cordas** / *string theory* |
| Lab type | Concept — theoretical physics × musical metaphor × ≠ rope |
| Not | [corda](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-corda.html) (rope) · [nó](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-no.html) (knot) · mysticism |
| Status | Active program; **no** unique test at accessible energy |
| Date | 2026-08-22 |

**Craft reading:** a rich **map**, still **open**. Extra dimensions and supersymmetry belong to the formalism — they are not cards in the [Objects](/objetos/) catalog.

## Status

**Approved** — string theory filed as physics concept; rope object stays on its own sheet.

inspecao-palavra-teoria-das-cordas.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **teoria das cordas** — calco de *string theory*. Un **programa de investigación** en física teórica: partículas como **cuerdas unidimensionales que vibran**, no puntos. Distinta del objeto [corda](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-corda.html) (cuerda). Cierre: [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Auditoría independiente. Fuentes: [Teoría de cuerdas](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Teoria_das_cordas), [EN](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/String_theory). **No es curso de física ni prueba experimental.** La metáfora musical (χορδή) es el **nombre**; la matemática es el **oficio**.

![Infografía de divulgación — Teoría de cuerdas](/imagens/inspecoes/teoria-das-cordas-infografico.jpg)

*Infografía de divulgación (mapa popular). Útil para los **nombres**; **no** es prueba. La cita de Tesla al pie es atribución popular — no evidencia de supercuerdas.*

## 1. Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Sintagma | **teoria das cordas** / *string theory* |
| Tipo lab | Concepto — física teórica × metáfora musical × ≠ cuerda-objeto |
| No es | [corda](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-corda.html) · [nó](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-no.html) · misticismo |
| Estado | Programa activo; **sin** test único a energía accesible |
| Fecha | 2026-08-22 |

**Lectura de oficio:** mapa **rico** y **abierto**. Dimensiones extra y supersimetría son del formalismo — no fichas del catálogo [Objetos](/objetos/).

## Estado

**Aprobada** — teoría de cuerdas fichada como concepto de física; el objeto cuerda queda en su ficha.

inspecao-palavra-afinar.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **afinar** — *a-* + *fino* + *-ar* ← Lat. *fīnis*. Field request: two witnesses of pitch — the **guitar** (object: tuning peg + ear) and the **little bird whistling** (already in tune, no peg). Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Independent audit. [Wiktionary · afinar](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/afinar). Oral *asoviar* = **assobiar** (to whistle). Not a harmony class or a bird guide.

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **afinar** — to tune / refine / thin |
| Object | **[violão](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-violao.html)** (Brazilian guitar) |
| Living tuner | **passarinho assobiando** |
| Lab | [Three Little Birds](/posts/post-inspecao-personagem-three-little-birds.html) · [Vida](/vida/) |
| Date | 2026-08-22 |

## Guitar × whistling bird

The guitar **needs** a gesture ([gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html)): turn until the string meets the ear. The bird **already whistles**. The craft is to bring the wood toward the beak — not to “fix” the bird, not to worship the clip-on tuner.

## Seems vs is

**Seems:** perfection.  
**Is:** the right pitch **in this hand, today** — [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html), not someone else’s A.

## Status

**Approved** — *fino* etymon; guitar object; whistling bird; [Three Little Birds](/posts/post-inspecao-personagem-three-little-birds.html); [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-palavra-afinar.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **afinar** — *a-* + *fino* + *-ar* ← lat. *fīnis*. Pedido de campo: dos testigos del tono — el **violão** (objeto: clavija + oído) y el **pajarito silbando** (ya en tono, sin clavija). Cierre: [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Auditoría independiente. [Wikcionario · afinar](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/afinar). Oral *asoviar* = **assobiar** (silbar). No es clase de armonía ni guía de aves.

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Palabra | **afinar** — templar / refinar / adelgazar |
| Objeto | **[violão](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-violao.html)** |
| Afinador vivo | **passarinho assobiando** |
| Lab | [Three Little Birds](/posts/post-inspecao-personagem-three-little-birds.html) · [Vida](/vida/) |
| Fecha | 2026-08-22 |

## Guitarra × pajarito

La guitarra **pide** gesto ([gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html)): girar hasta que la cuerda encuentre el oído. El pájaro **ya silba**. El oficio es acercar la madera al pico — no «arreglar» al bicho ni idolatrar el afinador.

## Parece × es

**Parece:** perfección.  
**Es:** el tono justo **en esta mano, hoy** — [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Estado

**Aprobada** — étimo *fino*; objeto violão; pajarito silbando; [Three Little Birds](/posts/post-inspecao-personagem-three-little-birds.html); [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-palavra-afinador.contentEn:
## Scope

Brazilian Portuguese **afinador** — the **object** that **reads** the pitch of [violão](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-violao.html) [strings](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-corda.html) (clip-on chromatic tuner, fork, app). The verb is [afinar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-afinar.html); this sheet is the **thing**. Catalog: [Objetos](/objetos/). The tuner **names** frequency; the hand on the peg **writes** [tónos](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonos.html). Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Independent audit. [Wiktionary · afinador](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/afinador), [electronic tuner](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electronic_tuner). Not a lesson, shop, or brand sheet. The gadget does not replace the ear.

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Thing | Pitch reader — clip / fork / app |
| Etymon | *afinar* + *-dor* — “that which tunes” |
| Not | The verb · the peg (part of the guitar) · the whistling bird · a piano tuner (person) |
| Standard | E A D G B E (Mi–Lá–Ré–Sol–Si–Mi) |
| Links | [afinar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-afinar.html) · [violão](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-violao.html) · [corda](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-corda.html) · [tónos](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonos.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-22 |

## Seems vs is

**Seems:** the tuner tunes the guitar.  
**Is:** the tuner **reads**; the peg **writes**; the ear **signs**. Green LED ≠ music.

## Status

**Approved** — tuner as helper object; strings live on the violão; no brand affiliation.

inspecao-palavra-afinador.contentEs:
## Alcance

**Afinador** (portugués de Brasil) — el **objeto** que **lee** el tono de las [cuerdas](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-corda.html) del [violão](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-violao.html) (clip cromático, diapasón, app). El verbo es [afinar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-afinar.html); esta ficha es la **cosa**. Catálogo: [Objetos](/objetos/). El afinador **nombra** la frecuencia; la mano en la clavija **escribe** el [tónos](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-tonos.html). Cierre: [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Auditoría independiente. [Wikcionario · afinador](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/afinador). No es método, tienda ni marca. El gadget no sustituye el oído.

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Cosa | Lector de tono — clip / diapasón / app |
| Étimo | *afinar* + *-dor* |
| No es | El verbo · la clavija · el pajarito · el afinador de piano (persona) |
| Estándar | Mi–La–Re–Sol–Si–Mi (E A D G B E) |
| Vínculos | [afinar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-afinar.html) · [violão](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-violao.html) · [corda](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-corda.html) |
| Fecha | 2026-08-22 |

## Parece × es

**Parece:** el afinador afina la guitarra.  
**Es:** el afinador **lee**; la clavija **escribe**; el oído **firma**. LED verde ≠ música.

## Estado

**Aprobada** — afinador como objeto-muleta; las cuerdas cantan en el violão; sin afiliación.

inspecao-palavra-script.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of **[script](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-script.html)** — English loan alive in Brazilian Portuguese for a **written sequence** that a person (or an interpreter) **follows**. Field request: *inspeção da palavra script*. Covers Latin *scrīptum* ← *scrībere*, layers **code / screenplay / HTML tag**, house folder `scripts/` ([opsert](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-upsert.html)), contrast with PT **roteiro** / **escrito**, **BudGanja correction** (script ≠ destiny, ≠ [skill](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-skill.html)), and [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Method note: [script](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/script), [scrīptum](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/scriptum#Latin). Not a programming course, screenplay manual, or offensive-automation guide.

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Anchor | **script** · PT sisters **roteiro** / **escrito** |
| Path | Lat. *scrībere* → *scrīptum* → EN *script* → BR tech/stage/oral |
| Links | [skill](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-skill.html) · [pattern](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-pattern.html) · [commitar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-commitar.html) · [opsert](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-upsert.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-24 |

**Seems:** destiny (the film) or magic (code that “just runs”).  
**Is:** an ordered text with an author — readable, correctable, [committed](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-commitar.html).

## 2. BudGanja correction

**script ≠ destiny.** A file is not [skill](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-skill.html). [Pattern](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-pattern.html) is the mold; script is the steps. Read before running ([risco](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html)); if it stalls → [buguei](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-buguei.html) → [backspace](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-backspace.html). Close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Status

**Approved** — EN loan → BR; written sequence; anti-destiny; links [skill](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-skill.html) · [pattern](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-pattern.html) · [commitar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-commitar.html) · [opsert](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-upsert.html); [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

Inspección de **[script](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-script.html)** — préstamo inglés vivo en el portugués de Brasil para la **secuencia escrita** que alguien (o un intérprete) **sigue**. Pedido de campo: *inspeção da palavra script*. Cubre lat. *scrīptum* ← *scrībere*, capas **código / guion / etiqueta HTML**, carpeta `scripts/` ([opsert](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-upsert.html)), contraste con **roteiro** / **escrito**, **corrección BudGanja** (script ≠ destino, ≠ [skill](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-skill.html)) y [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Nota: [script](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/script), [scrīptum](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/scriptum#Latin). No es curso de programación, manual de guion ni guía de automatización ofensiva.

**Es:** texto ordenado con autor — se lee, se corrige, se [commitea](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-commitar.html).

## 2. Corrección BudGanja

**script ≠ destino.** El archivo no es [skill](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-skill.html). [Pattern](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-pattern.html) es el molde; script son los pasos. Leer antes de ejecutar ([risco](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html)); si traba → [buguei](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-buguei.html). Cerrar con [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Estado

**Aprobada** — préstamo EN→BR; secuencia escrita; anti-destino; vínculos [skill](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-skill.html) · [pattern](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-pattern.html) · [commitar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-commitar.html) · [opsert](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-upsert.html); [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

Editorial inspection of **[upsert](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-upsert.html)** — English portmanteau of *update* + *insert*. Lab living name: **opsert** (verb **opsertar**; close **Opsert.**). Craft cry: **mãos a obra** (plural, no crase — the accent gets in the way; *mãos à obra* stays on the map). Two branches of the same gesture: **raise** what is already there; **insert** what is not. House files stay `upsert-*.js`. Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Independent audit. [Wiktionary · upsert](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/upsert), [MERGE (SQL)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Merge_(SQL)). **Sheet ≠ SQL tutorial or silent-overwrite licence.**

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| EN lemma | **upsert** |
| Lab name | **opsert** / **opsertar** / **Opsert.** |
| Hands | **mãos a obra** (plural, no crase) — raise and insert |
| BR calque | **upsertar** — map only, not lab speech |
| Etymon | Blend *update* + *insert* — **high** confidence |
| False siblings | game *upar* · *replace* · [commitar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-commitar.html) (snapshot **after**) |
| Links | [commitar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-commitar.html) · [pattern](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-pattern.html) · [skill](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-skill.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-22 |

## Offices

1. **INSERT** — new row; fails (or skips) if the key exists.  
2. **UPDATE** — existing row; zero rows if the key is missing.  
3. **UPSERT / MERGE / opsert** — insert **or** update by key; not magic overwrite.  
4. **REPLACE** — often delete+insert; identity may change — **not** this sheet.  
5. **[commitar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-commitar.html)** — snapshot **after** the merge.

**Lab:** `upsertPost` looks up the *slug* — update if present, insert if not — then [commitar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-commitar.html) the trace. Cry: **Mãos a obra.**

**Seems:** one button that always works.  
**Is:** a **conflict policy** on identity. Opsert ≠ silent overwrite.

**Verdict:** living name **opsert** approved; [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) after a visible key.

Grito: **mãos a obra** (plural, sin crasis — el acento estorba; *mãos à obra* queda en el mapa). Dos ramas del mismo gesto: **levantar** lo que ya está; **insertar** lo que no. inspecao-palavra-intestino.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of Portuguese **intestino** (intestine) — the **inner tube**. Latin *intestīnum* ← *intestīnus* “internal” ← *intus* “within.” Distinct from [barriga](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-barriga.html) (outer belly, satisfaction signal). Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Method note: [Wiktionary · intestino](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/intestino), [intestinum](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/intestinum#Latin). **Not** gastroenterology or medical advice. Indexing [Davis](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-william-davis.html) / [gluten](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-gluten.html) ≠ endorsement.

## 1. Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **intestino** |
| Etymon | Lat. *intestīnum* ← *intus* “within” |
| Lab type | Organ (tube) × internal (adjective) × processing |
| Not | [Belly](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-barriga.html) · stomach · [heart](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-coracao.html) |
| Links | [barriga](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-barriga.html) · [sinais](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sinais.html) · [eCBome](/posts/post-inspecao-neurociencia-endocanabinoidoma.html) · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-22 |

## 2. Senses

**Organ** (small / large intestine — names, not an atlas) · **internal** (*guerra intestina* = inward conflict, same etymon, other craft) · **processing** what enters ([água](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-agua.html), [pipoca](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-pipoca.html)). English *gut feeling* lives more in [barriga](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-barriga.html) / [coração](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-coracao.html) in PT.

## 3. Outside × inside

[Barriga](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-barriga.html) = visible “enough.” **Intestino** = the *intus* that works. Complementary — not synonyms.

## 4. Purpose

Name the tube · honour the inside · read food discourse without swallowing it as protocol · close with [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## 5. Valeu !!!

Best possible **with this inside at work**, today — without posing anatomy or selling flora. Gut feeling ≠ [truth](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html).

## Status

**Approved** — object · senses · barriga cut · [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-palavra-curar.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **[curar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-curar.html)** — Lat. *cūrāre* ← *cūra* (“care, attention, charge”). Field request: inspection of the word *Curar*. Offices that must not fuse: **treat the body**, **dry/cure the harvest**, **cura as parish priest**. False friend: **cuidar** (*cōgitāre*). Lab cut: **curing the [plant](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-planta.html)** ≠ slogan “the plant cures”. Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Independent audit. [Wiktionary · curar](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/curar), [*cūra*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/cura#Latin). **Sheet ≠ clinical protocol, leaflet, drying recipe, or miracle.**

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **curar** — to heal / to cure (preserve) / to treat |
| Etymon | Lat. *cūra* → *cūrāre* → PT **curar** — **high** confidence |
| Not | **cuidar** (*cōgitāre*) · a medical protocol · a guarantee |
| Links | [planta](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-planta.html) · [cultivo](/cultivo/) · [Cannabis sativa](/posts/post-inspecao-planta-cannabis-sativa.html) · [UNIFESP XIV](/posts/post-inspecao-curso-unifesp-cannabis-medicinal.html) · [truth](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) · [risk](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-22 |

## Offices (keep apart)

1. **Treat / heal** — body; not a protocol here.  
2. **Cure / dry** — meat, tobacco, post-harvest [plant](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-planta.html) — EN *cure*.  
3. **Parish *cura*** — charge of [souls](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alma.html); not a clinic.  
4. **Lab** — attend the sheet with *cūra* (cite, limit); refuse “X cures Y” as headline.

**Harvest ≠ clinic:** “curar a erva” is office 2 (time, air, [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html)). “A erva cura” is office 1 as slogan — it asks [truth](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) and [risk](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html), not faith.

## Seems vs is

**Seems:** the word *is* the cure.  
**Is:** the word names **care with craft**. Outcome lives elsewhere — clinic, evidence, time. [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) on **this** attending, today.

## Status

**Approved** — *cūra*; offices split; ≠ *cuidar*; harvest ≠ slogan; [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-palavra-curar.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **[curar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-curar.html)** — lat. *cūrāre* ← *cūra* («cuidado, atención, encargo»). Pedido de campo: inspección de la palabra *Curar*. Oficios que no se fusionan: **tratar el cuerpo**, **secar/curar la cosecha**, **cura párroco**. Falso amigo: **cuidar** (*cōgitāre*). Corte lab: **curar la [planta](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-planta.html)** ≠ eslogan «la planta cura». Cierre: [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Auditoría independiente. [Wikcionario · curar](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/curar), [*cūra*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/cura#Latin). **Ficha ≠ protocolo clínico, prospecto, receta de secado ni milagro.**

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Palabra | **curar** — sanar / curar (conservar) / tratar |
| Étimo | Lat. *cūra* → *cūrāre* → PT **curar** — confianza **alta** |
| No es | **cuidar** (*cōgitāre*) · protocolo médico · garantía |
| Vínculos | [planta](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-planta.html) · [cultivo](/cultivo/) · [Cannabis sativa](/posts/post-inspecao-planta-cannabis-sativa.html) · [XIV](/posts/post-inspecao-curso-unifesp-cannabis-medicinal.html) · [verdad](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) · [riesgo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html) |
| Fecha | 2026-08-22 |

## Oficios (separar)

1. **Tratar / sanar** — cuerpo; no hay protocolo aquí.  
2. **Curar / secar** — carne, tabaco, [planta](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-planta.html) tras la cosecha.  
3. **Cura párroco** — encargo de [almas](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-alma.html); no es consultorio.  
4. **Lab** — atender la ficha con *cūra*; rechazar «X cura Y» como titular.

**Cosecha ≠ clínica:** «curar a erva» es oficio 2. «A erva cura» es oficio 1 de eslogan — pide [verdad](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-verdade.html) y [riesgo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html), no fe.

## Parece × es

**Parece:** la palabra *es* la cura.  
**Es:** la palabra nombra **cuidado con oficio**. El resultado vive en otro sitio. [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) en **este** trato, hoy.

## Estado

**Aprobada** — *cūra*; oficios separados; ≠ *cuidar*; cosecha ≠ eslogan; [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-expressao-elo-de-ligacao.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **“[elo de ligação](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-elo-de-ligacao.html)”** — the **ring that joins** A and B. Field request: relate it to the **infinity symbol** (*simbuklo* in the ear → **símbolo**). The graphic is the **lemniscate** (∞). Craft reading: the **crossing** of the two loops **is** the link.

> Independent audit. Sources: [elo](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/elo), [infinity symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infinity_symbol), [lemniscate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lemniscate), [σύμβολον](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%CF%83%CF%8D%CE%BC%CE%B2%CE%BF%CE%BB%CE%BF%CE%BD). Classroom analogy: Dr. **Kassia Martins**, [UNIFESP XIV lesson 8](/biblioteca/unifesp/livro-xiv.html#aula-8) ([YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dNcVCa1_7Ig)). **Not mysticism, not a clinical protocol.** Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Saying | **elo de ligação** (connecting link) |
| Pair | **infinity symbol** / lemniscate |
| Ear trigger | *simbuklo* → **símbolo** |
| Lab type | Expression — joining ring × ∞ crossing |
| Not | [link](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-link.html) loan alone · [nó](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-no.html) · eternity · dose |
| Date | 2026-08-22 |

**H1:** the phrase is almost tautological — Portuguese insists the ring **do** the joining.  
**H2:** Greek *sýmbolon* was already a joining token (two halves that fit).  
**H3:** Kassia’s standing-8 = communication up↔down; the lab **relates** that crossing to this locution — it does **not** claim she used these words.  
**H4:** [endocannabinoidome](/posts/post-inspecao-neurociencia-endocanabinoidoma.html) is the map; the analogy is not proof.

```poem
The eight lying down is called infinity.
The eight standing up is called a path:
what is above speaks with what is below.

At the crossing — the ring you do not see —
lives the connecting link.

It is not only the chain-ring in the hand.
It is not only the link you click.
It is the point where both loops
are still one.

Simbuklo arrived crooked in the ear.
Símbolo addressed it.
The ribbon (lemniscate) does not promise forever:
it promises communication,
rhythm,
balance.

The body already knew:
relax, eat, sleep, protect —
the conductor joins what was apart.

Valeu !!!
at the crossing,
without pretending infinity fits on a sheet.
```

## Status

**Approved** — connecting-link locution filed; related to ∞ by the **crossing**; *simbuklo* addressed; XIV analogy credited without affiliation.

| Gatillo | *simbuklo* → **símbolo** |
| Tipo lab | Expresión — anillo que junta × cruce del ∞ |
| No es | [link](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-link.html) · [nó](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-no.html) · eternidad · dosis |
| Fecha | 2026-08-22 |

**H1:** la locución es casi tautológica — el portugués insiste en que el anillo **haga** el oficio.  
**H2:** gr. *sýmbolon* ya era un token que encaja.  
**H3:** el 8 de pie (Kassia) = comunicación arriba↔abajo; el lab **relaciona** el cruce — **no** afirma que ella dijera estas palabras.  
**H4:** el [endocanabinoidoma](/posts/post-inspecao-neurociencia-endocanabinoidoma.html) es el mapa; la analogía no es prueba.

```poem
El ocho acostado se llama infinito.
El ocho de pie se llama camino:
lo de arriba habla con lo de abajo.

En el cruce — el anillo que no se ve —
vive el eslabón de ligación.

No es solo el eslabón de la cadena en la mano.
No es solo el link que se clica.
Es el punto donde las dos vueltas
aún son una sola.

Simbuklo llegó torcido al oído.
Símbolo lo enderezó.
La cinta (lemniscata) no promete eternidad:
promete comunicación,
ritmo,
equilibrio.

El cuerpo ya sabía:
relajarse, comer, dormir, proteger —
el maestro une lo que estaba separado.

Valeu !!!
en el cruce,
sin fingir que el infinito cabe en una ficha.
```

## Estado

**Aprobada** — locución del eslabón que junta; relacionada al ∞ por el **cruce**; *simbuklo* enderezado; analogía XIV acreditada sin afiliación.

inspecao-palavra-link.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **link** (English loan: chain-ring / hyperlink) and its **relation** to the surname **Klink** of [Tamara Klink](/posts/post-inspecao-tamara-klink.html). The Brazilian ear glues *Klink* to *link*; [tamaraklink.com](/posts/post-inspecao-site-tamaraklink.html) reads as “Tamara link”. The lab names the glue and **refuses** it as etymon.

> Independent audit. Sources: [Wiktionary · link](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/link), [Wikipedia · Tamara](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tamara_Klink), [Amyr](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amyr_Klink). Word ≠ person. Official spelling **Klink**.

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **link** — EN loan |
| Surname | **Klink** — Germanic-type family name |
| Ear | K-link ≈ link |
| Etymon | **apart** |
| Date | 2026-08-21 |

**Verdict:** *link* is a chain-ring. *Klink* is a family. Calling Tamara “a link” is craft metaphor ([caminho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caminho.html) / [passar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-passar.html)) — not the origin of the name.

## Status

**Approved** — loanword filed; surname filed; relation = ear + metaphor, not ancestry.

inspecao-expressao-em-pe-e-deitado.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **“[em pé e deitado](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-em-pe-e-deitado.html)”** — the **pair of postures** of the [lemniscate](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lemniscata.html). Field request: *em pé e Deitado ou bodiado*. The ear brought *bodiado*; the letter addresses **deitado** (lying down). English *body* sticks to the same trigger: in [UNIFESP XIV lesson 8](/biblioteca/unifesp/livro-xiv.html#aula-8), Dr. Kassia Martins asks that the figure be thought **standing** when one thinks of the **body**. The crossing stays on [elo de ligação](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-elo-de-ligacao.html). Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Independent audit. Sources: [pé](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/p%C3%A9), [deitar](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/deitar), [infinity symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infinity_symbol), [body](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/body). **Not mysticism, not a clinical protocol.** No affiliation.

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Saying | **em pé e deitado** (standing and lying) |
| Ear trigger | *bodiado* → **deitado** (+ *body*) |
| Graphic | [lemniscate](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lemniscata.html) |
| Crossing | [elo de ligação](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-elo-de-ligacao.html) |
| Not | two curves · eternity · dose · [nó](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-no.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-22 |

**H1:** one ribbon, turned — lying = ∞; standing = body path (Kassia).  
**H2:** *bodiado* is not an etymon.  
**H3:** the lab **relates** the pair to the lesson — it does **not** claim she used these words.

```poem
Bodiado arrived crooked in the ear.
Deitado addressed it.
The eight lying down is called infinity.
The eight standing up is called a body:
what is above speaks with what is below.

It is not two figures.
It is the same ribbon, turned.
Standing — the path in the body.
Lying — the name of the endless.
At the crossing — the link that joins.

Kassia did not baptise the locution.
She stood the lemniscate up
when she thought of the body.
The lab keeps the pair:
standing and lying.

Valeu !!!
in both postures,
without pretending infinity fits on a sheet.
```

## Status

**Approved** — pair of postures filed; *bodiado* addressed; XIV analogy credited without affiliation.

inspecao-expressao-em-pe-e-deitado.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **«[em pé e deitado](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-em-pe-e-deitado.html)»** — el **par de posturas** de la [lemniscata](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lemniscata.html). Pedido de campo: *em pé e Deitado ou bodiado*. El oído trajo *bodiado*; la letra endereza **deitado** (acostada). El inglés *body* se pega al mismo gatillo: en la [aula 8 del XIV](/biblioteca/unifesp/livro-xiv.html#aula-8), la Dra. Kassia Martins pide pensar la figura **de pie** cuando se piensa el **cuerpo**. El cruce queda en [elo de ligação](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-elo-de-ligacao.html). Cierre: [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Auditoría independiente. Fuentes: [pé](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/p%C3%A9), [deitar](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/deitar), [infinity symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infinity_symbol), [body](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/body). **No es misticismo ni protocolo clínico.** Sin afiliación.

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Expresión | **em pé e deitado** (de pie y acostada) |
| Gatillo | *bodiado* → **deitado** (+ *body*) |
| Gráfico | [lemniscata](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lemniscata.html) |
| Cruce | [elo de ligação](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-elo-de-ligacao.html) |
| No es | dos curvas · eternidad · dosis · [nó](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-no.html) |
| Fecha | 2026-08-22 |

**H1:** una misma cinta, girada — acostada = ∞; de pie = camino en el cuerpo (Kassia).  
**H2:** *bodiado* no es étimo.  
**H3:** el lab **relaciona** el par con la aula — **no** afirma que ella dijera estas palabras.

```poem
Bodiado llegó torcido al oído.
Deitado lo enderezó.
El ocho acostado se llama infinito.
El ocho de pie se llama cuerpo:
lo de arriba habla con lo de abajo.

No son dos figuras.
Es la misma cinta, girada.
De pie — el camino en el cuerpo.
Acostada — el nombre del sin-fin.
En el cruce — el eslabón que junta.

Kassia no bautizó la locución.
Puso la lemniscata de pie
cuando pensó el cuerpo.
El laboratorio guarda el par:
de pie y acostada.

Valeu !!!
en las dos posturas,
sin fingir que el infinito cabe en una ficha.
```

## Estado

**Aprobada** — par de posturas fichado; *bodiado* enderezado; analogía XIV acreditada sin afiliación.
