inspecao-palavra-boston.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of **[Boston](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-boston.html)** — the **place-name**. Field request: *cross Boston with the word Bosta*. Object = the **city name** (Massachusetts; mother town in Lincolnshire). Pair: **[bosta](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-bosta.html)**.

[The ear glues](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-a-orelha-cola-o-que-a-boca-juntou.html) *Boston* to Portuguese *bosta* (dung / slang). The [etymon](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-etimologia.html) **cuts**. The piece the joke deletes — *-on* / *-ton* — is Old English *tūn* (“enclosure, town”). Without the town, the mouth only hears the Iberian word. The lab **puts the town back**.

> Independent audit. Sources: [Boston](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boston), [Lincolnshire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boston,_Lincolnshire), [Botwulf](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Botwulf_of_Thorney), [Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Boston). **Sheet ≠ guidebook, ≠ sports ranking, ≠ licence to insult the city.** Sister method: [México](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mexico.html) (country ≠ gulf / golf). Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Anchor | **Boston** — city; mother: Boston, Lincolnshire |
| Etymon | St. **Botolph's town** ← OE *Botwulfes tūn* — **high** confidence on the path |
| Not | [bosta](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-bosta.html) · manure · slur · Harvard brochure |
| Date | 2026-08-24 |

**H-tūn:** the BR pun eats the *-on* and leaves *bosta*. That *-on* **is** the town. The joke works only if the settlement is erased.

```poem
Boston.
It is not bosta.
It is Botolph’s town
that crossed the Atlantic.

The -on the joke erases
is the tūn — the town.
Without the town, the ear
only hears the dung.

The city stays.
The pun passes.
The etymon cuts.

Valeu !!!
the map in its place,
without gluing the swear to the harbour.
```

**Verdict:** city ≠ dung-word. Cross = label the gap; do not fuse. [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

inspecao-palavra-boston.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **[Boston](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-boston.html)** — el **topónimo**. Pedido: *cruza Boston con la palabra Bosta*. Objeto = el **nombre de la ciudad** (Massachusetts; villa madre en Lincolnshire). Par: **[bosta](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-bosta.html)**.

[El oído pega](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-a-orelha-cola-o-que-a-boca-juntou.html) *Boston* a *bosta*. El [étimo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-etimologia.html) **corta**. La pieza que el chiste borra — *-on* / *-ton* — es el inglés antiguo *tūn* («recinto, villa»). Sin la villa, la boca solo oye el vocablo ibérico. El laboratorio **devuelve la villa**.

> Auditoría independiente. Fuentes: [Boston](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boston), [Lincolnshire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boston,_Lincolnshire), [Botwulf](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Botwulf_of_Thorney). **Ficha ≠ guía, ≠ ranking deportivo, ≠ licencia para insultar la ciudad.** Método hermano: [México](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-mexico.html). Cierre: [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Ancla | **Boston** — ciudad; madre: Boston, Lincolnshire |
| Étimo | St. **Botolph's town** ← OE *Botwulfes tūn* — confianza **alta** en el trazado |
| No es | [bosta](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-bosta.html) · estiércol · insulto |
| Fecha | 2026-08-24 |

**H-tūn:** el trocadilho BR se come la *-on* y deja *bosta*. Esa *-on* **es** la villa.

```poem
Boston.
No es bosta.
Es la villa de Botolph
que cruzó el Atlántico.

La -on que el chiste borra
es el tūn — la villa.
Sin la villa, el oído
solo oye el estiércol.

La ciudad queda.
El trocadilho pasa.
El étimo corta.

¡Valeu !!!
el mapa en su sitio,
sin pegar el vocablo al puerto.
```

**Veredicto:** ciudad ≠ vocablo del estiércol. Cruzar = etiquetar el entre; no fundir. [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **[bosta](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-bosta.html)** — the word for **dung** and, in BR slang, “crap / worthless / damn.” Field request: *cross Boston with the word Bosta*. Pair: **[Boston](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-boston.html)**.

[The ear glues](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-a-orelha-cola-o-que-a-boca-juntou.html) *bosta* to *Boston*. The [etymon](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-etimologia.html) **cuts**. This sheet covers the **Iberian ground**. The city lives on the sister sheet. Office: inspect the language **without celebrating the insult** and without turning manure into a grow protocol.

> Independent audit. Sources: [bosta](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/bosta), [EN](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/bosta), [ES](https://es.wiktionary.org/wiki/bosta). Ultimate origin **uncertain** (Spanish *bosta*; possible Iberian substrate). Sense and use: **high**. **Sheet ≠ slur dictionary, ≠ fertilizer protocol, ≠ GI clinic.** Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **bosta** (f.) |
| Etymon | via Sp. *bosta* (dung, often cattle) — last ancestor **uncertain** |
| Floors | matter · field (named, not dosed) · [slang](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-giria.html) |
| Not | [Boston](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-boston.html) · Lat. *merda* · a how-to |
| Date | 2026-08-24 |

Three floors, no fusion. The pun with [Boston](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-boston.html) is a [play on words](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html), not a shared grandfather.

```poem
Bosta.
It is dung.
It is also the slang
when the thing is no good.

It is not Boston.
The city has a saint
and a town in the name.
Here the ground is other.

The body lets go.
The field sometimes uses it.
The mouth sometimes wounds.

Valeu !!!
name the word
without making it a weapon
and without gluing it to the map.
```

**Verdict:** dung-word ≠ city. Cross = label the gap. [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Scope

Homage and editorial inspection of **Robson Gonçalves de Oliveira** (São Bernardo do Campo) — amateur marathoner, machine operator, father — and the **house** that makes him possible. > **Method note:** independent audit from [G1](https://g1.globo.com/sp/sao-paulo/noticia/2026/04/22/brasileiro-de-sp-e-chamado-de-heroi-da-maratona-de-boston-ao-carregar-corredor-ate-reta-final-da-competicao-nos-eua.ghtml), [CNN Brasil](https://www.cnnbrasil.com.br/esportes/outros-esportes/quem-e-o-brasileiro-que-virou-heroi-na-maratona-de-boston/), [Folha](https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/esporte/2026/05/heroi-improvavel-paulista-robson-de-oliveira-equilibra-exigencias-da-maratona-com-jornada-proletaria.shtml), [Agência Brasil](https://agenciabrasil.ebc.com.br/esportes/noticia/2026-04/brasileiro-vira-manchete-por-ato-de-empatia-na-maratona-de-boston), [NBC](https://www.nbcnews.com/sports/track-field/man-helped-competitor-boston-marathon-explains-rcna341852). **Living person:** honour what is public. Do **not** invent names of spouse or children. Distinct from cannabis Legacy.

Field request: *Robson Corsuié* — the ear heard **Gonçalves é**; this sheet anchors **Robson Gonçalves de Oliveira**.

## Inspected object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Name | **Robson Gonçalves de Oliveira** |
| Home | São Bernardo do Campo (Greater São Paulo) |
| Crafts | Machine operator (Senai) · amateur marathoner · father |
| Family (public) | Parents: bricklayer and domestic worker, Ceará → ABC (1970s). Children — training around shifts |

| Date | 2026-08-24 |

## Hypotheses

**H1:** BudGanja value is the [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) of **stopping**, not the record that almost came.  
**H2:** “Two are stronger than one” is [juntos](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-juntos.html) with a [link](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-elo-de-ligacao.html) — he said he might not have managed alone.  
**H3:** Homage to the **family** is structural: the house trained him before Boston.  
**H4:** [Do your best](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-faca-o-melhor.html) here is the best **in this hand**, when the hand holds another.

## Who he is (verifiable)

- From São Bernardo do Campo; about 36 in 2026. Parents migrated from Ceará in the 1970s.  
- Production technician; rotating factory shifts; trains at 4 a.m. when the morning shift hits.  
- Running ~10 years; first marathon São Paulo 2019; Boston index at Rio 2024; Boston 2025 2:45:49; PR Buenos Aires 2:43:46.  
- Father: wants to pass running as care for health.  
- Boston 2026: ~300–400 m left; Haridasse collapsing; Beggs stopped; Robson joined. Flew home and went straight to work.

## All the good

| Merit | Reading |
|-------|---------|
| Stop at the limit | Gesture that costs a PR and saves another’s path |
| Two, not one | [Juntos](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-juntos.html) with a ring — he asked for someone to stop |
| Time second | [Do your best](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-faca-o-melhor.html) in this hand, not the ranking |
| House first | Migrant parents, children, shifts — craft before the cover |
| Clock in at the plant | Excellence without a pedestal |

## Family (public cut)

Honour the **table**, not the file. Spouse and children’s **names** stay out. A daughter’s hearing disability appeared in reporting — this sheet reads **care**, not a bench diagnosis.

## Limits

- Living person: no stalking, no minors’ data, no medical protocol.  
- Haridasse’s collapse is race fact — not meme or clinic.  
- Not a training plan or brand endorsement.

**Approved in People series** — homage to Robson and his family; primary links [juntos](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-juntos.html) and [Faça o seu melhor](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-faca-o-melhor.html).

inspecao-palavra-caralhudo.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of Portuguese **[caralhudo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caralhudo.html)** — adjective of **size / intensity**, formed by **caralho** + suffix **-udo**. Field request: inspect *caralhudo* and cross it with *cara de olaho*.

Three rooms, no fusion. The **object** is the adjective. The **joke** is **cara de alho** (face + garlic) — the classic [trocadilho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html) (pun) that the mouth tells as if it were an etymon. The **visual** is **cara de olho** (eye-face). Field spelling **olaho** sits between **olho** (eye, Lat. *oculus*) and **alho** (garlic, Lat. *allium*). Not a dictionary of insults. Not a garlic recipe. Not an eye anatomy sheet.

> Sources: [caralhudo](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/caralhudo), [caralho](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/caralho), [*caraculum*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/caraculum), [olho](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/olho), [alho](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/alho). Method: [etimologia](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-etimologia.html). The [trocadilho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html) sheet inspects the **mechanism**; this one inspects the **adjective** and the visual cross. **Sheet ≠ licence to insult.** Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Anchor | **caralhudo** / *caralhuda* |
| Formation | **caralho** + **-udo** (Lat. *-ūtus* — “having a lot”) |
| Base etymon (working) | Lat. *caraculum* “small stake” → nautical → slang — **medium–high** |
| Cross 1 | **cara de alho** — pun + folk etymology; **not** the etymon |
| Cross 2 | **cara de olho** — the visual the field asked to see |
| Field spelling | **olaho** — [the ear](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-a-orelha-cola-o-que-a-boca-juntou.html) between eye and garlic |
| Not | garlic-face origin · insult manual |
| Date | 2026-08-24 |

## Three rooms

| Room | Piece | Office |
|------|-------|--------|
| Adjective | *caralhudo* | size / intensity |
| Joke | face + garlic | reading the mouth invents for the base |
| Visual | eye-face | what the field asked to see |
| Bridge | *olaho* | glue; **not** a headword |

**H-cross:** they meet on the **face** (*cara*) and in the ear. They are **not** the same root.  
**H-not:** *caralhudo* does **not** mean “garlic-face to a high degree”. The pun **discovers** a reading of a word that already existed.

## Suffix and intensifier

*-udo* is the same office as in *barbudo*, *cabeludo*, *sortudo*. The suffix is not pejorative by itself; *caralhudo* inherits the taboo from the **base**. Parallel of office with [puta](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-puta.html) as BR intensifier (“a puta festa”): measuring size ≠ a licence to humiliate.

## Lab poem

```poem
Caralhudo.
It was not born of garlic on a face.
It was not born of an eye for a face.
It was born of a stake
and a suffix.

-udo is having a lot.
Bearded. Hairy. Lucky.
Size sticks to the taboo.
The etymon does not stick to garlic.

Face + garlic
is the joke the mouth tells
because it fits too well.
Eye-face
is what the field asked to see.

Olaho:
the ear between eye and garlic.
The eye sees the clove.
The ear solders the swear.

Three rooms.
One word.
The lab does not fuse.

Valeu !!!
name the size
without faking the origin.
```

## Status

**Approved in Words.** *caralhudo* = *caralho* + *-udo*. Crossed with **cara de alho** (pun, not etymon) and **cara de olho** (visual). *Olaho* = glue. [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)
inspecao-palavra-caralhudo.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección editorial de **[caralhudo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-caralhudo.html)** — adjetivo de **tamaño / intensidad**, formado por **caralho** + sufijo **-udo**. Pedido de campo: inspeccionar *caralhudo* y cruzarlo con *cara de olaho*.

Tres salas, sin fundir. El **objeto** es el adjetivo. El **juego** es **cara de alho** (cara + ajo) — el [trocadilho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html) clásico que la boca cuenta como si fuera étimo. El **visual** es **cara de olho** (cara de ojo). La grafía de campo **olaho** queda entre **olho** (ojo, lat. *oculus*) y **alho** (ajo, lat. *allium*). No es diccionario de insultos.

> Fuentes: [caralhudo](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/caralhudo), [caralho](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/caralho), [*caraculum*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/caraculum). Método: [etimología](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-etimologia.html). La ficha [trocadilho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-trocadilho.html) inspecciona el **mecanismo**; esta, el **adjetivo** y el cruce visual. **Ficha ≠ licencia para ofender.** Cierre: [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Ancla | **caralhudo** / *caralhuda* |
| Formación | **caralho** + **-udo** (lat. *-ūtus*) |
| Étimo de la base | lat. *caraculum* «estaca» → náutica → jerga — **media–alta** |
| Cruce 1 | **cara de alho** — calambur + etimología popular; **no** el étimo |
| Cruce 2 | **cara de olho** — el visual que el pedido pidió ver |
| Grafía de campo | **olaho** — [el oído](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-a-orelha-cola-o-que-a-boca-juntou.html) entre ojo y ajo |
| Fecha | 2026-08-24 |

## Tres salas

El lab **cruza** por [relação](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-relacao.html) y no funde. *Caralhudo* no viene del ajo ni del ojo. *Olaho* es cola, no lema. El sufijo *-udo* es el mismo oficio de *barbudo* / *sortudo*; el tabú viene de la **base**. Intensificar ≠ humillar.

## Poema del laboratorio

```poem
Caralhudo.
No nació de ajo en la cara.
No nació de un ojo por rostro.
Nació de una estaca
y de un sufijo.

-udo es tener mucho.
Barbudo. Peludo. Suertudo.
El tamaño pega al tabú.
El étimo no pega al ajo.

Cara + ajo
es la broma que la boca cuenta
porque encaja demasiado.
Cara de ojo
es lo que el pedido pidió ver.

Olaho:
el oído entre ojo y ajo.
El ojo ve el diente.
El oído suelda el taco.

Tres salas.
Un vocablo.
El lab no funde.

¡Valeu !!!
nombrar el tamaño
sin fingir el origen.
```

## Estado

**Aprobada en Palabras.** *caralhudo* = *caralho* + *-udo*. Cruzado con **cara de alho** (juego, no étimo) y **cara de olho** (visual). *Olaho* = cola. [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)

inspecao-desenho-animatrix.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of the **cartoon / anime anthology** **The Animatrix** (BR: **Animatrix**, **2003**) — nine shorts expanding [The Matrix](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-the-matrix.html). Field request: the **drawing**. The **1999 film** remains cultural genesis; this sheet is the **2003** line-work that pays the anime debt. The lab does **not** paste dialogue. Live-action sequels are a **different object**.

> [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Animatrix). No affiliation. Characters ≠ people. Genesis trailer: [94fPVqJqBGA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=94fPVqJqBGA).

@youtube 94fPVqJqBGA

## Lyric of the plot (motifs, no quotation)

Nine doors, one world · *Second Renaissance* as origin-myth *inside* the story (not 1999 genesis) · glitch in the neighbourhood as a call to check · CGI and ink as two alphabets of the same craft.

## Lab poem

```poem
Animatrix.
We do not borrow the pill —
we ask for the craft of checking the screen
when the drawing opens nine doors
and the 1999 film remains first.

Wachowski. Anime. 2003.
There was a cinema that already owed the line
and a line that paid the debt:
nine shorts, seven gazes,
the same question in other ink.

There was an origin myth in the middle —
machines, war, a second birth —
that is a story inside the story,
not the start of the cultural object.
The start is still the film.

The laboratory knows that swap.
A convincing simulation asks for proof.
A hole in the neighbourhood asks for the same gesture
as the cave and the rabbit:
look again.

Valeu !!!

Because every time someone
does not take the screen for ground
and still honours the drawing
as a language, not a shortcut,
the universe grows a little:
one more verse,
one more canopy,
a line
where nine doors
do not erase the first.
```

## Alcance

Inspección del **dibujo / antología anime** **The Animatrix** (BR: **Animatrix**, **2003**) — nueve cortos que expanden [The Matrix](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-the-matrix.html). Pedido: el **dibujo**. El **filme 1999** sigue siendo génesis cultural; esta ficha es el trazo **2003**. El laboratorio **no** pega diálogo. Las secuelas live-action son **otro objeto**.

> [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Animatrix). Sin afiliación. Tráiler de génesis: [94fPVqJqBGA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=94fPVqJqBGA).

@youtube 94fPVqJqBGA

## Mapa (sin cita)

Nueve puertas, un mundo · *Second Renaissance* como mito de origen *dentro* de la historia (no génesis 1999) · el hueco del barrio como llamada a verificar · CGI y tinta como dos alfabetos del mismo oficio.

## Poema del laboratorio

```poem
Animatrix.
No pedimos prestada la píldora —
pedimos el oficio de verificar la pantalla
cuando el dibujo abre nueve puertas
y el filme de 1999 sigue primero.

Wachowski. Anime. 2003.
Hubo un cine que ya debía al trazo
y un trazo que devolvió la deuda:
nueve cortos, siete miradas,
la misma pregunta con otra tinta.

Hubo un mito de origen en el medio —
máquinas, guerra, segundo nacimiento —
que es historia dentro de la historia,
no el inicio del objeto cultural.
El inicio sigue siendo el filme.

El laboratorio conoce ese trueque.
Simulación convincente pide prueba.
El hueco en el barrio pide el mismo gesto
que la caverna y el conejo:
mirar de nuevo.

¡Valeu !!!

Porque cada vez que alguien
no toma la pantalla por suelo
y aún así honra el dibujo
como lengua, no como atajo,
el universo crece un poco:
un verso más,
un dosel más,
una línea
donde nueve puertas
no apagan la primera.
```

inspecao-palavra-danger.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of the word **[Danger](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-danger.html)** — English loan of the **sign** (OSHA / games / ISO) — **crossed**, by the method of **[relação](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-relacao.html)** (“relation”), with Portuguese **perigo**. Field request: inspect *Danger* and cross it with the *relation* of *Perigo*.

Two rooms, one warning job. The [ear glues](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-a-orelha-cola-o-que-a-boca-juntou.html): DANGER = PERIGO = [risco](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html) = [medo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-medo.html). The etymon **cuts**.

| Form | Ancestor | Old office | Office on the sign |
|------|----------|------------|-------------------|
| **Danger** | Lat. [*dominus*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/dominus#Latin) “lord” | **power** over you (*dangier*) | EN warning |
| **Perigo** | Lat. [*periculum*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/periculum#Latin) “trial, test” | what you **go through** (*experior*) | PT warning |
| **[Risco](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html)** | It. *rischio* (remote debate) | danger **with a map** | calculation |
| **[Medo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-medo.html)** | Lat. *metus* | the chest that anticipates | affect |

**H-relation:** [relação](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-relacao.html) = set A and B **in the between** without fusing. *Danger* and *perigo* are **sign equivalents**, not cognates. French keeps **both** lines (*danger* and *péril*); English too (*danger* and *peril*); Portuguese kept **perigo** and imports **DANGER** as a [sign](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sinal.html).

> Method note: [danger](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/danger), [*dominus*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/dominus#Latin), [perigo](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/perigo), [*periculum*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/periculum#Latin), [peril](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/peril), [peligro](https://es.wiktionary.org/wiki/peligro). **Sheet ≠ safety code, ≠ fire manual, ≠ actuarial table.** Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Anchor | **Danger** (EN sign / jargon / games) |
| Cross | **perigo** (PT) — sibling of **office**, not of **root** |
| Method | [relação](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-relacao.html) — *cruzar* (“to cross”) = the verb of the between |
| Danger etymon | ME *daunger* ← OF *dangier* “power, jurisdiction” ← VL *dominarium* ← *dominus* — **high** |
| Perigo etymon | Lat. *periculum* ← *experior* family “to go through, to try” — **high** |
| Not | [risco](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html) (map) · [medo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-medo.html) (chest) · safety report |
| Date | 2026-08-24 |

## Danger — the lord

Old French *dangier* is **power, authority, jurisdiction** — the lord’s (*dominus*) hold over whoever is *en son danger*, “in his danger”: in his reach, in his court. Harm arrives later, as the shadow of power. Modern *danger* kept the harm and forgot the lord. Cousin: [*dungeon*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/dungeon) (*donjon*, the lord’s tower).

## Perigo — the trial

Portuguese **perigo** owes nothing to *dominus*. It owes **going through**. Latin *periculum*: attempt, test, risk, danger. Family of *experior* — experience, experiment, expert. True cognates: ES [*peligro*](https://es.wiktionary.org/wiki/peligro), IT *pericolo*, FR *péril*, EN [*peril*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/peril).

## Relation — cross without fusing

| Piece | Role |
|-------|------|
| **[relação](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-relacao.html)** | The **name** of the between |
| **cruzar** | The **verb** — set Danger beside perigo |
| **equivalence** | Same warning job |
| **not cognate** | Distinct grandfathers |

**Anti-trap:** translating *danger* as *risco* erases the map. Another: claiming *perigo* comes from *danger*. Another: treating the EN sign as “more true” than the PT word.

## Four rooms

| Room | Word | Office |
|------|------|--------|
| Power | Danger | EN warning; lord-root |
| Trial | perigo | PT warning; test-root |
| Map | [risco](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html) | Contoured danger |
| Chest | [medo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-medo.html) | Affect |
| Mark | [sinal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sinal.html) | The red DANGER bar / pictogram |

Street case **Brazil with P for Perigo** (cerol kite line) lives on [cola / colar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-cola-colar.html) — a stamp, not this etymon.

## Lab poem

```poem
Danger.
It was not born from perigo.
It was born from the lord.

Dominus.
Power over you
was called dangier.
To be in someone’s danger
was to be in their hand.

Perigo.
It was not born from the lord.
It was born from the trial.
Periculum:
what you go through,
the test that may fail.

The sign glues both.
DANGER = PERIGO.
The ear fuses.
The etymon cuts.

Risk maps.
Fear warns.
Relation sets both in the between
without welding the root.

Valeu !!!
warn
without pretending that power
and trial
are the same word.
```

## Status

**Approved in Words.** *Danger*: etymon *dominus* (the lord’s power). Crossed with **perigo** (*periculum*, the trial) by [relação](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-relacao.html). Cuts: [risco](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html) · [medo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-medo.html) · [sinal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sinal.html). [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)
inspecao-palavra-danger.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección editorial de la palabra **[Danger](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-danger.html)** — préstamo inglés de la **placa** — **cruzada**, por el método de **[relação](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-relacao.html)**, con el portugués **perigo** (esp. **peligro**). Pedido de campo: inspeccionar *Danger* y cruzarlo con la *relación* de *Perigo*.

Dos salas, un oficio de aviso. El [oído pega](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-a-orelha-cola-o-que-a-boca-juntou.html): DANGER = PERIGO = [risco](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html) = [medo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-medo.html). El étimo **corta**.

| Forma | Abuelo | Oficio antiguo | Oficio en la placa |
|-------|--------|----------------|--------------------|
| **Danger** | lat. [*dominus*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/dominus#Latin) «señor» | el **poder** sobre ti | aviso EN |
| **Perigo / peligro** | lat. [*periculum*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/periculum#Latin) «prueba» | lo que se **atraviesa** | aviso PT / ES |
| **[Risco](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html)** | it. *rischio* | peligro **con mapa** | cálculo |
| **[Medo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-medo.html)** | lat. *metus* | el pecho que anticipa | afecto |

**H-relación:** [relação](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-relacao.html) = poner A y B **en el entre** sin fundir. *Danger* y *perigo* son **equivalentes de placa**, no cognados. El francés guarda **ambas** líneas (*danger* y *péril*); el inglés también (*danger* y *peril*); el portugués se quedó con **perigo** y importa **DANGER** como [señal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sinal.html). El español *peligro* **sí** es cognado de *perigo* — ambos *periculum*, no *dominus*.

> Nota: [danger](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/danger), [perigo](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/perigo), [peligro](https://es.wiktionary.org/wiki/peligro), [*periculum*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/periculum#Latin). **Ficha ≠ norma de seguridad.** Cierre: [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Danger — el señor

El francés antiguo *dangier* es **poder, jurisdicción** — la mano del señor (*dominus*). El daño llega después. El *danger* moderno se quedó con el daño y olvidó al señor. Primo: [*dungeon*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/dungeon) (el *donjon*).

## Perigo / peligro — la prueba

**Perigo** (PT) y **peligro** (ES) no deben nada a *dominus*. Deben a **pasar por**. Latín *periculum*: ensayo, riesgo, peligro. Familia de *experior* — experiencia, experimento, perito.

## Relación — cruzar sin fundir

Poner Danger al lado de perigo / peligro: mismo oficio de aviso, abuelos distintos. [Risco](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html) mapea; [medo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-medo.html) avisa el pecho; [sinal](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sinal.html) es la marca. El caso de calle **Brasil con P de Perigo** (línea de cometa con cerol) vive en [cola / colar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-cola-colar.html).

## Poema del laboratorio

```poem
Danger.
No nació del perigo.
Nació del señor.

Dominus.
El poder sobre ti
se llamaba dangier.
Estar en el danger de alguien
era estar en su mano.

Perigo / peligro.
No nació del señor.
Nació de la prueba.
Periculum:
lo que se atraviesa,
el ensayo que puede fallar.

La placa pega las dos.
DANGER = PERIGO.
El oído funde.
El étimo corta.

Riesgo mapea.
Miedo avisa.
Relación pone las dos en el entre
sin soldar la raíz.

¡Valeu !!!
avisar
sin fingir que el poder
y la prueba
son la misma palabra.
```

## Estado

**Aprobada en Palabras.** *Danger*: étimo *dominus* (poder del señor). Cruce con **perigo** (*periculum*, la prueba) por [relação](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-relacao.html). Cortes: [risco](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html) · [medo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-medo.html). [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)

inspecao-palavra-olho.titleEs: Inspección: Olho — oculus; cruzado con zaroio (zarolho)
inspecao-palavra-olho.excerptEn: Words: olho (Lat. oculus) × zaroio (field voice of zarolho — the eye that does not line up); lh → i; ≠ eye ≠ ophthalmós; Valeu !!!
inspecao-palavra-olho.excerptEs: Palabras: olho (lat. oculus) × zaroio (voz de zarolho — el ojo que no alinea); lh → i; ≠ eye ≠ ophthalmós; ¡Valeu !!!
inspecao-palavra-olho.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **olho** (eye) — Lat. *oculus*. Field request: the **word**. Echo: cross it with **zaroio**.

Two pieces, one field. The **object** is *olho*. The **crossing** is *zaroio* — field voice of **zarolho** (cross-eyed / one-eyed / a look that does not line up). The [ear](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-a-orelha-cola-o-que-a-boca-juntou.html) hears *-oio* (the palatal *lh* turned *i*, as in caipira *olho* → *oio*). The [etymon](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-etimo.html) **cuts**: the eye is *oculus*; the prefix of *zarolho* is the **uncertain** piece (working path: *zanolho* ← *zanaga* + *olho*). Not ophthalmology. Not a slur. Not a third-eye sheet.

> Sources: [olho](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/olho), [*oculus*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/oculus#Latin), [zarolho](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/zarolho), [*zanolho*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/zanolho). Method: [etymology](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-etimologia.html). Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Two pieces

| Piece | Form | Origin | Office |
|-------|------|--------|--------|
| **Organ** | *olho* | Lat. *oculus* | What sees; the look as a noun |
| **Wandered axis** | *zaroio* / *zarolho* | *olho* + uncertain prefix | The eye that does not line up |
| **Field voice** | *zaroio* | *lh* → *i* | The ear; paper keeps *zarolho* |
| **Verb (cut class)** | *eu olho* | same family *olhar* | Homograph — another class |
| **Cut trees** | *ophthalmós* / *eye* | Greek / Germanic | Not the PT etymon |

English *eye* is a parallel, not a parent. Greek *ophthalmós* feeds the clinic’s Latinate vocabulary. Portuguese *olho* is *oculus*.

To name *zaroio* is not to mock. If there is a clinical question, this sheet does not treat it.

## Lab poem

```poem
Olho.
Not the verb I look.
It is the organ.
It is the look named as a noun.

Latin oculus.
Not Greek ophthalmós.
Not English eye.

Zaroio.
The mouth glues lh into i.
Zarolho on paper.
Zaroio in the ear.

The eye that does not go with the other.
It is not a slur.
It is the axis that wandered.

The ear hears oio inside zaroio.
The etymon cuts the uncertain prefix
and keeps the eye.

Valeu !!!
see straight
without mocking the axis.
```

## Status

**Approved in Words.** *olho* < *oculus*. Crossed with *zaroio* / *zarolho*. *Lh* → *i*. Prefix still open. Rooms cut. [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)
inspecao-palavra-olho.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **olho** (ojo) — lat. *oculus*. Pedido: la **palabra**. Eco: cruzarla con **zaroio**.

Dos piezas, un campo. El **objeto** es *olho*. El **cruce** es *zaroio* — voz de campo de **zarolho** (bizco / tuerto / mirada que no alinea). El [oído](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-a-orelha-cola-o-que-a-boca-juntou.html) oye *-oio* (el *lh* palatal vuelto *i*). El [étimo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-etimo.html) **corta**: el ojo es *oculus*; el prefijo de *zarolho* es la pieza **incierta** (vía de trabajo: *zanolho* ← *zanaga* + *olho*). No es oftalmología. No es insulto. No es ficha del tercer ojo.

> Fuentes: [olho](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/olho), [*oculus*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/oculus#Latin), [zarolho](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/zarolho), [*zanolho*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/zanolho). Método: [etimología](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-etimologia.html). Cierre: [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Dos piezas

| Pieza | Forma | Origen | Oficio |
|-------|-------|--------|--------|
| **Órgano** | *olho* | lat. *oculus* | Lo que ve; la mirada como nombre |
| **Eje desviado** | *zaroio* / *zarolho* | *olho* + prefijo incierto | El ojo que no alinea |
| **Voz de campo** | *zaroio* | *lh* → *i* | El oído; el papel guarda *zarolho* |
| **Verbo (clase cortada)** | *eu olho* | misma familia *olhar* | Homógrafo — otra clase |
| **Árboles cortados** | *ophthalmós* / *eye* | griego / germánico | No el étimo PT |

El inglés *eye* es paralelo, no padre. El griego *ophthalmós* alimenta el léxico clínico. El portugués *olho* es *oculus*.

Nombrar *zaroio* no es burlarse. Si hay cuestión clínica, esta ficha no trata.

## Poema del laboratorio

```poem
Olho.
No es el verbo que yo miro.
Es el órgano.
Es la mirada nombrada en sustancia.

Latín oculus.
No es el griego ophthalmós.
No es el inglés eye.

Zaroio.
La boca pega el lh en la i.
Zarolho en el papel.
Zaroio en el oído.

El ojo que no va con el otro.
No es insulto.
Es el eje que se desvió.

El oído oye oio dentro de zaroio.
El étimo corta el prefijo incierto
y guarda el ojo.

¡Valeu !!!
ver derecho
sin burlarse del eje.
```

## Estado

**Aprobada en Palabras.** *olho* < *oculus*. Cruzada con *zaroio* / *zarolho*. *Lh* → *i*. Prefijo abierto. Salas cortadas. [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)

inspecao-palavra-oculos.contentEn:
## Scope

Portuguese **óculos** — the **object**: a pair of lenses in a frame, worn **in front of** the [olho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-olho.html) (eye), on the nose and [ears](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-orelha.html). Field request: inspection of the **object**. Same etymon as the organ (*oculus*); other class. Catalog: [Objetos](/objetos/). Not a prescription. Not a shop. Not a brand sheet. Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Independent audit. [óculos](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/%C3%B3culos), [*oculus*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/oculus#Latin), [Wikipedia](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%93culos). The glasses **do not replace** the eye; they **sit in front**.

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Thing | Two lenses + frame + temples |
| Etymon | Plural of *óculo* ← Lat. *oculus* — “eye” |
| Not | The organ [olho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-olho.html) · contact lens · architectural oculus · VR · a brand |
| Spoken BR | Often *o óculos* (the pair as one thing); lemma stays plural |
| Links | [olho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-olho.html) · [luz](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-luz.html) · [orelha](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-orelha.html) · [risco](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-risco.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-24 |

**Seems:** the glasses see.  
**Is:** the [eye](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-olho.html) sees; the lenses **bend or filter** [light](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-luz.html) on the way.

## Status

**Approved** — óculos as object; same *oculus* as [olho](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-olho.html); other class. No brand affiliation.

inspecao-expressao-dont-show-again.titleEn: Inspection: Don't Show Again × não mostrar de novo — the warning that asks not to return
inspecao-expressao-dont-show-again.titleEs: Inspección: Don't Show Again × não mostrar de novo — el aviso que pide no volver
inspecao-expressao-dont-show-again.excerptEn: Sayings: Don't Show Again × não mostrar de novo — EN×PT dialog; show=look × mostrar=warn; de novo ≠ the new; Valeu !!!
inspecao-expressao-dont-show-again.excerptEs: Dichos: Don't Show Again × não mostrar de novo — caja EN×PT; show=mirar × mostrar=avisar; de novo ≠ lo nuevo; ¡Valeu !!!
inspecao-expressao-dont-show-again.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of **«[Don't Show Again](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-dont-show-again.html)»** crossed with Portuguese **«não mostrar de novo»**. Field request: inspect *Dont Show Again* crossed with *não mostrar de novo*.

Two mouths, one office. English dialog-box speech asks **not to put it in view again**. Portuguese calques: **não mostrar de novo** / *não mostrar novamente*. Object = the **preference locution** — the [gesture](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) that cuts the [loop](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-loop-infinito.html) of a [warning](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sinal.html). Not a cookie tutorial. Not a recipe to bypass consent. Not the stage *show*.

> Sources: [don't](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/don%27t), [show](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/show#English), [again](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/again), [não](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/n%C3%A3o), [mostrar](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/mostrar), [de novo](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/de_novo), [mōnstrō](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/monstro#Latin), [scēawian](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/sceawian). Method: [etymology](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-etimologia.html). **Sheet ≠ localStorage class, ≠ dark-pattern playbook.** Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) · [eu amo a vida](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-eu-amo-a-vida.html).

## The cross

| Mouth | Pieces | Office |
|-------|--------|--------|
| **EN** | *Don't* + *Show* + *Again* | Do not **put in view** again |
| **PT** | *não* + *mostrar* + *de novo* | Do not **point / warn** again |
| **Field** | *Dont* (no apostrophe) | The mark drops; the etymon does **not** |
| **PT glue** | *de novo* heard as «the new one» | [Ear](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-a-orelha-cola-o-que-a-boca-juntou.html) — not the UI office |

**H-gold:** EN *show* ← *scēawian* (look / inspect). PT *mostrar* ← *mōnstrāre* / *moneō* (point / **warn**). Same checkbox, two trees. [Skip](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-pular.html) is **this time**; Don't Show Again is **from here on**. [Miss Click](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-miss-click.html) on the tick stores the preference by accident.

```poem
Don't Show Again.
Não mostrar de novo.
Two mouths, one office:
the warning asks not to return.

Don't: do + not.
Show: put in view — look.
Again: once more.

Não: Latin non.
Mostrar: monstrare — point, warn.
De novo: from the new — another time.

English hides the look.
Portuguese hides the warning.
The box is the same.

Dont without the apostrophe
is not a name.
It is Don't without the mark.

De novo is not the new one.
It is the once-more.

Skip is this time.
Don't Show Again is from here on.
The loop asks for a stop condition.
The inspector, sometimes, looks again.

Valeu !!!
hide the nag,
without hiding the risk.
```

## Status

**Approved in Sayings.** *Don't Show Again* × *não mostrar de novo*: one preference office; *show*/look × *mostrar*/warn; field spelling *Dont*; glue *de novo* ≠ the new; skip ≠ from here on. Rooms cut. [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)
inspecao-expressao-dont-show-again.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **«[Don't Show Again](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-dont-show-again.html)»** cruzada con **«não mostrar de novo»**. Pedido de campo: inspeccionar *Dont Show Again* cruzado con *não mostrar de novo*.

Dos bocas, un oficio. El inglés de la caja de diálogo pide **no poner a la vista otra vez**. El portugués calca: **não mostrar de novo** / *não mostrar novamente*. Objeto = la **locución de preferencia** — el [gesto](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-gesto.html) que corta el [loop](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-loop-infinito.html) de un [aviso](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-sinal.html). No es tutorial de cookie. No es receta para burlar consentimiento. No es el espectáculo (*show*).

> Fuentes: [don't](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/don%27t), [show](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/show#English), [again](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/again), [não](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/n%C3%A3o), [mostrar](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/mostrar), [de novo](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/de_novo), [mōnstrō](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/monstro#Latin), [scēawian](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/sceawian). Método: [etimología](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-etimologia.html). **Ficha ≠ clase de localStorage, ≠ playbook de dark pattern.** Cierre: [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html) · [eu amo a vida](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-eu-amo-a-vida.html).

## El cruce

| Boca | Piezas | Oficio |
|------|--------|--------|
| **EN** | *Don't* + *Show* + *Again* | No **poner a la vista** otra vez |
| **PT** | *não* + *mostrar* + *de novo* | No **señalar / avisar** otra vez |
| **Campo** | *Dont* (sin apóstrofo) | Cae la marca; el étimo **no** |
| **Cola PT** | *de novo* oído como «lo nuevo» | [Oído](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-a-orelha-cola-o-que-a-boca-juntou.html) — no el oficio de la UI |

**H-oro:** EN *show* ← *scēawian* (mirar / inspeccionar). PT *mostrar* ← *mōnstrāre* / *moneō* (señalar / **avisar**). La misma caja, dos árboles. [Pular](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-pular.html) es **esta vez**; Don't Show Again es **de aquí en adelante**. [Miss Click](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-miss-click.html) en el visto graba la preferencia sin querer.

```poem
Don't Show Again.
Não mostrar de novo.
Dos bocas, un oficio:
el aviso pide no volver.

Don't: do + not.
Show: poner a la vista — mirar.
Again: una vez más.

Não: latín non.
Mostrar: monstrare — señalar, avisar.
De novo: desde lo nuevo — otra vez.

El inglés esconde la mirada.
El portugués esconde el aviso.
La caja es la misma.

Dont sin apóstrofo
no es un nombre.
Es Don't sin la marca.

De novo no es lo nuevo.
Es el otra vez.

Saltar es esta vez.
Don't Show Again es de aquí en adelante.
El loop pide condición de parada.
El inspector, a veces, mira de nuevo.

¡Valeu !!!
esconder el nag,
sin esconder el riesgo.
```

## Estado

**Aprobada en Expresiones.** *Don't Show Again* × *não mostrar de novo*: un oficio de preferencia; *show*/mirar × *mostrar*/avisar; grafía de campo *Dont*; cola *de novo* ≠ lo nuevo; saltar ≠ de aquí en adelante. Salas cortadas. [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)

inspecao-palavra-genocidio.titleEn: Inspection: Genocídio — the name of destroying a group as a group; ≠ war ≠ slogan
inspecao-palavra-genocidio.titleEs: Inspección: Genocídio — el nombre de destruir un grupo como grupo; ≠ guerra ≠ eslogan
inspecao-palavra-genocidio.excerptEn: Words: genocídio (génos + -cīdium; Lemkin 1944) — 1948 Convention · Law 2.889/1956; ≠ war ≠ massacre ≠ slavery; Valeu !!!
inspecao-palavra-genocidio.excerptEs: Palabras: genocídio (génos + -cīdium; Lemkin 1944) — Convención 1948 · Ley 2.889/1956; ≠ guerra ≠ masacre ≠ esclavitud; ¡Valeu !!!
inspecao-palavra-genocidio.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **genocídio** — Gk. *génos* («people, kind, stock») + Lat. *-cīdium* (*caedere*, «to cut / to kill»). Field request: *Inpeçao em Genocidio*. The object is the **word**: a **1944** coinage (Raphael Lemkin) for the crime of destroying a **group as a group**. Not a court. Not a manifesto. Not a case list. Not [war](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-guerra-do-paraguai.html), [slavery](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-escravidao.html), [persecution](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-perseguicao.html), or homicide.

Legal core: [UN Convention, 9 Dec. 1948](https://www.ohchr.org/pt/instruments-mechanisms/instruments/convention-prevention-and-punishment-crime-genocide) (Art. II) — intent to destroy, in whole or in part, a national, ethnical, racial or religious group as such. Brazil: [Law 2.889/1956](https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/leis/L2889.htm). Political use in BR (including [UNIFESP XIV](/biblioteca/unifesp/livro-xiv.html) on cannabis / Black youth) is **semantic travel**, not a verdict.

## Lab poem

```poem
Genocídio.
A new word
for an old crime.

Génos — the people, the kind, the stock.
-Cide — the cut that kills.

Not war alone.
Not massacre alone.
Not the killing of one.
Not slavery under another name.

It is the name of destroying
a group as a group —
and that asks a court,
not a slogan.

The lab honours the weight
and cuts the rooms.
It makes no list.
It makes no hymn.

Valeu !!!
with respect —
no sermon on the word.
```

## Status

**Approved in Words.** Group-as-group ≠ war ≠ massacre ≠ slogan. Rooms cut. [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)
inspecao-palavra-genocidio.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **genocídio** — gr. *génos* («pueblo, género, linaje») + lat. *-cīdium* (*caedere*). Pedido: *Inpeçao em Genocidio*. El objeto es el **vocablo**: acuñación de **1944** (Raphael Lemkin) para destruir un **grupo como grupo**. No es tribunal. No es manifiesto. No es lista de casos. No es [guerra](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-guerra-do-paraguai.html), [esclavitud](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-escravidao.html), [persecución](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-perseguicao.html) ni homicidio.

Núcleo jurídico: [Convención ONU, 9 dic. 1948](https://www.ohchr.org/pt/instruments-mechanisms/instruments/convention-prevention-and-punishment-crime-genocide) (art. II). Brasil: [Ley 2.889/1956](https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/leis/L2889.htm). El uso político BR (incl. [UNIFESP XIV](/biblioteca/unifesp/livro-xiv.html)) es **viaje semántico**, no sentencia.

## Poema del laboratorio

```poem
Genocídio.
Palabra nueva
para un crimen antiguo.

Génos — el pueblo, el género, el tronco.
-Cidio — el corte que mata.

No es la guerra sola.
No es la masacre sola.
No es el homicidio de uno.
No es la esclavitud con otro nombre.

Es el nombre de destruir
un grupo como grupo —
y eso pide tribunal,
no eslogan.

El laboratorio honra el peso
y corta las salas.
No hace lista.
No hace himno.

¡Valeu !!!
con respeto —
sin sermón en el vocablo.
```

## Estado

**Aprobada en Palabras.** Grupo-como-grupo ≠ guerra ≠ masacre ≠ eslogan. Salas cortadas. [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)

inspecao-palavra-restore.titleEn: Inspection: Restore — set back on its feet; crossed with Back, Backup and Up
inspecao-palavra-restore.titleEs: Inspección: Restore — poner de pie; cruzado con Back, Backup y Up
inspecao-palavra-restore.excerptEn: Words: restore (Lat. restaurāre) × back (Gmc bæc) × backup (back+up) × up (Gmc upp) — four rooms, one circuit; Restoure = slip; ≠ restore back; Valeu !!!
inspecao-palavra-restore.excerptEs: Palabras: restore (lat. restaurāre) × back (germ. bæc) × backup (back+up) × up (germ. upp) — cuatro salas, un circuito; Restoure = lapsus; ≠ restore back; ¡Valeu !!!
inspecao-palavra-restore.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of the family **restore · back · backup · up**. Field request: *Restoure Back, Backup, Up*.

Four rooms, one circuit. **Up** is the Germanic vector (upward / complete / online). **Back** is the return and the spine. **Backup** is the compound *back* + *up*: support from behind, then the spare copy. **Restore** is Latin *restaurāre*: set back on its feet. The [ear](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-a-orelha-cola-o-que-a-boca-juntou.html) glues them; the etymon **cuts**. Slip **Restoure** = Restore (like *Longin* for Login). Tautology **restore back** cut. Restaurant = same Latin tree, other office. Not a disaster-recovery tutorial.

> Sources: [restore](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/restore), [restaurāre](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/restauro#Latin), [restaurar](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/restaurar), [back](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/back#English), [backup](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/backup), [up](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/up#English). Method: [etymology](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-etimologia.html). Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Four lineages

| Lineage | Piece | Origin | Office |
|---------|-------|--------|--------|
| **Up** | *upp* | Germanic — upward / complete / online | The **vector** |
| **Back** | *bæc* | Germanic — the back, the return | The **return** |
| **Backup** | *back* + *up* | Compound — hold from behind | The **spare** |
| **Restore** | *restaurāre* | Latin — set on its feet again | The **re-standing** |
| **Cut slip** | *Restoure* | Mouth × PT *restauro* | Not the lemma |
| **Cut tautology** | *restore back* | Redundant calque | Restore **already** returns |

Backup without a tested restore is a paper shield. Restore without a backup asks the air for a miracle. *Upar* (level up) is another room of *up*. [Backspace](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-backspace.html) erases; it does not keep the spare. [Save Game](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-save-game.html) records the match — a sister trail, another sheet.

## Lab poem

```poem
Restore.
It is not the mouth’s Restoure.
It is not the restaurant.
It is to set back on its feet.

Up is the vector.
Back is the return.
Backup is both pieces
holding from behind.

Whoever restores without a copy
asks for a miracle.
Whoever copies and never tests
holds paper.

Restore back
says twice
the same door.

Valeu !!!
the copy in place
and the gesture of return.
```

## Status

**Approved in Words.** *restore* < *restaurāre*. Crossed with *back*, *backup* and *up*. Four rooms. Slip *Restoure* read. [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)
inspecao-palavra-restore.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de la familia **restore · back · backup · up**. Pedido: *Restoure Back, Backup, Up*.

Cuatro salas, un circuito. **Up** es el vector germánico (arriba / completar / en el aire). **Back** es el regreso y la espalda. **Backup** es el compuesto *back* + *up*: sostener por detrás, luego la copia de reserva. **Restore** es latín *restaurāre*: poner de pie otra vez. El [oído](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-a-orelha-cola-o-que-a-boca-juntou.html) pega; el étimo **corta**. Lapsus **Restoure** = Restore. Tautología **restore back** cortada. Restaurante = mismo árbol latino, otro oficio. No es tutorial de disaster recovery.

> Fuentes: [restore](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/restore), [restaurāre](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/restauro#Latin), [restaurar](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/restaurar), [back](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/back#English), [backup](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/backup), [up](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/up#English). Método: [etimología](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-etimologia.html). Cierre: [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Cuatro linajes

| Linaje | Pieza | Origen | Oficio |
|--------|-------|--------|--------|
| **Up** | *upp* | Germánico — arriba / completar / en el aire | El **vector** |
| **Back** | *bæc* | Germánico — espalda, regreso | El **retorno** |
| **Backup** | *back* + *up* | Compuesto — sostener por detrás | La **reserva** |
| **Restore** | *restaurāre* | Latín — poner de pie otra vez | El **reerguir** |
| **Lapsus** | *Restoure* | Boca × PT *restauro* | No es el lema |
| **Tautología** | *restore back* | Calco redundante | Restore **ya** vuelve |

Backup sin restore ensayado es papel. Restore sin backup pide milagro al aire. *Upar* es otra sala de *up*. [Backspace](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-backspace.html) borra; no guarda la reserva. [Save Game](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-save-game.html) graba la partida — rastro hermano, otra ficha.

## Poema del laboratorio

```poem
Restore.
No es el Restoure de la boca.
No es el restaurante.
Es poner de pie otra vez.

Up es el vector.
Back es el regreso.
Backup son las dos piezas
sosteniendo por detrás.

Quien restaura sin copia
pide milagro.
Quien copia y nunca prueba
sostiene papel.

Restore back
dice dos veces
la misma puerta.

¡Valeu !!!
la copia en su sitio
y el gesto de volver.
```

## Estado

**Aprobada en Palabras.** *restore* < *restaurāre*. Cruzado con *back*, *backup* y *up*. Cuatro salas. Lapsus *Restoure* leído. [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)

inspecao-derivado-leite.excerptEn: Harmful products: milk and dairy (*Bos taurus*) — UHT, milk powder, cheese, sweetened yogurt and dairy drinks versus traditional milk. Family hub; protein on the casein sheet; animal on the cattle sheet.
inspecao-derivado-leite.excerptEs: Productos nocivos: leche y lácteos (*Bos taurus*) — UHT, leche en polvo, queso, yogur azucarado y bebidas lácteas frente a leche tradicional. Hub de la familia; proteína en caseína; animal en la vaca.
inspecao-derivado-leite.contentEn:
## Scope

Editorial inspection of **milk** and **dairy** — from milking to the shelf — as a **harmful product** when **dose**, **processing** and the **industrial matrix** collide. This sheet is the **family hub**: fluid milk, UHT, powder, cheese, yogurt, butter, whey, condensed milk, dairy drinks and ice cream. The isolated protein lives in [casein](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-caseina.html); the animal in [cattle](/animais/vaca/); processed meats in [cattle derivatives](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-vaca.html).

> **Method note:** independent BudGanja audit. **Not medical or dietary advice.** The cow and traditional fresh milk are **not** absolute villains; the focus is the **industrial dairy chain**. Indexing [Lair Ribeiro](/posts/post-inspecao-divulgacao-lair-ribeiro.html) ≠ endorsing every claim.

## Do not merge rooms

| Room | Sheet |
|------|-------|
| Animal | [Cattle](/animais/vaca/) |
| Dairy family | **This sheet** |
| Protein | [Casein](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-caseina.html) |
| Meats | [Cattle derivatives](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-vaca.html) |
| Snack matrix | [Industrial chocolate](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-chocolate.html) |

## Inspected object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Name | **Milk** and **dairy** |
| Animal origin | *Bos taurus* — [cattle sheet](/animais/vaca/) |
| Risk focus | UHT/powder milk + ultra-processed dairy |
| Series | Harmful products |
| Inspection date | 2026-08-24 |

## What milk is

Cow’s milk is mostly **water** plus **lactose**, **fat**, **casein** (~80% of protein), **whey** and minerals. The lab does not argue “milk = poison”; it asks **which milk**, **which matrix**, **which dose**.

**H1:** separate **milking / culture** from **UHT cartons and milk powder**.  
**H2:** “I don’t tolerate milk” may be lactose, casein, both — or only the sweetened ultra-processed drink.  
**H3:** Brazilian shelves mix legal milk with **dairy drinks** and chocolate milks — the word “leite” on the ad is not enough.

## Family map

| Product | BudGanja reading |
|---------|------------------|
| Fresh / short-life pasteurised | Low–intermediate |
| UHT carton | Intermediate — Brazil’s default shelf milk |
| Milk powder / dairy solids | High in snacks and formulas |
| Artisan cheese | Dose and tolerance — do not demonise the craft |
| Sweetened yogurt / dairy dessert | High — [sugarcane](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-cana-de-acucar.html) + dairy |
| Condensed milk | High — [WHO free sugars](/posts/post-inspecao-artigo-oms-acucares-livres-2015.html) |
| Dairy drink / chocolate milk | High — not “a glass of milk” |
| Ice cream | High — [Hall 2019](/posts/post-inspecao-artigo-hall-ultraprocessados-2019.html) matrix |
| Whey / caseinates | [Casein](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-caseina.html) |

## Lactose ≠ casein ≠ added sugar

1. **Lactose** — milk sugar; lactase deficiency ≠ IgE allergy.  
2. **Casein** — protein; see [casein](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-caseina.html) and [Brooke-Taylor 2017](/posts/post-inspecao-artigo-brooke-taylor-caseina-a1-a2-2017.html). Human evidence **heterogeneous**.  
3. **Added sugar** — what turns yogurt into dessert; same axis as [sugarcane](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-cana-de-acucar.html).

## Labels to watch (Brazil)

- **Milk** vs **dairy drink** vs **dairy compound**;
- milk powder, dairy solids, whey, caseinates;
- sugar / glucose syrup in yogurt and chocolate milk;
- long lists + flavour = ultra-processed even with a cow in the ad.

## Network

[Cattle](/animais/vaca/) · [Casein](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-caseina.html) · [Industrial chocolate](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-chocolate.html) · [Sugarcane](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-cana-de-acucar.html) · [Gluten](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-gluten.html) · [Lair](/posts/post-inspecao-divulgacao-lair-ribeiro.html) · [Harms × videos](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-analise-danos-videos.html)

**Editorial verdict:** traditional milk and craft cheese deserve cultural context; **powder**, **sweetened dairy drinks** and **ultra-processed dairy** deserve an alert — with method, without panic.

## Hub

Return to [Harmful products](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-derivados) and the [animals catalog](/animais/).
inspecao-derivado-leite.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección editorial de la **leche** y los **lácteos** — del ordeño al estante — como **producto nocivo** cuando **dosis**, **procesamiento** y **matriz industrial** se cruzan. Esta ficha es el **hub de la familia**: leche fluida, UHT, en polvo, queso, yogur, mantequilla, suero, condensada, bebidas lácteas y helados. La proteína aislada está en [caseína](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-caseina.html); el animal en [vaca](/animais/vaca/); las carnes en [derivados de la vaca](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-vaca.html).

> **Nota metodológica:** auditoría independiente BudGanja. **No es consejo médico ni nutricional.** La vaca y la leche fresca tradicional **no** son villanos absolutos; el foco es la **cadena láctea industrial**. Indexar [Lair Ribeiro](/posts/post-inspecao-divulgacao-lair-ribeiro.html) ≠ respaldar cada claim.

## No fusionar las salas

| Sala | Ficha |
|------|-------|
| Animal | [Vaca](/animais/vaca/) |
| Familia láctea | **Esta ficha** |
| Proteína | [Caseína](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-caseina.html) |
| Carnes | [Derivados de la vaca](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-vaca.html) |
| Matriz snack | [Chocolate industrial](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-chocolate.html) |

## Objeto inspeccionado

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Nombre | **Leche** y **lácteos** |
| Origen animal | *Bos taurus* — [ficha](/animais/vaca/) |
| Producto de riesgo | Leche UHT/polvo + lácteos ultraprocesados |
| Serie | Productos nocivos |
| Fecha | 2026-08-24 |

## Qué es la leche

La leche de vaca es sobre todo **agua** con **lactosa**, **grasa**, **caseína** (~80% de la proteína), **suero** y minerales. El laboratorio no dice «leche = veneno»; pregunta **cuál leche**, **en qué matriz**, **con qué dosis**.

**H1:** separar **ordeño / cultura** de **brik UHT y leche en polvo**.  
**H2:** «no tolero la leche» puede ser lactosa, caseína, ambas — o solo el ultraprocesado azucarado.  
**H3:** en Brasil el estante mezcla leche legal con **bebida láctea** y chocolatadas — el nombre «leite» en el anuncio no basta.

## Mapa de la familia

| Producto | Lectura BudGanja |
|----------|------------------|
| Fresca / pasteurizada de corta vida | Bajo–intermedio |
| UHT | Intermedio — patrón BR de estante |
| Leche en polvo / sólidos lácteos | Alto en snacks y fórmulas |
| Queso artesanal | Dosis y tolerancia — no demonizar el oficio |
| Yogur azucarado / postre lácteo | Alto — [caña](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-cana-de-acucar.html) + lácteo |
| Leche condensada | Alto — [OMS azúcares libres](/posts/post-inspecao-artigo-oms-acucares-livres-2015.html) |
| Bebida láctea / chocolatada | Alto — no es «un vaso de leche» |
| Helado | Alto — matriz [Hall 2019](/posts/post-inspecao-artigo-hall-ultraprocessados-2019.html) |
| Whey / caseinatos | [Caseína](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-caseina.html) |

## Lactosa ≠ caseína ≠ azúcar añadido

1. **Lactosa** — azúcar de la leche; déficit de lactasa ≠ alergia IgE.  
2. **Caseína** — proteína; ver [caseína](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-caseina.html) y [Brooke-Taylor 2017](/posts/post-inspecao-artigo-brooke-taylor-caseina-a1-a2-2017.html). Evidencia humana **heterogénea**.  
3. **Azúcar añadido** — convierte el yogur en postre; mismo eje que [caña](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-cana-de-acucar.html).

## Etiquetas a observar (Brasil)

- **Leche** vs **bebida láctea** vs **compuesto lácteo**;
- leche en polvo, sólidos lácteos, suero, caseinatos;
- azúcar / jarabe en yogur y chocolatada;
- lista larga + aroma = ultraprocesado aunque haya vaca en el anuncio.

## Red

[Vaca](/animais/vaca/) · [Caseína](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-caseina.html) · [Chocolate industrial](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-chocolate.html) · [Caña](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-cana-de-acucar.html) · [Gluten](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-gluten.html) · [Lair](/posts/post-inspecao-divulgacao-lair-ribeiro.html) · [Daños × vídeos](/posts/post-inspecao-derivado-analise-danos-videos.html)

**Veredicto editorial:** la leche tradicional y el queso de oficio merecen contexto; la **leche en polvo**, las **bebidas lácteas azucaradas** y los **lácteos ultraprocesados** merecen alerta — con método, sin pánico.

## Hub

Volver a [Productos nocivos](/biblioteca/inspecoes/#inspecoes-derivados) y al [catálogo de animales](/animais/).

inspecao-palavra-vinte-e-dois.titleEn: Inspection: 22 — vinte e dois; inverted it becomes s2, the chat heart
inspecao-palavra-vinte-e-dois.titleEs: Inspección: 22 — vinte e dois; invertido vira s2, el corazón del chat
inspecao-palavra-vinte-e-dois.excerptEn: Words: 22 / vinte e dois — Lat. vīgintī + duo; 2×11; invert 2 into S → s2 (chat heart ≠ organ); ≠ Catch-22; Valeu !!!
inspecao-palavra-vinte-e-dois.excerptEs: Palabras: 22 / vinte e dois — lat. vīgintī + duo; 2×11; invertir el 2 pega en S → s2 (corazón de chat ≠ órgano); ≠ Catch-22; ¡Valeu !!!
inspecao-palavra-vinte-e-dois.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **vinte e dois** (digit **22**). Field: invert **22** into **s2**. Standing **22** is the cardinal (*vīgintī* + *duo*; **2 × 11**). **s2** is Brazilian chat-heart — not the [organ](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-coracao.html). **Catch-22** and season **S2** are other rooms.

> Independent audit. Inversion 2→S is **eye / speech**, not a type law. Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Word | **vinte e dois** · **22** |
| Path | Lat. *vīgintī* + *duo* |
| Math | **2 × 11** · palindrome |
| Invert | **22** → **s2** (first 2 reads as **S**) |
| Cut | Catch-22 · season S2 · organ [coração](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-coracao.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-24 |

## Lab poem

```poem
Twenty-two.

Two twos, shoulder to shoulder.
They are not twins by birth.
They are the same stroke, repeated.

They count.
Two times eleven.
Even.
Front and back: 22.
The palindrome does not ask for luck.

It is not Catch-22.
The paradox lives in another book.
It is not season two.
Series S2 is another room.

Invert the first two.
The stroke lies down and turns S.
It becomes s2.

s2 is not the organ.
The organ is called heart.
s2 is the chat’s chest:
S and 2 drawing a note
with two glyphs.

The number stays 22.
The screen writes s2.
Affection passes in the note.
The cardinal keeps counting.

Valeu !!!
twenty-two standing,
s2 in the note,
without fusing the chest to the paradox.
```

## Verdict

**Approved** — cardinal + inverted glyph; chat-heart cut from the organ; paradox stays in Heller’s book.

inspecao-palavra-vinte-e-dois.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **vinte e dois** (dígito **22**). Pedido: invertir **22** en **s2**. El **22** de pie es el cardinal (*vīgintī* + *duo*; **2 × 11**). **s2** es el corazón de chat BR — no el [órgano](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-coracao.html). **Catch-22** y la temporada **S2** son otras salas.

> Auditoría independiente. La inversión 2→S es **ojo / habla**, no ley tipográfica. Cierre: [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Palabra | **vinte e dois** · **22** |
| Étimo | lat. *vīgintī* + *duo* |
| Matemática | **2 × 11** · palíndromo |
| Inversión | **22** → **s2** (el primer 2 se lee **S**) |
| Corte | Catch-22 · temporada S2 · órgano [coração](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-coracao.html) |
| Fecha | 2026-08-24 |

## Poema del laboratorio

```poem
Veintidós.

Dos doses, hombro con hombro.
No son gemelos de nacimiento.
Son el mismo trazo, repetido.

Cuentan.
Dos veces once.
Par.
De frente y de espaldas: 22.
El palíndromo no pide suerte.

No es Catch-22.
El paradoja vive en otro libro.
No es la segunda temporada.
S2 de serie es otra sala.

Invierte el primer dos.
El trazo se acuesta y vira S.
Queda s2.

s2 no es el órgano.
El órgano se llama corazón.
s2 es el pecho del chat:
S y 2 dibujando un recado
con dos glifos.

El número sigue 22.
La pantalla escribe s2.
El afecto pasa en el recado.
El cardinal sigue contando.

¡Valeu !!!
veintidós de pie,
s2 en el recado,
sin fundir el pecho en la paradoja.
```

## Veredicto

**Aprobado** — cardinal + glifo invertido; corazón de chat cortado del órgano; la paradoja queda en el libro de Heller.

inspecao-palavra-incineradora.excerptEs: Objeto: «incineradora» (pedido Inceneradora → canónica; in- + cinis + -dora) — horno que hace ceniza; ≠ cenicero ≠ hogera ≠ away; ¡Valeu !!!
inspecao-palavra-incineradora.contentEn:
## Scope

Portuguese **incineradora** (requested spelling “Inceneradora” → canonical **incineradora**) — the **object**: an industrial furnace / plant that reduces matter to **ash**. Same *cinis* tree as [cinzeiro](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-cinzeiro.html) (ashtray): that **holds** ash; this **makes** it. Catalog: [Objetos](/objetos/). Not a how-to. Not a waste-to-energy ad. Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Independent audit. [incinerar](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/incinerar), Lat. [*cinis*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/cinis#Latin), [Wikipedia · Incineration](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Incinera%C3%A7%C3%A3o). The incinerator **does not make stuff vanish**; it **turns it into ash and gas**.

## Object

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Thing | Combustion chamber + chimney + ash / slag |
| Etymon | *incinerar* + *-dora* ← Lat. *incinerāre* ← *in-* + *cinis* “ash” |
| Requested spelling | *Inceneradora* (e) → **incineradora** (i) |
| Not | [Cinzeiro](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-cinzeiro.html) · open bonfire · bakery oven · crematorium · [extintor](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-extintor.html) |
| Links | [fogo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fogo.html) · [incêndio](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-incendio.html) · [A História das Coisas](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-a-historia-das-coisas.html) · [Annie Leonard](/posts/post-inspecao-figura-annie-leonard.html) |
| Date | 2026-08-24 |

**Seems:** trash goes “away.”  
**Is:** matter **changes form**. [How the rich transform things](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-como-os-ricos-transformam-as-coisas.html) — transform ≠ disappear.

## Status

**Approved** — incineradora as object; same *cinis* as [cinzeiro](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-cinzeiro.html); other scale. No plant affiliation.

inspecao-palavra-incineradora.contentEs:
## Alcance

**Incineradora** (portugués; pedido *Inceneradora* → canónica **incineradora**) — el **objeto**: horno / planta industrial que reduce materia a **ceniza**. Mismo árbol *cinis* que [cinzeiro](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-cinzeiro.html): aquel **guarda**; esta **hace**. Catálogo: [Objetos](/objetos/). No es receta. No es anuncio. Cierre: [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

> Auditoría independiente. [incinerar](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/incinerar), lat. [*cinis*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/cinis#Latin). La incineradora **no hace desaparecer** las cosas; las **vuelve ceniza y gas**.

## Objeto

| Campo | Valor |
|-------|-------|
| Cosa | Cámara + chimenea + ceniza / escoria |
| Étimo | *incinerar* + *-dora* ← lat. *incinerāre* ← *in-* + *cinis* |
| Grafía | *Inceneradora* (e) → **incineradora** (i) |
| No es | [Cinzeiro](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-cinzeiro.html) · hogera · horno de pan · crematorio · [extintor](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-extintor.html) |
| Vínculos | [fogo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-fogo.html) · [incêndio](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-incendio.html) · [A História das Coisas](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-a-historia-das-coisas.html) |
| Fecha | 2026-08-24 |

**Parece:** la basura se va.  
**Es:** la materia **cambia de forma**. Transformar ≠ desaparecer.

## Estado

**Aprobada** — incineradora como objeto; el mismo *cinis* que [cinzeiro](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-cinzeiro.html); otra escala. Sin afiliación.

inspecao-palavra-ramela.titleEn: Inspection: Ramela — ramelento ≠ remo lento (slow oar)
inspecao-palavra-ramela.excerptEn: Words: ramela / remela (eye rheum; obscure origin) × ramelento (ramela + -ento) ≠ remo lento (rēmus × lentus); Valeu !!!
inspecao-palavra-ramela.excerptEs: Palabras: ramela / remela (lagaña; origen oscuro) × ramelento (ramela + -ento) ≠ remo lento (rēmus × lentus); ¡Valeu !!!
inspecao-palavra-ramela.contentEn:
## Scope

Inspection of Portuguese **ramela** / **ramelento** and the ear-glue **remo lento** (“slow oar”). Field request: the **word** ramela, ramelento, and its relation to remo lento.

Three rooms. **Ramela** (lemma twin **remela**) is rheum in the corner of the [eye](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-olho.html) after sleep. Origin **obscure** (Aulete; EN Wiktionary *unknown*). **Ramelento** is *ramela* + *-ento*: having rheum; by extension sticky / sluggish. **Remo lento** is two other trees: [remo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-remo.html) ← Lat. *rēmus* (oar) and *lento* ← Lat. *lentus* (slow). The [ear](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-a-orelha-cola-o-que-a-boca-juntou.html) glues *ramelento* to *remo-lento*. The [etymon](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-etimo.html) **cuts**.

> Sources: [ramela](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/ramela), [remela](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/remela), [Aulete](https://www.aulete.com.br/remela), [remo](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/remo), [*lentus*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/lentus#Latin). Method: [etymology](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-etimologia.html). Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Three rooms

| Room | Piece | Origin | Office |
|------|-------|--------|--------|
| **Ramela** | *ramela* / *remela* | Obscure; Galician cognate | Rheum in the eye |
| **Ramelento** | *ramela* + *-ento* | Portuguese derivation | Having ramela; sluggish |
| **Remo lento** | *rēmus* + *lentus* | Two Latin trees | [Oar](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-remo.html) that does not hurry |
| **Cut folk** | remela ← *rēmus* / *mucilla* | Shape / mucus stories | Low confidence |

Waking with ramela may **feel** like rowing slowly. That is office, not blood.

## Lab poem

```poem
Ramela.
It is not a small oar.
It is the corner of the eye
after sleep.

Ramelento.
The ear hears slow oar.
The etymon cuts:
ramela plus -ento.

Remo is the blade.
Lento is lentus.
Whoever wakes with ramela
rows slowly
without being an oar.

Valeu !!!
clear the corner
without fusing the trees.
```

## Status

**Approved in Words.** *ramela* ≠ small oar. *ramelento* ≠ *remo lento*. Etymon of *remela* left open. [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)
inspecao-palavra-ramela.contentEs:
## Alcance

Inspección de **ramela** / **ramelento** y la cola de oído **remo lento**. Pedido: la **palabra** ramela, ramelento y su relación con remo lento.

Tres salas. **Ramela** (lema hermano **remela**) es la lagaña en el rincón del [ojo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-olho.html) después del sueño. Origen **oscuro** (Aulete; Wiktionary *unknown*). **Ramelento** es *ramela* + *-ento*: quien tiene ramela; por extensión, pegajoso / perezoso al despertar. **Remo lento** son dos árboles: [remo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-remo.html) ← lat. *rēmus* y *lento* ← lat. *lentus*. El [oído](/posts/post-inspecao-expressao-a-orelha-cola-o-que-a-boca-juntou.html) pega *ramelento* a *remo-lento*. El [étimo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-etimo.html) **corta**.

> Fuentes: [ramela](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/ramela), [remela](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/remela), [Aulete](https://www.aulete.com.br/remela), [remo](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/remo), [*lentus*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/lentus#Latin). Método: [etimología](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-etimologia.html). Cierre: [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Tres salas

| Sala | Pieza | Origen | Oficio |
|------|-------|--------|--------|
| **Ramela** | *ramela* / *remela* | Oscuro; cognado gallego | Lagaña |
| **Ramelento** | *ramela* + *-ento* | Derivación portuguesa | Quien tiene ramela |
| **Remo lento** | *rēmus* + *lentus* | Dos árboles latinos | [Remo](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-remo.html) sin prisa |
| **Folclore cortado** | remela ← *rēmus* / *mucilla* | Forma / muco | Confianza baja |

Despertar con ramela puede **parecer** remar despacio. Eso es oficio, no sangre.

## Poema del laboratorio

```poem
Ramela.
No es un remo pequeño.
Es el rincón del ojo
después del sueño.

Ramelento.
El oído oye remo lento.
El étimo corta:
ramela más ento.

Remo es la pala.
Lento es lentus.
Quien despierta con ramela
rema despacio
sin ser remo.

¡Valeu !!!
limpiar el rincón
sin fundir los árboles.
```

## Estado

**Aprobada en Palabras.** *ramela* ≠ remo pequeño. *ramelento* ≠ *remo lento*. Étimo de *remela* abierto. [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)

inspecao-palavra-parabola.contentEn:
## Scope

Study page for Portuguese **parábola** and Latin **parabola** — one sheet, two rooms. Greek *parabolḗ* (*para-* “beside” + *bállein* “to throw”): to throw a comparison **beside** the thing. Field request: inspect *Parabola*; then: a dedicated page for parabolas, Latin and Portuguese together.

Room A = the **story** that teaches by comparison (EN *parable*). Room B = the **curve** (EN *parabola*; conic; focus and directrix). Daughter [palavra](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-palavra.html) (“word”) is **another** sheet. Not a catechism. Not a full conics course.

> Sources: [Wiktionary](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/par%C3%A1bola), Lat. [*parabola*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/parabola#Latin), Gk. [*parabolḗ*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%CF%80%CE%B1%CF%81%CE%B1%CE%B2%CE%BF%CE%BB%CE%AE#Ancient_Greek), [*parable*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/parable) / [*parabola*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/parabola). Method: [etymology](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-etimologia.html). Close: [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Two rooms

| Room | English | Craft |
|------|---------|-------|
| **A. Narrative** | *parable* | A story thrown beside the thesis |
| **B. Curve** | *parabola* | Points equidistant from focus and directrix; *y = ax²* |
| **Daughter** | *word* ≠ *parabola* | [palavra](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-palavra.html) — Romance child of the same Latin |
| **Lab use** | “X as a parable of Y” | Room A — method, not cosmology |

English **cuts** what Portuguese **keeps together**. [The Matrix](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-the-matrix.html) is used in the lab as a **parable of verification**. [O Alquimista](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-o-alquimista.html) is a travel parable. [Lemniscate](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lemniscata.html) is another curve, not this conic.

## Lab poem

```poem
Parábola.
To throw beside.

A story that compares
without naming the thing.
A curve that joins
the focus and the directrix.

The same root
gave the word
and the parabola.

English cuts them:
parable / parabola.
Portuguese
keeps one mouth.

Valeu !!!
two rooms,
one etymon.
```

## Status

**Approved in Words.** One page for Latin and Portuguese. Two rooms. Daughter *palavra* cut. [Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)
inspecao-palavra-parabola.contentEs:
## Alcance

Página de estudio de **parábola** (PT) y lat. **parabola** — una ficha, dos salas. Gr. *parabolḗ* (*para-* «al lado» + *bállein* «lanzar»): lanzar una comparación **al lado**. Pedido: inspeccionar *Parabola*; luego: una página dedicada, latín y portugués juntos.

Sala A = la **historia** que enseña comparando (EN *parable*). Sala B = la **curva** (EN *parabola*; cónica; foco y directriz). La hija [palavra](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-palavra.html) («vocablo») es **otra** ficha. No es catecismo. No es curso de cónicas.

> Fuentes: [Wikcionario](https://pt.wiktionary.org/wiki/par%C3%A1bola), lat. [*parabola*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/parabola#Latin). Método: [etimología](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-etimologia.html). Cierre: [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html).

## Dos salas

| Sala | Inglés | Oficio |
|------|--------|--------|
| **A. Narrativa** | *parable* | Historia lanzada al lado de la tesis |
| **B. Curva** | *parabola* | Puntos a igual distancia del foco y la directriz |
| **Hija** | *word* ≠ *parabola* | [palavra](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-palavra.html) — hija romance |
| **Uso lab** | «X como parábola de Y» | Sala A — método, no cosmología |

El inglés **corta** lo que el portugués **junta**. [The Matrix](/posts/post-inspecao-filme-the-matrix.html) se usa como **parábola de verificación**. [O Alquimista](/posts/post-inspecao-arte-o-alquimista.html) es parábola de viaje. La [lemniscata](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-lemniscata.html) es otra curva.

## Poema del laboratorio

```poem
Parábola.
Lanzar al lado.

Una historia que compara
sin decir el nombre.
Una curva que junta
el foco y la directriz.

La misma raíz
dio la palavra
y la parábola.

En inglés cortan:
parable / parabola.
En portugués
es la misma boca.

¡Valeu !!!
dos salas,
un étimo.
```

## Estado

**Aprobada en Palabras.** Una página para latín y portugués. Dos salas. Hija *palavra* cortada. [¡Valeu !!!](/posts/post-inspecao-palavra-valeu.html)
